description:
You can choose this apartment for a completely safe and comfortable stay in a central location.
The apartment consists of a living room, bedroom, kitchen, balcony, toilet, and bathroom, and you have the entire place to yourselves.
You can check in on your own using the smart entry system located at the building entrance. After each guest, the apartment is hygienically cleaned, and all used items such as linens, towels, and sheets are replaced with new ones. The apartment is located within walking distance to transportation options such as the Marmaray metro.
🙂🙏🏻

reviews.text: Unfortunately, the stay didn’t meet our expectations. The photos showed the apartment differently. There was a strong smell of cigarette smoke in the building and unit, likely from the carpet — a clear “No Smoking” policy would help. The layout was inconvenient: kitchen and bed in one room, sofas in another. Furniture was worn, with burn marks on the table, and lighting was very dim. The balcony wasn’t usable due to water pooling from the AC and an old broken chair. The bathroom was very small, with a damaged door. No vacuum, broom, washing machine, or microwave were provided; the fridge leaked inside. On the positive side, the location was excellent — close to shops, cafes, and a large park. The host was polite and responsive, bringing needed items when asked. In its current condition, it’s more suitable for a short solo stay than for a family.

Konum iyiydi,kolay ulaşım,kolay giriş yaptık.Fakat binaya girince ağır kötü koku vardı ve 3 gün boyunca bu koku kaldı.Odaya giriş iyiydi,tuvalet ve banyo aynı yerde idi,kapısı kapanmıyor,zorlarsanız belki, kilidi kırık idi.Tuvalet leş gibi lekeler vardı,yanımda getirdiğim hijyen malzemeleri ile kendim temizledim,uzun saç kılları vardı,duş başlığı heryerinden kaçırıyor birde askısına asılamiyordu,kırık idi,elimizle tutmak suretiyle banyo edebildik.Buzdolabi vardı,ayarları bozuk soğutmuyor, sürekli gürültülü çalışıyor, soğutma ayarları değiştirme olanağı olmadı.yatak iyiydi,temiz çarşaf ve havlular düzgündü, yerdeki kaplama halı temiz sayılırdı.Balkona oturulacak derisi tamamen kalkmış sandalye vardı, pencere ve kapılar boyası kalmış,o kadar eskiydi ki,tarihi eserdi resmen.Koltuklar leş gibiydi,sigara yanıkları vardı,üstelik bazı kırlentler yerlerde idi, böyle olunca oturmadık bile.Zamanımızın çoğunu dışarıda geçirip,yatmak için kullandık sadece,ailemle kalmak imkansız, iğrençti.

konum itabiri ile mükemmel ama fiyat performans açısından kötüydü duş başlığı bozuktu buzdolabında önceki misafirden kalma ürünler vardı. su bile yoktu odada koltuk minderleri bile duzeltilmemişti yatak çarşafları ve yastık yüzleri karışıktı duvarlar lekeliydi iyi birşey ekleyeyim klimalar sorunsuz çalışıyordu. Emrah beyin personeli ve kendisi iletişim konusunda gayet iyilerdi

There wasn’t kitchen equipment and the place needs maintenance. There is only one bed but not much clean, no iron, no vacuum cleaner when needed. Balcony was a total mess. Location is very good and easy to access everything. Mr Emrah was responsible and willing to help.
Konum mükemmel, ev çok keyifliydi. Giriş/çıkış süreci çok rahat geçti, iletişim hızlıydı. Temizlik ve düzen gayet iyiydi. Tekrar tercih ederim

description:
This is Historical Rum building named “Rum_Otto” in the heart of Taksim. We carefully renovated the building with little touch Ottoman design to keep history alive and little modern design to make your stay comfy. Everything inside “first class” materialized you easily understand during your stay

This house with 6 independent room in the same building.Perfect for large group who wants to close with personal privacy

reviews.text:
The location was amazing. We were walking distance to many bars and clubs, restaurants, activities and even a local market to get anything we needed. Down the street was a taxi hub, which made it easy to get around.
The host was very helpful and responsive. To be honest, he was one of the nicest people I met in Turkey.
Each room had everything we needed - irons, extra towels, kitchen utensils, bedding, etc - whatever was missing, the host provided ASAP! No complaints.
My only CON to this airbnb - we were a group of 8, the description was not clear about the layout until we received check in information. This is house designed like hotel rooms - there was not a comfortable common area for all of us together. The hot tub was only accessible to whoever is in the basement room, which also has a completely separate entrance. We loved the airbnb just wished we had more space to gather collectively.

7 of us stayed for 3 nights. Check-in was smooth with clear instructions, with keyless pin entry. The apartments/rooms were all very comfortable and had everything one would need for a short trip (or long). The property is in a sloping verge, and has staircase access from the road, hence maybe not very suitable for wheelchair access, but it was not a problem for us. There was a shop nearby (less than a minutes walk) that was open 24 hrs. Taksim square and Istiklal street were in walking distance.
Most convenient of all was how quick our host Iso responded to all our questions.
We really enjoyed our trip and would definitely recommend and stay there again if we were to visit Istanbul again.
Thank you Iso.

Our host, ISO was very responsive & sent clear, well written instructions. They were also patient with us when we were tired & asked for help with information already included in what was sent.
The apartments were all stunning! Very clean & as exciting to walk into as to see online. We rented the whole building for a large family group. It gave us all individual space when we needed it, plus we were close enough to socialise & share the experience.
The location was very handy to get around.
We were very happy with our stay & would love to stay there again.
Thankyou ISO for providing such a beautiful retreat in the heart of Istanbul..

For a big group this place provides all the comforts for every family/ couple with their own private kitchen and bathrooms and some community space in the bigger rooms for casual hangouts. Amazing hosts. Would love to stay here again!!

Our group of 10 had a great time at Rum Otto. The host was so helpful and communicative during our entire stay. We were there for a wedding and needed help with transportation to the wedding events, and the host helped us set that all up. The bathrooms were a little bit small, but that's to be expected. Overall, great place to stay at with a great value.

description: Come stay in this private, quiet and homely home, it is located in the heart of downtown. This spacious house is perfect for a group of travel companions or a family looking for a peaceful stay. Enjoy walking everywhere in this apartment located in the heart of Istanbul. Our house is centrally located near many restaurants and shopping. Amenities include High-Speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, a washing machine, and a dryer. Have a great vacation.

reviews.text:
We had a fantastic stay at this apartment!
It's spacious, cozy, and immaculately clean, offering a perfect retreat. It’s even more spacious than it appears in the photos.
The kitchen is well-equipped with everything you might need.
The cleanliness was top-notch.
The location is great, being close to the Sahil and close to many amenities, though it’s ideal for those who enjoy walking if you don’t have a car. So if you hate walking, it could be challenging.
The host was incredibly responsive, ensuring our stay was seamless.
Highly recommended for a comfortable and convenient stay!

I recently had the pleasure of staying at Mesut’s charming apartment. From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the warm hospitality and attention to detail.
The apartment was impeccably clean and beautifully decorated, with thoughtful touches that made it feel like a home away from home. The bedrooms were clean, the kitchen fully equipped and it was very spacious and location perfect, providing a perfect place to relax after a day of exploring the city.
Mesut was an exceptional host, always available to answer questions and provide recommendations. Their guide to local restaurants and attractions was incredibly helpful and added to the overall experience.
The location was ideal, situated in a quiet neighborhood but still close to all the major sights. Public transportation was easily accessible, making it convenient to get around.
Overall, my stay exceeded all expectations, and I highly recommend Mesut’s apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. I look forward to returning.

Mesut was a very friendly host, he answered very fast and provided us with what we needed. However there are a few points I would like to mention, the flat is in the basement and there is no view outside, the humidity is super high in the basement which has resulted in a bad smell and my clothes were somehow wet the whole time. The sheets and towels were clean but quite old, the same as the pans in the kitchen. The elevator and AC were working well and we did not have problems. we were 6 people but I guess the flat is better for 4-5 people, there is a portable mattress but the flat is not big enough for it.

Mesut was a great host, responsive, helpful, and easy to communicate with throughout the stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and generally well maintained.
Some furniture could use renewal, but everything was still acceptable and functional for the stay. We also needed extra pots for cooking, and Mesut kindly provided them for us, which we appreciated.
The neighborhood is very convenient, with good public transportation connections, supermarkets, and other necessities nearby.
The only point future guests may want to consider is the distance to some parts of the city center. Reaching the western side of Asian Istanbul by public transportation can take close to 2 hours depending on traffic and timing.

Everything was great, the place was exactly as described and a lot of good restaurants around the area. The only negative is that parking was hard to find and there was a very faint animal smell in certain spots in the house. But overall good experience.

description:
Experience Istanbul from this stylish 1 bedroom residence in the heart of Beyoğlu. Perfect for urban explorers, you’re just a short stroll from Taksim Square and the luxury boutiques of Nişantaşı.
Enjoy total peace of mind with 24/7 building security and modern amenities. Whether you're here for culture or shopping, this central gem offers the ultimate city base.
• Top Location: Near Metro & Galata
• Safe & Secure: Full-time staff
• Modern Comfort: Fully equipped

reviews.text:
Great place , clean and cozy .
There is a lot of noise as the building is facing the street so all motorcycles noise starts at night .
Parking lot is great , apartment location is accessible.
Bed is not that much comfortable and pillows are not comfortable, blanket not enough for 2 people as it is smaller than the bed itself .
The living room sofa smells cigarettes and the bedroom is wall at the bed side has some stains .
Room cleaning charge was deducted but for the hall stay it hasn’t been cleaned !!
The door can’t be locked for my own safety , internal door lock is not working !!
Other than that, it is a great apartment.
Hope to visit you again ♥️

I really enjoyed my stay at this apartment! Everything was exactly as described — clean, cozy, and stylish. It was a pleasure to spend time inside, and you can tell that every detail was thoughtfully considered. The location is convenient and in a quiet area. Check-in was smooth, and the host was always responsive and helpful. Thank you for the warm welcome — I’d be happy to stay here again!

evin konumu gayet iyi ve ev temizdi .. fakat şu bardağı ve fincanda milattan önce kalmaydi resmen.. selin hanım her zaman destek oldu iletişimi süper fakat sikayetimiz yatak o kadar gıcırdıyoki gece uyumaniz imkansız, ek olarak getirilen çocuk yatağının da ordasi çökmüş ve örtünmek için küçük bir pike bırakılmış yetersizdi

Great stay! The apartment was slightly further out than it looked on maps but still walkable (if you like walking!) to all of the major attractions in Istanbul. Apartment was very clean with all the amenities you needed for a short or long stay - it would maybe be good to have complementary tea and coffee and hair conditioner included, in addition to what is already provided but this is the only suggestion. We used the pool and gym facilities a couple of times. The pool is pretty cold but a treat to have; the gym facilities are great. There are a couple of shops on the ground floor below, and it seems like there will be more joining them in the coming months! To get to a few of the main attractions/centre it is around a 15/20 minute (uphill) walk, and lots of restaurants in that area too. We would be happy to stay here again!

A great stay. As usual. A 10 min walk to Taksim. Close to lots of places to eat. 10 min drive to many places. Great location for Istanbul. The apt itself was as described and I will be back the next time I visit Istanbul.

description: Enjoy the best of style, comfort, and safety in our stunning building, perfect for both families and business travelers. Rest easy knowing that our apartments are designed to provide you with everything you need for a memorable stay, including top-notch amenities and a secure environment. Whether you're here for work or holiday, you'll love the stylish atmosphere and inviting decor that our flats have to offer.

reviews.text: Very vey good apartment huge and spacious for one bedroom apartment just the the bedroom is the same size as hotel room, extremely clean, very good and nice furniture, bed was comfy, full kitchenette some pots need to be changed, washer & dryer, underground parking, and the best is the view facing the street but it's not that noisy, highly recommended, regarding the host he's very helpful came to meet us in person at the check in, and didn't rush us to checkout one of the best hosts

Great place! Very clean it’s bigger than the photos, nice decor and comfy, the locations is also great! Very close to taksim square and walkable distance to Galata tower. Host very friendly and helpful! Definitely recommend

well recommended this will be your best choice we really liked Muzeyyen's apartment and from sure we will come back in our next visit to istanbul

The place matches the photos and they had every amenities you might need including hair straightener.
The equipment and the structure of the house is great. The only downside is the noise that comes to the bedroom at night and that’s because it’s located in the city centre in a busy street. If you have airplugs all should be fine. They are also very responsive and reply to you very quickly. They even changed my booking which was really helpful.

description:
Wireless internet. Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nişantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at this apartment. Everything was perfect — the place was very clean, well-equipped, and exactly as described. The neighborhood is quiet and feels very safe, and I truly appreciated the level of privacy I had throughout my stay. The host was responsive and helpful whenever I had a question. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for comfort, security, and peace of mind. Definitely a 5-star experience
Très belle endroit! Le logement correspond très bien aux photos, l'immeuble aussi est propre et semble récent! J'ai adoré et je recommande. Merci!!
Great host
Die Unterkunft entsprach der Beschreibung und war angenehm für unseren Aufenthalt. Der Kontakt mit dem Host war freundlich und unkompliziert.
Great place in a beautiful location. Has a nice pool, sauna, gym, and even a market and small restaurant attached to the complex.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Mr. Yakup’s place looks exactly the same as in the photos and might be even better. I chose his property because of the location, cost and also the good reviews. I arrived early but Mr. Yakup allowed me to leave my heavy luggages and even brought all of it in the room so I did not have any problem bringing it to the 4th floor. The room was spacious, bright and clean. The host is very helpful and responsive to questions and requests. He even gave me recommendations for laundry. The best part about the property is, the moment you open the main door of the building, you would be welcomed with one of the nicest smell I ever had. It reaches to the top floor where my unit is. It is so pleasant. Another best thing about Mr. yakup is he let me leave my luggage for safe keeping since I went to different and will come back to Istanbul after a long time. He is one of the best hosts I have ever encountered. Definitely recommended and will stay again!

Great value for money!
This Airbnb was a fantastic find in Istanbul. The unit was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for our stay. The host was incredibly responsive and helpful, making our trip even more enjoyable. The location was perfect, with easy access to all the major tourist attractions. Highly recommend!

We liked the location. Any street we walked onto brought us a feeling of authenticity and originality. The apartment is as in the photo, clean, with crisp white linens and a very comfortable double bed (a big plus). Excellent communication from start to finish and very warm hospitality, many thanks to Muwafaq.

The location is perfect - 5 min walk to Sultanahmet. The apartment was very clean and well maintained. The host was easy to reach and helpful. I'd recommend this apartment.
Just a note: there are lots of stairs, narrow, so it will be hard to reach for someone with lots of heavy luggage. It was not a problem for us, but worth mentioning.
Yakup was very nice, helpful, and quick to reply. The place was clean, comfortable, and close to the city center. Almost everything is within walking distance. I can highly recommend it.

description:
Hey there people
The home is at the Istanbul historic centre peninsula, in Beyoglu a few steps away from Galata Tower. Also just 2 munite for go to Galata port. İstiklal street - şişhane metro station just 4 munite on the walk . Also tophane metro station is just 1 munite. There are well known restaurants and cafes,art galleries and boutique shops and Markets in a min away.All touristic attractions are in walkable distance.You will have more than what traveler needs.

reviews.text: The location is great, close to good restaurants, attractions and the tram line. The host was very responsive and helped arrange a transfer from the airport. The apartment matched the description and photos. The shower and bathroom sinks had a significant amount of black mold. We asked the host to clean it and they came the next morning and deep cleaned the shower and replaced the moldy caulking on the sinks. We cleaned the tub out with bleach on our own before using. The dishwasher did not work and the host offered to hook up, but we decided to just hand wash. The beds, pillows and couch were comfortable for adults and kids. The kitchen had a mildew smell every time we used the sink. Overall good stay except for the mold. Thankful the host was so responsive.

Cevat’s place was exactly how it looked in the pictures. The check-in process was so smooth and so was the check-out. There’s no view but hey, let’s be honest if I wanted view I’d have booked a hotel overlooking Taksim Square, right? Loved the location because the nearest public transport station was a mere 5 mins walk and that connected you to all the main tourist spots. Well, Beyoglu is no less a tourist spot :) We could walk to many places for lunch and dinner during our stay. The kitchen was equipped with anything one may need.
I’d love to return to this tiny compact cosy apartment albeit with a little less luggage so that it’s easier to lug it up and down the staircase :)

The apartment was nice and well located, near the Galata tower, it was very clean and the communication with the host was perfect. Nevertheless it lack of toaster and kitchen utensils were limited and it was smaller than it seems in the photos.

The apartment was in a great location, very close to the tram and bus stations, and it was easy to walk to Galata Tower and the main street. We had an issue with the shower drain, but the host responded right away and fixed it quickly, which we really appreciated. The luggage storage and check-in process were also very convenient. The apartment was spacious enough for five people, and the AC worked very well during the hot summer. There was about one flight of stairs, but it was not a problem for us. Overall, we had a very comfortable stay.

Our stay at Cevat's place was excellent. The location is perfect - just a short walk from key spots in Beyoğlu, yet quiet enough to relax. Check-in was smooth, communication was quick, and the accommodation was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. We felt safe, welcomed, and well taken care of throughout our stay. Highly Recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul.

description:
Welcome to our tiny private room in the heart of Beşiktaş!

Beşiktaş is filled with restaurants, cafes, shops and bars, as well as its historical landmarks.

Our cosy room features a comfortable double bed, private bathroom with original ceiling fan.

With its central location and easy access to public transportation.

it's the perfect base for exploring all that Istanbul has to offer. Maybe remind you there is no Air-condition for the environmental reasons 🙏 but of course with ceiling fan

reviews.text:
The location was easy to find and easy to travel for those who want to see the city.
The room was clean and sufficient for a comfortable stay. Although there was noise due to being in a central, it did not bother me much.
Check-in and check-out processes were also quite easy. When I had a question, I always received a return and guidance. A nice and quality place to stay :)

The room was really clean and tidy. The staff sister was very attentive and helpful. The only issue that could be considered was that there was a lot of noise coming from outside to inside, but that's quite normal depending on the location.

Konumu gayet iyiydi. Toplu taşıma araçları ile ulaşım çok rahat sağladık . Ve bir çok yere de yürüyerek ulaşım sağlanabilir . Odanın çok dar oluşu bizi rahatsız etti. İki kişinin ayakta zor durduğu kadar küçük bir alan var yatağın yanında . Valizlerinizde koyduğunuz da neredeyse hiç yer kalmıyor . Adroniki bey gerekli iletişimi kurdu ve personeli de bizimle ilgilendi fakat fiyat performans olarak aşırı küçük bir oda ve gece camı asla açıp yatamadık . Dışarı da parmaklık olmalıydı güvenlik açısından endişe verici. Sokakta aşırı gürültülü bir sokak değil fakat gece odaya ses tabi ki geliyor zemin katta çünkü.

Konum aşırı merkezi akaretlerin direkt arkası olması bu yerin en büyük artısı. Ancak oda çok küçük.( fotoğraflarda belli olduğu için sıkıntı yok.) Oda aşırı sıcaktı havalandırması yetmiyordu. Camı açtığımızda camda sineklik ve güvenlik demirleri yoktu. Cam açmaktan çekindik bu sebeple piştik. Klima vs yada camın önüne yapılacak bir demir işi çözecektir. Bunların dışında 3. günümün sabahında uyandıktan sonra ayakkabımı giyerken ayakkabıma kertenkele girmiş. Odanın kapısında küçük delikler var muhtemelen ordan girdi, çok kötü bi deneyim oldu kertenkele. Onun dışında duştan sıcak su güzel aktı. Esnek giriş çıkış saatleri iyiydi. Havlular temizdi ve güzel kokuyordu.
The room was clean and tidy, there was shampoo and liquid soap in the bathroom. Perfect location and clear check-in/out instructions. Good ventilation in the bathroom.

description: Walking among the greenery and typical island houses, cycling, swimming, visiting the S.F. Abasıyanık Museum, witnessing the most beautiful sunset in Istanbul, eating in Kalpazankaya, collecting mimosas in the spring, understanding Marta while swimming in the bay

Biz memnun kaldık, tekrar kalmak isteriz

Biz evde 2 çift kaldık. Yatak odasındaki yatakta hiçbir sorun yoktu fakat salondaki çekyatta kalan arkadaşlar,çekyatın eğiminden dolayı pek rahat uyuyamadıklarını söylediler. Eser hanım ilerde çekyatı değiştirmeyi düşünebilir.Onun haricinde herkese tavsiye ederim.

description:
This 1BR apartment is located at the heart of city’s coolest neighbourhood ''Moda'' walking distance to Kalamış Coast, shops, restaurants, famous bars, markets and all transportation. Just a 5 minutes walk to the famous “Boğa Heykeli”.

- Designed with taste, this apartment will be ideal for anyone who is seeking comfort, a “home like” atmosphere, accessibility to major tourist attractions.

-Self check-in is also available using the password.

reviews.text:
NOTE: smoking is forbidden, and you have to use the elevator each time you want to smoke a cigarette so for smokers it can be uncofortable. After you book they will text you that you'll get a 100$ fine if they found that you smoked inside.
The place is placed well close to metrobüs station, place is clean, bed confortable, place to work with laptop available. Air conditioning was good and cooled the whole place. Inside is modern and cozy I like it and defintly will book again.

Overall, I had a good stay. The location was convenient, and communication with the host was responsive and helpful throughout.
There were some cleanliness issues on arrival, including stains and hair on the couch and bedding. However, once I raised the issue, the host responded promptly and did what they could to address it.
One thing to be aware of is that the road outside can be quite noisy, particularly at certain times of the day. Aside from that, the accommodation was well located and the host was attentive and easy to reach.

-absolutely not recommend for people who are into their comfort and who prefers clean accommodation

I am very sorry I had to stay in this location, as well as I am sorry to write this review as I hate to make people upset. However I have to be honest: I didn’t find it pretty, things were ugly, dirty and needed maintenance, from the key door that would not open, to the bathroom that has stains on the sides that can’t be washed, as they need a complete bathroom renovation. reviews.text:
I had a fantastic stay at Burak place! The service was amazing—just as promised. Borac is incredibly hospitable and warm; he’s always ready to help, show you around, and guide you in the right direction. He truly goes above and beyond to make your stay comfortable.
The location is perfect—just a 5-minute walk to Taksim, with plenty of shops, restaurants, and even 24-hour supermarkets and dining spots nearby. Everything you need is right around the corner.
Borac himself is a one-man show—he’ll make sure you’re taken care of, and honestly, he’s so kind that it feels like you don’t even have to worry about money (don’t tell him I said that!). He even gave me two bottles of water for free, which was really appreciated.
For breakfast or a quick bite, you can head downstairs to the rice restaurant (I forgot the name, but it’s the one with the yellow sign)—they serve great sandwiches at a fair price, though maybe not for every single day!
The building is secure, with a guard always pres

The entire home was beautiful, clean, and warm, which was especially nice during those freezing winter days. The building itself was stunning and well-constructed, and the indoor parking lot was a great convenience.
The stay was comfortable, and having a car made it easy to get anything I needed. The kitchen had a few basic utensils, which were still usable, and the cooking pots were good. However, it would have been helpful to have a few more.
One small thing to note is that hand wash soap and shampoo were not provided, so guests may want to bring their own.
Overall, the home was lovely, the building was beautiful, and the indoor parking was an excellent bonus. I appreciated the cleanliness and warmth of the space, which made for a pleasant stay.

We had a wonderful stay at Burak’s place. It was beautiful, cozy, and exactly as described in the pictures. The kitchen and bathroom were spotless, and the location was perfect, close to Taksim Square, Galata Port, Galata Tower, and many other tourist attractions.
Burak was an amazing host, friendly, responsive, and always ready to assist us.
Since I’m quite sensitive to light and we tend to sleep in late, the curtains didn’t fully block the sunlight. However, Burak was very helpful and quickly provided new ones, which allowed us to sleep a bit more comfortably.
Overall, we absolutely loved the apartment.

I had a pleasant stay in Istanbul with Burak as my host. He is extremely friendly, helpful, and always willing to assist. Every time I asked for something, he did his best to arrange it as quickly as possible, and I really appreciated his positive attitude. The location is great, about a 25-minute walk from Taksim Square, which made it easy to explore the city.
The only downside was that the apartment I received was not the same as the one shown in the photos. Burak has several apartments in the same building, and the one I stayed in was missing many basic items at first. To his credit, he worked on fixing everything during my stay, bringing what was needed little by little according to my free time. However, I feel that if I had stayed for a shorter period, there might not have been enough time to get everything properly arranged.
Overall, Burak is a great host, but I recommend confirming in advance which apartment you will stay in and whether it is fully equipped.

The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and perfect for our stay. It's location near shopping and a variety of eateries made everything we needed easily accessible. We loved the vibrant atmosphere and the opportunity for some great people-watching in the area. Having access to the gym and pool was an added bonus, making the stay even more enjoyable. Burak was a fantastic host, always responsive and ensuring everything was in order. His attention to detail really made a difference. I’d absolutely stay here again and recommend it to both friends and family. Thank you, Burak, for providing such a wonderful experience!

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great and everything we needed was nearby. We have enjoyed everything about this apartment : Once we arrived it was super easy to check in. Inside the apartment was very clean and neat. The beds were super comfy. Although it was in a busy neighborhood the street that the apartment was on felt very quiet. There are a lot of cafes, restaurants, every shop imaginable and at least 4 supermarkets nearby. Looking to book it again next time we're in Istanbul.

My stay at this apartment was amazing! It is so central and easy to get to anywhere. there is an elevator in the building. the building in general is new and renovated. the location is very good, the metro is 5 mins walking distance. there are nice restaurants and cafes nearby. i definitely recommend to families. the apartment is spacious and nicely decorated. The cleaning was flawless, we couldn't notice one mistake. the staff and the hospitality was great. i really am going to only stay here on my other trips to istanbul. Thank you Emir and Yasemin.
We enjoyed staying in Emir and Yasemin Place. The location is great and it’s a very comfortable place. The hosts are very responsive and would like to go back someday.
The most responsive host on Airbnb I’ve ever had. Thank you. The place is at great location, very central. The flat is comfortable and matches the description. I would stay here again.

reviews.text: Hasan's place was exactly as shown in the photos. It was clean and quote central in a peaceful neighborhood. At walking distance from the Galata tower as well as Taksim. The only disadvantage is that the room is on the 4th floor and the building doesn't have a lift. But Hasan will arrange for assistance if required, so that wasn't much of a problem either. Hasan was very kind and responsive and answered all our questions. Will definitely recommend staying here!

As a host, Hasan is amazing! He is very responsive, very helpful, and assisted in resolutions to a few issues we had very promptly... which is such a major benefit when staying in Airbnbs!
As for the apartment, we stayed there when the heat was very bad in August, and the home had just 1 air con in the livingroom. This left the other rooms very hot, but we made do with the fans Hasan left. In any other season, it would have been quite fine.
There are a lot of stairs being on the 4th floor, but great exercise! Istanbul is a city of stairs & hills... so you should just come prepared either way lol.
Everything else was as to be expected. perhaps a little deeper cleaning in the shower would be good, but again, we were truly fine here.
The area provided close access to great food, ferry, sites, and the water front. We enjoyed our stay very much.
Thanks Hasan for being such an amazing host!

I find it similar to a 3* hotel, the apartment is big and clean but it has just 1 bathroom and it needed some maintenance. We found some electrical sockets hanging off the wall that could be a problem for families with small kids, the air conditioning is a mobile unit installed in the living room, it's noisy and doesn't cover all the rooms. The downstairs neighbors put their garbage in front of the door and we had to keep our breath while going up the stairs. Overall it was ok for a family with three kids.

The location couldn’t be better — it’s right in the heart of the city— close to everything from historic sites to great food spots. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and Hasan was incredibly kind and helpful. I felt right at home. Highly recommended!
Everything was just as described by the host. He was very responsive to any questions I had and consistently checked in to see if we needed anything.

description:
Wake up to breathtaking panoramic views of the Bosphorus in one of Istanbul's most beautiful and prestigious neighborhoods.

Located in the peaceful district of Emirgan, this spacious 2-bedroom apartment offers the perfect combination of comfort, tranquility, and easy access to some of Istanbul's most iconic attractions.

Enjoy your morning coffee overlooking the Bosphorus, take a relaxing stroll along the waterfront, or spend the evening watching the city lights from the terrace.

reviews.text:
We stayed in this apartment for two weeks, and the breathtaking view was truly the highlight of our stay. The apartment is a good size, and the kitchen is well-equipped for a longer stay.
There were a few issues, though. Storage space is very limited, especially for families staying more than a few days, and there is no drying rack for clothes that can’t go in the dryer. The listing also mentions a Fold ’n Play crib, but only a bassinet was provided.
The biggest downside was the renovation work in another apartment. We were told it would last only two days, but it continued for almost 12 days. The hosts did their best to coordinate the work around our schedule, but having to notify them every time we left or returned wasn’t something we expected to do on vacation, and the noise was difficult with young children.
The location is beautiful and close to the waterfront, although families with strollers should be aware that the walk back to the apartment is quite steep.

Breathtaking view. So peaceful. Within a short walking distance to town, Great space, so comfortable, clean, loved having a washer & dryer, kitchen had everything you need in terms of appliances & all the basics to cook with. Would highly recommend to stay here as we had such a lovely time!
Excellent location. Great view of the priceless Bosphorus . A bit tiny street and slightly uphill but amazing view so worth it
It was amazing. Better than photos.
Le logement est parfait et encore plus beau que sur les photos. La vue sur le pont est magnifique. M. EFE est accueillant et nous a expliquer tous ce qu’il fallait sur le logement.

reviews.text: The host was very kind, super responsive, and helpful, which I truly appreciated. Unfortunately, the property itself had many issues. It was extremely noisy—dogs barking all night, roosters starting at 4 a.m., and loud prayer calls from nearby mosques—making it very hard to sleep. One bed was uncomfortable, and the bathroom was poorly designed: the shower sprayed water everywhere, the slope caused water to pool near the toilet, and strong sewer smells came from the drains. The ceiling was very low (I’m 175cm and hit my head), and there was no ventilation, which made the smell worse. Instead of a real cooktop, there was only a portable one that had to be plugged in through the bathroom door, so you couldn’t close or lock it while in use. Overall, the host was wonderful, but the property needs major improvements in plumbing, comfort, and design. It was about 1.5 hr drive from the Taksim Square and neighbors were very kind and welcoming.

Semra is a very kind lady and her bnb had absolutely amazing views. There is a couple of restaurants that are walk-able as well as a lovely breakfast place around. The place was moderately clean and a little noisy. The one thing I want to mention is that the pictures did not show that there is only a mini-fridge in the place and the bathroom area has a very sloped roof where its hard to even stand by the toilet or the sink, I'm 5'4 and had problems with this but my boyfriend who is 6 ft banged his head numerous times, had some light bleeding. I think this is something that needs to be mentioned in the descriptions. If you are anywhere above 5 ft I don't recommend this bnb.

Öncelikle Semra hanıma ve annesine çok çok teşekkür ederim. Hersey harikaydı. Eve bayıldım. Bütün ihtiyaclarımızı karşılayacak hersey vardı evin içinde. Bir daha imkanımız fırsatımız olursa gene aynı evi tutmak isteriz. Evin konumu bizleri çok cezbetti. Alt katı ayrı üst katı ayrı ayrı temiz ve geniş aynı zamanda ferahtı. Ağaçların arasında olması evin hem serin kalmasını hem de sessiz sakin kalmasını sağlıyor. Herkese tavsiye ederim.

Çok şirin ve fiyatı uygun bir ev, Semra hanım güleryüzlü ve yardımsever bir insan. Kendisiyle iletişim çok kolaydı. Evinde kendimi rahat hissettim. Evin manzarası çok güzeldi. Çevresinde yürüyüş yapabileceğiniz sahil var, güzel yemek yiyebileceğiniz mekanlarda var. Kendisine teşekkür ediyorum.

Huzurlu, sakin bir yerdi. Tam resimlerde anlatıldığı gibiydi. Bir daha konaklayacak olsam aynı yere giderim. Kendi evimde gibi rahat ettim. Hava soğuk olmasına rağmen içerideki klima son derece sıcak bir hava sağlıyordu. Tavsiye ederim. 5 yıldız.

description: A modern and spatious 2+1 flat in a private building with luxurious amenities, including a pool, gym, sauna, cafe and a 7/24 security. reviews.text:
We had a really good stay overall. The apartment was comfortable, the rooms were good and the swimming pool was a big bonus, especially for the kids who really enjoyed it.
The location was good, around a 10-minute walk to Taksim Square, where there are plenty of shops, restaurants and good transport links. The only slight downside was the uphill walk to Taksim, which could be tiring at times.
The owner was very helpful and accommodating. Communication was excellent and whenever we messaged, he responded quickly, which made our stay much easier.
One tip for future guests is to keep the 2pm check-in time in mind when booking flights, as early check-in may be difficult while the apartment is being cleaned and prepared.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would happily recommend it, especially for families.

reviews.text: Our stay was absolutely fantastic. The apartment is in a side street of the Galata Tower in Beyoglu on the European side and everything is around that apartment. Metro station, huge Supermarkt, shops, restaurants and bars and literally a 10 min walk to İstiklal Street, Taxim. We loved it. Everything was clean, accurate as shown in the pictures and Hakan as well as the Janitor Elias always there when needed. The walls of the apartment are very thin, you can hear neighbors if they speak or walk, when disturbances happen, Hakan took immediately care of it. (We had a minor disturbance on one night, but nothing major) overall the stay is a 10/10 and we will visit again. Thank you Hakan for hosting us!

The location is excellent—everything is nearby: ferries, trams, and the metro. I highly recommend this place, especially if it’s your first time in Istanbul or if you’re staying for just a few days with a tight schedule. The host responds quickly and is always ready to help, and the apartment is clean and comfortable

Hakan was a great host and met us on arrival at the apartment. He was always quick to respond to any messages. The apartment was spacious and the beds were comfortable. As tap water in Istanbul is not potable we appreciated the two large containers of drinking water that were provided. A great location and we would be happy to stay again.

This property is in a very convenient location for exploring the Galata area. We stayed for seven nights, and the only thing we felt could make the stay even more comfortable would be having a microwave, which would also help save on electricity. There are small supermarkets nearby, but to buy alcohol you need to walk a bit farther — something we understand is due to local religious customs.
Our host, Hakan, was incredibly kind. When we mentioned during check‑in that we were short on toilet paper, he immediately contacted his staff from afar and had it delivered to us in no time. That level of responsiveness alone makes it clear why he deserves to be a Superhost.
We would be very happy to stay here again.

Enjoyed staying here very much. Apartment is centrally located, transport close by and lots of cute restaurants and coffee shops right outside the building. Apartment was extremely clean, well taken care of and had all you need for however long you stay. Having an elevator was a big plus (although the apt was on first floor) as dragging luggage up stairs is not fun. Overall highly recommended.

description: Experience the charm of Balat with breathtaking views of the Golden Horn from this cozy, stylish flat. Perfectly situated in one of Istanbul’s most historic and vibrant neighborhoods, this apartment offers a blend of comfort and local character. Enjoy watching the sunset over the water from your window, stroll through colorful streets, and explore nearby cafes, artisan shops, and iconic landmarks. Ideal for travelers looking to immerse themselves in the true spirit of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Overall, my partner and I had a pleasant stay! The location is fantastic, right in central Istanbul with public transport only a 1-minute walk away, yet still quiet and not in a hectic area. The balcony with its unique view is truly special and the air conditioning was also very comfortable.
That being said, the cleanliness could be improved. The apartment didn’t feel " dirty", but nothing was really clean either: dust and hairs on the bedside table, many stains on the walls, doors, ceiling and on the sofa. Very moldy/dirty sealant edges in the shower.
What we found most surprising, though, was the towel policy. For an 8-night stay, only one large bath towel (plus a small face towel) per person was provided, and every extra set came at a charge of €10 (!). In our experience, it is a very basic standard that a stay of this length includes at least 2–3 towels per person. We ended up buying 4 large towels ourselves for €5 in total...

We really enjoyed our stay in Furkan's place.
The terrace is huge and with perfect view on the Golden Horn. The apartment is the right size for two people and cozy. The little kitchen has all the necessary to cook a few meals when needed.
We would have appreciate little more attention to details (only one hanger for all the towels and no clothes rack near the door, some maintenance to fix the shower hose hanger, few more cleaning supplies available would be necessary, and carpet to clean slippers when coming from the balcony).
Apart from that, we found the area perfect to visit Istanbul, just a short walk from the vivid Balat Neighbourhood and a super comfortable tram stop just in front of the house to reach in few minutes Eminonu. We would choose it again!

Furkan was a great host. very responsive and helpful- from letting us leave our luggage much earlier than the check-in time to helping us get to the airport by booking us a private taxi to the airport at 4 in the morning. The property was exactly as it looked in the photos and description, location was really good- close to public transport, restaurants/ cafes and in a beautiful neighborhood. We had a lovely carefree three days at his property!

The apartment is located pretty much in the heart of Balat, it's extremely beautiful with lots to do in the surrounding area. The location itself has great connections to pretty much anywhere in the city. The apartment itself is exactly as showcased in the pictures, very clean and definitely worth the prices. Most importantly it has a very pretty view! Would highly recommend and would stay here again if I can back to the area!

We really enjoyed the place. It has a great terrace with an awesome view, it is very well equipped, super close to balat neighborhood and lots of restaurants and cafes. The place was super comfortable, everything was specially clean and the communication with Furkan was smooth. Thank you!

If i go again i will choose this apartment. Host is very kind and attentive to his guests.

Kadir is a great host responsive polite and helpful. He helped carry our suitcase up three flights of stairs and back down. A charming apartment quaint and had air conditioning! Loved everything about the place and the area. Everything is super accessible you're embedded in a local neighborhood which was delightful. The one issue we experienced was the shower area there was leakage of water. Kader was going to get that fixed after we left. He did ask if that timeline was ok and we agreed.

Kadir's 300-year-old apartment is full of light and charm. It is up two steep flights of stairs, but Kadir was there to meet us and carry our luggage upstairs, and he was kind enough to come and carry our luggage back downstairs when it was time to leave. He also allowed us to use the apartment for an extra couple of hours since he didn't have another guest coming in that day. As others have noted, Kadir is very friendly and responsive. We had a problem with the front door and he had the lock changed the following day. We also had a problem with the toilet that he fixed the following day. There was an issue with water leaking out of the shower which he was not able to fix with us using the apartment, but I'm sure he will work on that when it is between guests. We found the apartment to be nice and quiet, and the air conditioning worked very well. As for the neighborhood, we loved Balat! We spent 4.5 days going all over Istanbul, and it was by far our favorite locale.

This apartment is exactly as pictured, full of light and very cozy. I felt right at home. Kadir was very helpful and responsive, going above and beyond to make my stay easy and comfortable. The building is old, but well maintained and full of personality.
The location is also amazing, near many coffee shops and restaurants, as well as shopping and public transportation. Balat is a charming and colorful neighborhood, with a rich history.
I highly recommend this apartment and will stay here again! Thank you, Kadir, for all your help!

Kadir very good host & very supportive and he helped us with luggage upon arrival and at departure early morning. The apartment same as photos, cozy place, surrounded by nice coffee shops & restaurants, near tram station and bus station. Very safe area. The points we faced the apartment during night only lights was low but I didn’t tell Kadir as we stayed most of the day outside but while leaving the house Kadir promised to change the lights.

description: İt is a hotel room included breakfast in the lobby there is a free cofee tea service whenever you want the hotel is really good as a location and in a safe street you can also use the kitchen if you want to cook or prepare something

reviews.text: Super great and safe location- it was right in front of a police station! It‘s right at Taksim Square,but at the same time you feel safe being around policemen. The room itself was clean and the breakfast was delicious and nutritional. The receptionist was very kind and helpful, I really appreciated his help.

Not good at all, dont waste your money for it, we left earlier. Smell mixed with cigarettes and toilet. The room we get was not from the photos. The bathroom has rust and it feels so dirty. We wanted to try to stay but we didnt. Not recommend.

Central location, clean and with a kind welcoming. Totally deserved for the price that we paid.
The place was definitely worth the money i paid. It’s very close to taksim street. The staff were helpful too

description: Enjoy easy access to everything from this place in a perfect location.

reviews.text: musa's place was very good for the price, the bed was a bit uncomfortable but overall the experience was good. Also the place is very near to taksim square.

Very good location, close to taksim square.

Recommended
Amazing deal for the price! Great amenities, very clean, and great location within a 10 minute walk of Taksim Square!
Musa is a very friendly host, always ready to help and answer your questions. The place is basic and has everything you need for a cheaper price.
Cozy stay near Taksim Mosque with friendly staff and convenient location. Slight noise from the street, but overall a pleasant experience.

description:
Our flat is pretty quiet and peaceful, although it is in the heart of Galata. The flat is just a few steps away from Galata Tower and Karaköy.

The flat designed to provide all your needs. If you want, you can work from home with high-speed internet or cook for dinner or read a book peacefully in silence with high consantration.

Out of the building, there are a lot of boutique cafes to eat something and a lot of local market for shooping

reviews.text: I had an amazing experience staying at this Airbnb! The house was exactly as described – spacious, clean, and beautifully decorated. The hosts were incredibly welcoming and made sure we had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect, with easy access to local attractions, restaurants, and public transport. The kitchen was fully equipped, making it easy to cook meals, and the living area was cozy and inviting. We truly felt at home here and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a relaxing getaway. Can’t wait to return!

We really liked the apartment! Communication with the host was easy. The instructions are clear and understandable. We were given information about nearby places in advance, which is very prudent. Clean, tidy, there were enough appliances in the kitchen, a comfortable bed. Thank you for leaving the water for us. We were a little worried that it would be cold, but the apartment was very warm! And the owner even provides an additional heater in case of a cold snap. The apartment is quiet, peaceful and safe. Thank you so much for your hospitality!

A lovely little apartment! It is only around 3 minutes walk away from the metro exit. And from the metro station to the apartment is rather a smooth walk compared with other hilly parts of this area. Note it’s located on the 4th floor without elevator and the stairs are quite steep and narrow. Make sure you aren’t physically available for that.
The apartment is very bright during daytime but the light is not sufficient during night time. The lamps on the desks and the night stand has been removed, making it difficult to work during night time. The host said will consider adding more lights though.The wifi is rather stable compared with other airbnb I stayed in Turkey. The host is quick to respond and offer an early checkin which is much appreciated.
A big plus is that the windows are very soundproof which is great for light sleeper like me. Overall highly recommended!

Staying in this historic apartment was a truly special experience. The architecture and interior details reflect the charm and character of old Istanbul, yet, everything was clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully prepared. The location is fantastic-walking distance to many cultural sites, cozy cafes, and local shops. Our hosts were vey kind responsive, and made sure we had everything we needed. If you´re looking for a place with soul and history, this is it. Highly recommended!

Amazing apartment in a perfect location, close to both the metro and funicular! So easy to get back after a long day of exploring. The host went above and beyond by leaving the AC on and cold water in the fridge before check-in, an absolute lifesaver during the heat wave. Highly recommend!

description:
Located in the heart of the historical peninsula, in a central and safe location, our comfortable studio is ideal for 2 people.

Our room has a comfortable double bed and a fully equipped private kitchen. It offers home comfort for short or long stays.

It is within walking distance of the Little Hagia Sophia Mosque, Hagia Sophia and the Sultanahmet Mosque.

✔️ Double bed
✔️ Private kitchen
✔️ Air conditioning & heating
✔️ Free Wi-Fi
✔️ Central location

Perfect choice for guests wanting to explore Istanbul on foot.

reviews.text: The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, making check-in easy. Excellent location and good value for money.

I had an amazing stay in Fatih! The host was absolutely outstanding—kind, responsive, and very professional throughout my stay. The apartment was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, and in a perfect location close to everything you need.
What really stood out to me was the host’s honesty and flexibility. I had accidentally booked extra days that I didn’t need, and when I requested a cancellation for those dates, they handled it with understanding and refunded me without any issues. That level of trust and customer care is rare and truly appreciated.
I felt very welcomed and well taken care of from start to finish. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul, and I would happily stay here again in the future

Tuncay is a great host. I arrived very late, but a caretaker living in the building checked us in as soon as we got there. For areas like Fatih and Sultanahmet, this property is a fantastic option. I selected it based on two main criteria: price and accessibility. The surrounding area is extremely hilly, which makes navigating with luggage difficult for tourists, and taxis are expensive. However, this residence is very easy to reach, with no elevation to climb and close proximity to the main road.
​The room matched the description, though it felt more spacious in the photos for two people. Additionally, the stairs are quite narrow. Fortunately, my room was on the first floor, and the caretaker helped us carry our bags. Overall, I highly recommend this place for its accessibility, affordable price, and a wonderfully communicative host who replies instantly.

We had a good stay at this apartment. The place was clean and matched the description. It was comfortable for our visit and had everything we needed.
The host was polite and responsive when we had questions, and communication was easy. Check-in and check-out were also smooth.
Overall, it was a decent experience and met our expectations. Thank you for the stay.
Overall a good stay. The apartment was clean and comfortable, and the host was responsive and helpful.

We loved our stay in this charming apartment above Soil Coffee & Dessert Café in the heart of Balat—walking distance to excellent restaurants, cafes, and beautiful mosques. The host was helpful and responsive; Ozzie, the friendly café manager, welcomed us early after a redeye. The neighborhood is full of color and character, and in the evenings we enjoyed opening the balcony doors to hear the sounds below: chatter, clinking dishes, music. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well laid out. The main bedroom stayed cool with AC (note: the second bedroom does not have AC, as stated). The bathroom was clean and functioned well; ventilation could be stronger, but it wasn’t an issue. The location is easy to navigate—steps from the water and close to tram and ferry stops. We often walked to the Sultanahmet and Karaköy/Galata areas. On our last day, the host generously allowed a late checkout to accommodate our evening flight. We’d gladly return and recommend Soil Balat to others!

This was the best Airbnb experience my husband and I have ever had. Ali and all of the employees at Soil Cafe (which is directly below the Airbnb) went out of their way to make sure that our stay was fantastic. They went above and beyond, were proactive and extremely generous the entire time we were there. We feel like we have an extended family in Istanbul now. The house was very clean and had all of the comforts we like. A drip coffee maker, a blow dryer, blackout shades, comfortable beds, great water pressure, and really high ceilings. The are is very lively and is walkable to all public transportation. We will stay here again the next time we are in Istanbul.

Hi guys
Thank you for the wonderful stay and communication 🫶🏻 the area is absolutely perfect full of life and restaurants and shops, historical sights and buildings too and near the water ( stunning) You will not get lost here feel free to walk around the area as you wish you will easily find your way home.
Staff are friendly and the lady who works there and speaks english is a star always helpful and smiling. Their cafe is always full of life and cats 🐈‍⬛ are free to come inside that i 🥰 love. The apartment is beautiful and clean , they even suppled washing powder 🫠 i would 100% visit again . Thank you for all for ur hospitality and welcoming stay 🩷

We were over the moon with the Accomodation!
They went out of their way to ensure we could leave our luggage a little earlier and upon checkout, they helped me to store my luggage because my flight was delayed. 😊
The apartment was fabulous, squeaky clean and had a lovely little balcony where we could sit in the evenings and watch the town and surroundings.
The location is excellent, close to the bus stop and write on the main road of balat where you can have dinner and shop.
The bedroom was perfect for us as a couple and a lovely bathroom.
The host was very responsive and helpful.
I will recommend any traveler to stay here and I really enjoyed our stay here and will happily book again!

We enjoyed our stay in this cozy apartment.
Nevertheless consider 2 things:
- Going to the touristic spots will require taking the bus or tram (they are at short distance and very easy/ safe to use)
- It is a bit noisy at night because of the cafes, but also part of Istanbuls magic
Besides that : the apartment has everything you need- we specially loved the balcony at night while eating a dessert and seeing people pass by.
Comfortable bed and hot water shower.
Great restaurants around (all of them alcohol-free) and very authentic and edgy boutiques in the neighborhood.
If you are an uncomplicated traveler this is the place for you.

description: Located just 20 meters from Istiklal Avenue, this bright and spacious apartment offers the perfect stay for those who want to experience the vibrant energy of Istanbul! Surrounded by restaurants, cafes, bars, and shopping spots, it’s an excellent choice for travelers looking to explore the city.

reviews.text: We had a pleasant stay overall. The location of the apartment is great, near many restaurants and a subway station and not so far from Galata Tower. Checkin was easy and the host left clear instructions and was very nice. The apartment is pet friendly and well equipped. Air conditioning worked well. The bed was comfortable. Those were the good aspects. Now the only problems were: the apartment and the building is really old and lacks a bit of maintenance and cleaning (like there was mold on the shower walls and the apartment smelled like cigarette smoke and damp). Also, it is not very accessible, since there's a long flight of stairs before you reach the elevator. So it was a bit difficult for us to move up and down with the baby stroller and our luggage. I also don't see why we needed to take the trash out before leaving, since the dumpsters are one block away. In short, it's a nice place to stay a few days in İstanbul, but I thought it was a bit overpriced for what it offers.

I had a wonderful stay here. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great, and everything I needed was easily accessible.
Merve was an excellent host—friendly, responsive, and very helpful throughout my stay. Communication was always easy, and she made sure everything went smoothly.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area, and I would be happy to stay here again in the future. Thank you for your hospitality!

Really loved my stay at Merve’s place! ❤️ The apartment was super clean, cozy, quiet and had everything I needed, including great AC and an elevator. The location is perfect, literally 2 minutes from Taksim Square, with restaurants, cafés, bars and supermarkets all around.
Merve was lovely, always quick to respond, kind and very helpful. I felt really comfortable here and would definitely stay again next time I’m in Istanbul. Highly recommended!

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment. Everything was exactly as shown in the photos, and the place was spotless, cozy, and very comfortable. The apartment had everything I needed, and the Wi-Fi worked perfectly, which made the stay even easier.
The location is fantastic — so many great cafés, restaurants, and shops just a short walk away, and it’s super easy to get around the city from here. It really made exploring the area much more enjoyable.
The host was incredibly kind and responsive. Check-in was simple, and every question I had was answered quickly. I truly appreciated how attentive and helpful they were during my stay.
Overall, I had an excellent experience and felt very comfortable throughout my visit. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a nice place in a great location.

Good location, yes it is noisy at night, but bedroom is pretty protected and if you are not an early sleeper it is fine. Cleanliness on the sofa and kitchen were a problem, pretty smelly until another washing round. During check in the communication was fluent, towards the end my asks and requests were clearly ignored and not acted up on after hours of check out. Shower needs an update as the water is not flowing completely through. Overall ok stay.

description:
Our apartment is 2 minutes from Istiklal Street, the heart of Istanbul, 1 minute from Galata Tower, 5 minutes from the tram line to Hagia Sophia, Sultan Ahmet Mosque and Basilica Cistern, and 5-6 minutes from Galata Port. There are cafes, restaurants, antique shops, boutiques and 4 grocery stores very close to our apartment. After 8 pm, our street turns into an extremely quiet environment, allowing guests to rest comfortably.

31.01.2025/ 34-2731

reviews.text:
Excellent apartment. Strategically located. 100 meters from the Galata Tower, yet away from the crowds. Clean, quiet street. The interior is comfortable and has everything you need. We had no problems with water or heating. Very hospitable host. Thank you so much for the welcome apples❤️
Important: don't confuse the WiFi router (black box on the black dresser) with the alarm box (white box above the door)!!! Birhan, thank you again for your patience and hospitality! I'll only come to you in Istanbul❤️
Birhan was a great host and was very accommodating. The place was clean and as described and the location was great.

We had an amazing stay and would definitely come back! The apartment is beautiful—a historic home that has been thoughtfully renovated with modern finishes and new appliances while keeping its unique charm.
Birhan was a fantastic host. He was very responsive, kindly let us leave our luggage before check-in, and even provided fresh fruit, treats, and everything we needed for a comfortable stay.
The location is perfect, within walking distance of Galata Tower, Taksim, the waterfront, metro stations, and plenty of great restaurants. The apartment was spotless, and the beautiful bay view made it the perfect place to relax after exploring. We highly recommend staying here!

We came to Istanbul for our son's wedding. This historical apartment played a significant supporting role! From the very 1st exchange to the last, Birhan was warm, prompt, & exceedingly accommodating. The apartment itself was spacious, allowing our family of 4 adults to be together & apart. 2 bedrooms & 2 full bathrooms provided privacy. Air conditioning in each room made sleeping pleasant. The rooms were quiet. Everything was exceptionally clean. If I stayed again, I would pick the 2nd bedroom. I was sensitive to the moisture in the laundry room attached to the master--even with the door closed. I requested a dehumidifier specifically for the laundry room, but Birhan's suggestion to use the dehumidifier setting on the bedroom air conditioning did help some. I will never forget my week with family in this charming apartment. It was centrally located, but on a quiet stretch of road leading to the tower. The kitchen nook above the cobblestone road was an absolute GEM. I already miss it.

The Birhan's apartment was better in reality than on photos whis is rarely a thing! The stay was great. Our arrival time and instructions were very clear. Birhan answered all my questions very fast. We had all the equipment we needed. Either the kitchen stuff or bathroom. Location was awesome, close to the center or any tram/bus stations by walk. Galata surroundings was also a big plus. There however was one dowfall and thats the upsrairs neighbour. His steps at 3AM were annoying. Other than that it was flawless. Would recommend to any one! Thank you Birhan

description: Enjoy a stylish experience where you can experience peace and happiness in a central location.

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at this home. The place was exactly as described-very clean, cozy, very safe and located. The host was incredibly kind and nice communication.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Kadikoy, i would love to stay here again in the future!!

çok çok memnun kaldım. tertemizdi, konum çok merkeziydi ve aynı zamanda sessizdi. her şey düşünülmüştü, filtre kahve makinesi, kahve, havlu, terlik, saç kurutma makinesi hatta şampuan ve duş jeli bile mevcuttu. tek olumsuz yorumum odada hafif bir sigara kokusu vardı. onun dısında her sey çok güzeldi. ev sahibinin iletişimi ve tutumu da oldukça iyiydi.

Check in cok kolaydi ozellikle valizi onden birakabilmek cok avantaj sagladi. Internet hizliydi, smart tv'ye erisimde sikinti olmadi. Carsaflar, havlular ve genel anlamda ev temizdi. Mutfakta bazi yetersizlikler vardi - basit tuz karabiber yagin olmayisi, cogu tava ve tencerelerin kapaklarinin olmayisi, duzgun dograma tahtasi eksikligi gibi. Uzun sureli kalislar icin bu eksikliklerin giderilmesinin ve mikrodalga eklenmesinin onemli bir fark yaratacagini dusunuyorum. Konumu cok merkezi her yere hizlica erisilebilir. Asansor olusu ayrica cevredeki every kiyasla buyuk rahatlik sunmakta.

We had such a beautiful stay at this Airbnb in Kadıköy, Istanbul! 🥰✨ My sister and I absolutely loved our time here. The apartment was stunning, clean, comfortable and beautifully decorated, with everything we needed for a relaxing stay.
The location was fantastic and made it so easy to explore Kadıköy and experience the lovely cafés, restaurants and atmosphere of the area. We felt comfortable and at home from the moment we arrived.
The host was wonderful, helpful and accommodating, which made our stay even more enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again when visiting Istanbul and highly recommend this beautiful Airbnb to anyone looking for a comfortable and stylish place to stay in Kadıköy. ♥️🇹🇷

Ev birebir aynı şekilde görsellerde göründüğü gibiydi. Konumu merkezi ve alışveriş yerlerine, restoranlara birkaç dakikalık yürüme mesafesindeydi. Toplu taşımaların bir çoğuna kolay erişim olduğu için bu bölgeyi tercih ettik ve ulaşım açısından çok rahattık. Hem metrobüse, hem vapura, hem metroya kolaylıkla erişim mevcut. Ev sahibi giriş konusunda esnek ve anlayışlıydı. Biz çok memnun kaldık.

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text: Hamid was a really friendly host who was always responsive if we needed anything. The location is great, close to some tourist attractions and bus stop. Although I will say it is a very steep hill you need to climb to get there! Some comments mention it is perhaps an unsafe area but I’d say it’s just more local, you have children playing in the streets and plenty of people walking around. The apartment had everything you could need; fridge, stove top, hot water, heating etc. Maybe just some bowls would have been good. Apartment was clean, bedsheets have some small holes but you could tell they were washed. Overall for the price you pay it is a great deal for Istanbul and we would definitely stay again!

Hamid was very welcoming and helpful. He was always available and responded quickly to any request. He kindly arranged a housekeeper to help with laundry without any issues. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The location is excellent and very close to major tourist attractions. I had a great stay and would definitely recommend this place.”
The place was so dirty and the area is not in Beyoğlu. The smell also was really bad. The neighborhood is scary and not safe. Don’t book it just cause its cheap.

Hamid bey esnek giriş ve temiz çarşaf yastık kılıfı talebimizi hızlıca temin etti. semtle ilgili Taksim'e yakın olması avantaj fakat bazı yorumlarda ses gürültü hakkinda şikayetler olmuş normal belli bir saate kadar mahalle sakinleri dışarda oluyor ama güvenlik konusunda endişe yaratmıyor, temizlik olarak tabiki 5 yıldızlı otel temizliği beklemeyin sağolsun temiz çarşaf talebim oldu hemen cevaplayın yerine getirdi genel olarak memnun ayrıldık.

Booked the apartment for 10 days. The price was wondeful and it had AC, just like we needed. Everything in the apartment suits the description and Hamid is a welcoming host always in contact and ready to help or answer questions. I would recommend this apartment for a short stay. For a longer stay, I'd recommend the the other apartment from Hamid with a washing machine, it's only a bit more expensive.
In the area there are good restaurants, shops, pharmacies and baklava sellers, everything you'd need in your trip to Istanbul.

description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.

reviews.text:
Thank you again for hosting me. I wanted to share some honest feedback after trying the apartment.
While the photos look great, I didn’t feel it was suitable for a longer stay. The heating was extremely strong when I arrived and it took time to regulate the temperature. There is also noticeable noise from the upper floor, especially when furniture is moved.
Another important point for me was the cleaning products used on the linens and towels. I have sensitive skin and the detergents seem quite strong, which caused irritation. It might be helpful to consider milder or hypoallergenic products in the future.
That said, I would like to mention that the reception staff, especially the lady working there, was amazing and very helpful throughout my stay. Her attitude and support were truly appreciated.
Overall, I realised it wasn’t the right fit for me long term, so I decided to move on. I appreciate your effort and wish you the best with future guests.
Thank you again.

Overall impression is great - people were nice, our stay was great, the apartment was clean and it was close to the Main Street.
The only downside was the noise - the walls are quite thin, so you can easily hear others. That said, it seemed we had particularly noisy neighbours, including a crying child, which is understandable and not something anyone can really control.
Otherwise, the stay was great and would probably choose it again. :)
Fazlasıyla memnun kaldık gayet iyi bir işletme evler tertemiz yeni.
