Ev son derece temizdi ve guzeldi. Yeri bulmakta biraz zorlandim. Giris icin depozita isteniyormus ve ben uygulama kullanmadigim icin web kisminda boyle bir ibare gormedim. Bu konuda baslangicta sorun yasadim ama otel sahibi sagolsun kabul etti bir seferlik. Keske bu ibare daha net bir sekilde yer alsaydi ilan sayfasinda.
Giris saatinden once gelmemiz gerekti yardimci oldular. Memnun kaldik. Tesekkur ederiz.

description:
A stylish and comfortable studio apartment located in a historic building in the heart of Beyoğlu. The apartment features a comfortable bed, private bathroom, kitchen, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and other essential amenities.Its central location offers easy access to Istiklal Street, Galata Tower and Karaköy, making it an ideal choice for exploring Istanbul. The building also features a lobby for guests.
Important: For security reasons, we cannot accommodate guests without a confirmed reservation.

reviews.text:
What a gorgeous apartment in a very old building, so tastefully restored. Spotlessly clean, nice and warm, equipped kitchen and close to supermarket. Plenty of restaurants and Turkish fast food within 10 minutes walk.
Be aware the area has steep narrow streets, and the apartment is on the 1st floor with no lift, so not ideal for anyone with mobility problems. But the host is very helpful and responsive, even arranged airport transfer at good price. Highly recommended stay

We had a great stay in Istanbul. The host was friendly, communicative and responsive. The place was easy to find but the neighbourhood did not leave a great impression.
Pros: Easy walkable access to Istiklal street. There were small markets nearby and bus station too. Clear instructions given before check-in and the place felt like home too.
Cons: There were some host-unrelated issues that were solved fast - internet failure the night of arrival (next morning it was fixed), the electricity failure one evening (returned the same night), dirty towel (changed immediately per request). The room was small and not enough amenities to cook but for short stays I don't think cooking would be an option anyways.
Thanks to our host for offering such a positive and helpful atmosphere.

The apartment is conveniently located in the city center of Istanbul, close to a great variety of shops and restaurants.
It's clean and well equipped, very comfortable even in its reduced size.
The host is very kind and responsive.
I would definitely reconsider it for my next time in Istanbul!!

The host here was wonderful! Very helpful, friendly, and responsive - he helped me carry my luggage up and down the stairs, offered tea and water, and also booked a taxi to the airport for me. Location is convenient if you need access to public transit and Pera. I would stay here again.

I just stayed at Cetin Armel homes and i truly reccomend it!
He s súper Nice Host and súper friendly person, he s always in the surroundings if You need he s help, first night i he help me out ordering My dinner, always reply to My messages if i need help, the building Is very secure as there are cameras inside all around the lobby, the pictures Match perfectly the description, i couldnt ask more , i had a great holidays in Istanbul also the área Is great as You re very central , Taksim square and iskilial You can reach it walking less than 10 minutes and many restaurants choices , much cheaper than the ones in Taksim Square
🩷
I Will 100 percent come back here again 😊
Thanks Cetin for your Hospitality 🩷🩷🩷

description: This spacious apartment within walking distance of Taksim Square is very close to metro and bus stops. It can comfortably accommodate 4 people thanks to a double bedroom and a large living area equipped with fold-out armchairs. The fully equipped kitchen has a washing machine, refrigerator and air conditioning. It offers a comfortable, central and home-like experience.

reviews.text:
We stay for a week, me, my wife & our son. Everything is beyond our expectations. Surreya and her husband is very helpful, their restaurant below have a delicious food. The privacy also very good, even we did not know there were another guest in the place.
All the facilities can be use, sometimes we cooked our own breakfast in the kitchen, we also used the washing machine for our clothes. The shower also have hot water. There were one day in the morning the water heater not working, after we informed, Surreya's husband directly repaired it.
We recommend this place especially for family. The price also reasonable, since it s very close to Taksim Square and the public transportation station to another Istanbul's area.
We hope all the blessed & happiness for Surreya and her family. Hopefully we can visit again, and meet little cute Denize 😊

Kaldığımız konut genel olarak bir aile için uygun değildi. Ev sahibinin iletişimi iyiydi. Elektrik kesintisi ortamın çok sesli olması özellikle geceleri rahat uyumaz engelde. Evin içindeki eşyaların aşırı kullanımından ötürü çok kötü durumda olduğunu söyleyebilirim. Evin tadilata ihtiyaç olduğunu da söyleyebilirim. Banyoda tuvalet suyuna bastığımızda suyun yerlere akması ve duş kabinin genel olarak tadilata ihtiyaç duyduğunu söyleyebilirim. Burada bulunmamızın tek sebebi taksim’e yakın olma isteyişimizdir. Bunun aksine bir daha buraya gelir miyim zannetmiyorum. Şayet dışarıda kalacak olursam tabii ki de burayı tercih ederim. Süreyya hanımın sorularıma hızlı bir şekilde yanıt vermesini bu yorumumda ön plana çıkarabilirim. Kendisi iyi bir ev sahibi olduğunu söyleyebilir fakat evin genel bir tadilata ihtiyacı olduğunu iletiyorum kendisine.

A clean but very simple budget apartment where the space could have been used more efficiently. That said, the hosts are extremely welcoming, and their restaurant on the ground floor is excellent.
The neighborhood itself is interesting to explore. It used to be somewhat neglected, but it’s clearly on a path of development now, with many restaurants, hotels, Airbnbs, unique architecture, and a strong sense of character and spirit. You can really feel the area evolving and improving, and this Airbnb is becoming better and better as part of that process.

öncelikle ev mangal/kızartma dükkanının üstünde kalıyor o yüzden aşırı kötü bir koku hakim. is kokusu bütün kıyafetlerinize siniyor. açıkçası zehirlenmekten korktuk ancak başka şansımız olmadığı için çıkamadık. evdeki eşyalar eski. ocak ın 4 bölmesinden sadece 2 si çalışmıyor. çıkmamızdan 1 gün önce ev sahibi aradı ve eve girilmesi gerektiğini söyledi. biz ise istemedik ki o gün alt katta inşaat vardı ve bize bunun haberi hiç verilmemişti. sabah 10 dan akşam 10 a kadar inşaat sesi duymak zorunda kaldık. eve girilmesini istemediğimizde ev sahibi bize istesek girebilirdik anahtar var tarzı bi ithamda bulundu. biz bundan çok rahatsız olduk. sonrasında özür diledi ancak eve girilip girilmediği konusunda bu olaydan sonra ev sahibine güvenemedik. kesinlikle bu kadar yüksek puanı hakeden bir yer değil. tek artısı konumu. aksi takdirde kesinlikle burayı tercih etmeyin. kokusu durulabilcek gibi değil asla camları açamadık. zorunda kalmadıkça burda kalmayın.

description: Located right behind Istanbul's famous Galata Tower this apartment offers amazing views and a comfortable stay. It has a Large apartment with stunning Bosphorus & the old city views. The apartment is 5 mins to tram, metro, bus and ferry stations.This tastefully decorated place has 4 seperate bedrooms and can accomodate up to 10 people. You can access almost all major tourist attractions and sites by walk from the apartment. There are plenty of nice restaurants,bars and cafes around.

reviews.text:
As first-time visitors to Istanbul traveling with three kids, we couldn’t have chosen a better place to stay. Gökçe and Emre were amazing hosts, friendly, responsive, and genuinely focused on their guests’ comfort from the moment we booked.
The apartment was spacious, comfortable, and perfect for our family of six, with three large bedrooms, an elevator, a fully equipped kitchen, and a washer and dryer. The daily bottled water delivery was such a thoughtful touch!
Honestly the location in Beyoğlu was fantastic, close to the Galata Tower, public transportation, restaurants, shops, and many of Istanbul’s top attractions, making it easy and affordable to explore the city with kids.
Most of all, we appreciated how cared for we felt throughout our stay. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to families visiting Istanbul. Thank you for helping make our first trip to Istanbul so memorable! 🇹🇷❤️

Pros: The Airbnb was very neat, super helpful to have an elevator, had the amenities we needed, and an easy way to get into the building. The hosts were great, responsive and accommodating. The inside was very artsy, had a great view to the waters and mosque. Felt homey inside.
Cons: It is on a street that had many hardware stores all around and the entrance can be missed easily, but we had someone greet us and bring us in. Bathrooms are on the smaller side, but were clean.

We had a wonderful three-week stay and loved the spacious rooms, beautiful Bosphorus views, and great location. The host added thoughtful touches, including toys for our toddler, and provided two free cleanings with fresh sheets during our stay. Everything was spotless, communication was quick, and overall this was a true five-star experience. We’d gladly re-book if we return to Istanbul!
Pros:
• Grocery stores nearby (Migros Jet, Şok, Carrefour, Show Market)
• Walking distance to Galataport, Karaköy, Spice Market, and Galata Tower
• Easy access to Sultanahmet (tram or ~40-min walk)
• Magnificent views and great host communication
• Central hub for all public transport (bus, tram, ferry, metro)
Cons (minor):
• Small elevator (fits 3) and it opens directly into the apartment
• Once had a brief city-wide power outage which requires us to take 5 flights of stairs

The views from this property were spectacular. While the property entrance might feel a bit awkward initially…the shop keepers are extremely friendly and helpful, we felt embraced by the culture of the neighborhood. Felt quite safe walking at night. Beds were very comfortable, rooms were spacious and bright.

Fantastic location. Literally can’t find a better place to stay in terms of getting places anywhere to Istanbul. We went everywhere with ease. No traffic. Golce and Emre were so responsive to anything we needed. Walkable to Ferry. Walkable to Tram. Very spacious. The call to prayers in the morning provided an authentic experience. The elevator was so helpful. Recommend this place to families. Very safe.

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: Hotel was clean very close to sabiha airport 10-12 min away , rooms was clean no air condition as described, toilet is very very small u can’t sit on it maybe for kids not adult . Reception was helpful and kind .

oda temizdi yatak rahattı..fakat göründüğünden çok daha küçüktü.oda kapılarının altı 3 parmak açıktı ve dolayısı ile koridordaki tüm ses odanın içindeydi.hava alanına uzak değil ama yakında değil..marmaray hattı 10 dk yürüme mesafesinde..tam olarak istediğim konumda değildi ama fiyatına göre iyidi..
Host was helpful and proactive with communicating everything. Room was clean, and all amenities were there. The only problem was noise, because it was close to the road and smoke smell in corridor.
The place is great and host is very accommodating however the rooms smelled of cigarettes including the bedding. I think they could improve upon that the rest was all great and amazing.

After walking the highway I entered to a mildly rude concierge who initially gave me keys to a very dirty room and only switched me after I complained. I don’t know if this was a genuine error, but either they gave me keys to a random persons room or didn’t clean at all. The new room had an odor but appeared pre-cleaned. Advertised as right next to airport but still about 20-25min during traffic (much of the day in Istanbul).

description: Comfortable double room in central Laleli, Istanbul, with a private bathroom, TV, air conditioning and free Wi-Fi. Daily housekeeping is provided. Our 24-hour reception is always ready to assist with check-in, transportation and local information. The building has an elevator. Easy access to Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar and Eminönü.

reviews.text:
The place is quite beautiful, very clean, tidy, and comfortable. Although it is on the smaller side, it was well maintained and had everything we needed for a pleasant stay. There are several restaurants nearby, which was very convenient, and the check-in process was smooth and easy.
We really appreciated being offered the option of an extended stay after checkout, which was very thoughtful and helpful. The only minor downside is that the bathroom is quite small. We also experienced a small issue where hot and cold water were mixing for a short time. We tried to resolve it ourselves, and the host assured us it would be fixed, but we didn’t have enough time to address it fully during our stay.
Overall, it was a very good experience, and I would definitely recommend this place to others.

Here in the Balkans they say that if the whole world were one country, Istanbul would be the capital. Fascinating city. Clean, tidy, phenomenally organized. Istanbul looks rich. The best food on the planet. As for the hotel, it is in the strict center, very close to the most important points in the city (Kapali Bazaar, Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Suleymaniye...). The hotel is completely renovated and super tidy. Everything is very clean and everything shines like a diamond. What the pictures are, is what it is in reality. The elevator is modern,. Otherwise, hotels in Istanbul are cheap compared to accommodation in our country. I do the same job because I rent out an apartment in Belgrade. I know very well how hard this is, even though it seems very easy to everyone.

Giriş işlemim hızlı ve kolay oldu. imkanlar güzeldi, oda temizdi, yeterliydi ve ihtiyaç olabilecek şeyler de sağlanmıştı. etraf ve sokaklar geceleri sessizdi yani dinlenmek için çok iyiydi, kimse sizi rahatsız etmiyor. ara sıra yan odalardan sesler geliyordu fakat bu otellerde normal bir şey. konum itibariyle merkezi bir yerde, yürüyerek pek çok tarihi yere gidilebiliyor, tramvay yakın, marmaray ve metro da en fazla 15 dakikalık yürüme mesafesindeydi. sokaklar ve yollar bazen yokuş bazen dar ama sultanahmet için normal bir şey. kahvaltı etme fırsatımız olmadı ama fiyat olarak uygundu ve edilebilir.
bir ihtiyacımız ve isteğimiz olduğunda personeller ilgilendiler, iletişim güzeldi. genel olarak otelden ve hizmetten memnun kaldık. tekrar tercih etmeyi düşünüyoruz.
Hotel was great. Clean with an amazing shower and a kettle. Really well located with everything close. Toprak was also really helpful and kind. Thank you
My stay in Istanbul was lovely the place was clean, comfortable, and well-kept. The location was convenient, and everything was exactly as described. A pleasant and hassle-free experience overall.

description:
The modern apartment with an architectural design is located in Beşiktaş, one of the liveliest areas of Istanbul, within walking distance to the coast. You can also easily reach Taksim, Ortaköy, Bebek and Karaköy.

With 24/7 transportation, you can reach anywhere in Istanbul, from shopping to entertainment, from coastal walks on the Bosphorus to places with Bosphorus views, you can reach many social areas in minutes

I offer a pleasant experience with 24/7 support and helpful services while staying at home

reviews.text:
The apartment is compact but clean and has all the basic amenities and appliances (washing machine, dishwasher, iron, hair dryer, microwave, stove, refrigerator, and kitchenware). The location is very good, with many cafes, shops and pharmacies nearby. Dolmabahçe and Ihlamur Park are about a 10-minute walk away.
Despite the busy street below the windows, we did not experience much noise at night. There was some noise from a nearby cafe, but only in the living room and only weekends.
The host replies quickly and was very friendly and helpful. He fixed the shower issue during the day, even during the holidays, which we really appreciated.
The only downside is that there is no elevator. If you are traveling with a stroller or large suitcase, you need to go up to the 3rd floor using a spiral staircase. However, neighbors kindly helped me carry the stroller.
Overall, we had a very pleasant stay. Thank you!

We had a lovely stay in Istanbul. The location was perfect - surrounded by so many cafes and restaurants that the hardest part was deciding where to eat. Everything we needed was close by including supermarkets, pharmacies and shopping, and it was an easy walk to the Bosphorus and Ortaköy.
The apartment was very clean and exactly as it appeared in the photos. We also really appreciated being able to leave our luggage at the apartment before check-in as we arrived early.
The host was very quick to reply, accommodating and easy to communicate with throughout our stay.
There are 3 flights of stairs, so something to be aware of, and there was some street noise from below, but overall it was a great stay in an excellent location.

We really enjoyed our trip! The apartment was exactly as described on Airbnb—clean, comfortable, and very safe. The location in Beşiktaş was amazing; it's a great, walkable neighborhood with a fantastic vibe.
Fatih was a wonderful host who provided super clear check-in instructions, making access seamless and stress-free.
Would definitely recommend staying here to anyone visiting Istanbul, and we’d love to stay again!

The location can’t be beat. It was clean, comfortable and close to transportation and the waterfront. There are lots of cafes and restaurants so close which was really nice. Quaint street but it does get noisy at night. But overall, we would definitely stay there again. The hosts were super responsive and helpful from before we got there to after we left.

The apartment was as described, and the host was kind and welcoming. It is very centrally located, with many restaurants and cafés nearby. The area is lively, so some noise in the evening should be expected. The apartment is therefore a good fit for people who do not mind staying in a vibrant, urban neighborhood.

description:
If you are looking to enjoy a luxurious stay in the heart of Istanbul then this is your place!
A cozy and luxurious apartment, naturally lighted, with an amazing view from the bedroom.
The apartment is a perfect place for couples or a small family of 3 and it's exactly walking distance from 212 outlet mall !

reviews.text: Im stayed for two week it was amazing stay in this appartment every thing new ,clean and matched with photos, calm and quiet it has good security,the location is very suitable near many resturants ,cafe and shopping center. communication with host very flexible and responsive and very soft check in.

Great apartment as described. Very close to Metro. Close to grocery stores and easy delivery. WiFi was fast and reliable.
The place is clean and comfortable. Would definitely stay again.

overall a great experience and highly recommend.

description: Enjoy a modern stay in Beyoğlu — close to Taksim! This stylish apartment offers two bedrooms, living room, kitchen, and two bathrooms. There is central heating and seasonal AC (May–Oct). The building has elevators, 24/7 security, a café, and paid social facilities (gym, pool, and sauna). Starbucks and Sheraton City Center Hotel are next door, and you can find us easily by searching “Safezone Homes” on Google Maps 🌿

reviews.text:
As a group who spent most of the day roaming istanbul, the apartment was just about what we needed, very welcoming and had all the essentials including a well-equipped kitchen, bathroom, and laundry facilities, it is perfect for a clean and comfortable stay.
The host was also very attentive and helpful with any extra needs during our stay and a delayed check-out.
The building entrance felt secure, and the location was about a 30-minute walk (the classic Istanbul walk 😊) from multiple tourist areas.

Adam was an amazing host! The apartment was super clean, comfortable, and exactly like the photos. The location was perfect and everything we needed was nearby. Adam was very friendly, responsive, and made the whole stay smooth and easy. I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting. Thank you for the great experience!

Great place for a group stay! There were four of us for the weekend - everything went smoothly.
A special shoutout to our host: he was very accommodating and adjusted both check-in and check-out times to fit our flight schedule, which made a huge difference. The check-in process was seamless, the apartment was exactly as described. Great location too - Taksim Square is about a 20-minute walk away. Highly recommend!
Great apartment, great location and great host. Thank you.
Very good place , clean . Free parking .. all are ok

description: Our family place is perfectly located in the Old City of Istanbul on one of the nicest and colorful street of Sultanahmet. You will feel at your home in our small street. You should be ready to taste the home made real Turkish traditional food.

reviews.text:
Hotel Buhara is accurately described as a guesthouse and it had that relaxed, friendly feel. The solo traveller room was basic but had a hugely comfy bed and aircon. The bathroom was basic but very clean. Ozlem and his staff are warm and helpful and took my medium sized bag up the stairs (spiral style but enclosed and you get used to them). Be aware that the stairs up to the rooftop terrace verge on being a ladder but there is an alternative route (down, then up, if wary). The terrific breakfast and stunning view make it worthwhile.
But what’s best is the location - walking distance to all the ‘biggies’ (Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapi) and to tram straight to ferries etc . While central, it is a lovely, quiet side street. - Another big plus.
Note: no space for a fridge, kettle or chair in room but at this great price, in this location, that’s fine.

Ozlem’s place was the perfect lodging for a solo traveler like me.
First of all, the staff is top notch for their personal attention (Gelkhar, Hussam, Asli, the lady who serves breakfast, the cleaning lady). They are so sweet, helpful and caring. Ozlem’s parents who run the coffee shop next door are so charming and friendly.
I am a budget traveler so Ozlem’s place is an excellent value without sacrificing comfort. The location can’t be beat. Even if the Blue Mosque, Aya Sofiya, Topkapi and Arasta Bazaar are within minutes of walking, the lodging is in a quiet street. After a full day of running around, I just fall asleep like a baby at night.
My room, although small, was very clean and well-serviced. The breakfast was very generous and had a great view from the terrace. I think Ozlem’s place is the best value around.
Please note if you have mobility issues to ask for a room on the lower floor since the stairs are a little steep.

I had some difficulty getting in contact with them at the beginning of the stay because of Airbnb messages not being accepted on their end so arriving in Turkey was a bit difficult because I requested airport pick-up but it wasn't arranged successfully so I unfortunately waited a bit for no one. But if you use public transportation from the airport it isn't too expensive (airport bus to city center and then either tram + walking or taxi to the hotel).
Also note this is a hotel, the rooms are located on each floor and the staircases are very small and spiral so I wouldn't suggest this place for someone with mobility issues.
Rooms and bathrooms are pretty small. Beds & linens are clean but not much space for storing luggage or anything else really. Beds are comfy but pillows are rather small for my liking.
Breakfast was plentiful daily and they changed it up every few days.
The guy working always greeted me and was super helpful. Even when I woke him up at 1:30 to be let in.

Positives: fantastic communication with the host, super friendly and helpful staff, great location, close to public transport, Blue Mosque, and many other sites, clean, value for money. Negatives: walls were paper thin and (no fault of the host) other guests were not considerate about noise and could be heard clearly well after midnight. Even ear plugs couldn't keep out the noise. Bed wasn't the most comfortable.

A lovely, cozy and a welcoming warm place to stay in Istanbul. Ozlem and her family - brother and her mom are very helpful in all our communications during and after the stay. This is a very warm and welcoming family who I wish to keep in touch my next visits. I wish I could stay here longer at this family run hotel. The room was clean and well maintained with good heating. It is surely walking distance to main areas around in the neighborhood. I wish to come back again soon to visit Istanbul and stay here. I surely recommend anyone visiting Istanbul to stay here.

description:
Bright roof duplex for groups and families!
You'll find a daybed and a comfortable folding couch at the apartment's entrance floor.
From open staircase you reach to the top bedroom floor with its private bathroom, and a queen size bed.
There are two bathrooms in this spacious apartment.
Our roof duplex includes washing machine, dishwasher and a microwave.
You'll have all utensils for cook and dine.
Big screen smart TV with NETFLIX
There is a capacity for extra bed or babycots in this suite.

reviews.text: Ahmet’s place was very comfortable and he was very helpful. He even let us keep our luggage in his office after we checked out. The place was clean and as described 5 mins walking distance from Taksim square. Highly recommend.

Şehir dışı birçok yerde kaldım, gerçekten temizlik konusunda şuana kadar kaldığım en iyi yer, yapmış olduğum konaklamada evden dışarı genel ihtiyaçlar dışında çıkmadığımdan ötürü evdeki imkanları tamamiyle kullanma konusunda epey bir fırsatım oldu, mutfakta bizim için bırakılan araç gereçler fazlasıyla yeterliydi, kesinlikle yemek yapıp birşeyler tüketmek istediğinizde herhangi bir sorun yaşamıyorsunuz, yatak odasının üst katta oluşu ve salonun mutfak ile birlikte alt katta konumlandırılmış olması ferah hissetirdi, aynı zamanda 2 banyo avantajı cabası, çok hızlı ve sorunsuz giriş ve çıkış sağladık, bizi karşılayan beyefendinin karşılama uslübu oldukça kibar ve içtendi, konaklama sürecimde herhangi bir gürültü teşkil edicek dış faktör, su kesintisi, elektrik arızası, ısıtma ile ilgili bir problem yaşamadım, çevre imkanları olarak kapıdan çıkar çıkmaz bir semt marketi ile karşılaşıyor 250-300 mt yürüme ile diğer tüm ihtiyaçlarınızı giderebiliyorsunuz, biz çok memnun kaldık, sorunsuz ve mükemmel bir deneyim oldu, Istanbul'da kalacak bir yere ihtiyaç duyduğumda kesinlikle rezerve edeceğim tek yer, teşekkür ederiz.

Ahmet’s place is right in Taksim area, close to nightlife and shopping. The place is very clean, big enough to accomodate 4 people. The upstairs bedroom tough doesn’t have a door so basically it’s one big room with upstairs.
Great furniture, stilish, sparklinh clean. Easy process at the reception.
Totally worth it!

Very nice location but need to climb too many stairs and space is just enough for a family of four and as we were two couples space was always a problem. A sofa bed was not opening but a folding bed was provided by host and it further reduced space in the flat. Otherwise close by to Taksim square and everything available in close proximity.

The building offers all the benefits of staying in Taksim without the noise of other similarly-priced locations. The staff were very friendly and helpful, and quick to respond to our needs. The apartment offered everything we needed and we enjoyed our stay.

description:
🌟 Welcome to this modern and stylish 2 Bedroom Apartment located in Maslak Sarıyer, within the prestigious Maslak 1453 Complex.

The apartment offers a spacious living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and access to on-site facilities including a gym, sauna, and steam room.

🧹Daily complimentary housekeeping service is included for your comfort.
(For +28 Nights Long Stays: Housekeeping service is included twice weekly.)

✨ We look forward to hosting you and wish you a pleasant stay!

reviews.text: Excellent stay. Clean and as described. Location is practical. Malls are near by and plenty of cafes and restaurants are around. Checkin process was very smooth and the communication is easy and quick.

Had a wonderful stay here! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was incredibly welcoming and communication was seamless. Would definitely recommend and stay here again!

5 star stay BUT… the air conditioning is controlled by the local authority. So until they turn it on you can only have hot air from the air conditioning - at the time this wasn’t stated in the listing.
Meant some hotter than ideal late May nights. Other than that a great experience with fantastic customer support.

Nous avons passé un excellent séjour de 10 jours à Somerset. L’appart-hotel était impeccable et particulièrement confortable pour une famille de 4. L’emplacement est vraiment excellent, avec de nombreux restaurants et commerces à proximité, dans un environnement très agréable.
Le ménage était parfaitement réalisé chaque jour, et tout le personnel a été adorable, disponible et très attentionné.
Mention spéciale pour le parking gratuit sur place, qui est un véritable avantage et très pratique.
Nous recommandons vivement Genius Living qui nous a très bien assisté et que nous solliciterons avec grand plaisir lors de nos prochains séjours !
Very nice house and very professional staff. You would enjoy the location great neighborhood and good support all around your stay.

description:
Get ready for a fantastic view of Istanbul! Offering unparalleled spaciousness and views, this home provides a very enjoyable stay, thanks to both its own large balcony and the shared terrace on the upper floor.
Perfect for short- and long-term stays, with a full list of amenities.

It is a self-check-in system; 48 hours before your reservation, you can check in using the passwords automatically provided in your check-in information.

Girişte karşılaştığım toz ve saç birikintileri temizliğin ne kadar yetersiz olduğunu ilk andan gösterdi. description: Located in Beyoğlu, one of Istanbul's most historic districts, this elegantly restored apartment promises a peaceful stay. Its location puts you very close to the city's most central areas. The building features a beautiful and spacious lobby area, a shared space where you can enjoy your time and socialize with other guests. You can also enjoy coffee and tea while staying in the building with our unlimited Wi-Fi service. Please note that we do not accept guests without reservations

reviews.text: I don't often leave reviews. I don't seek them either. It's rare that you have a really bad experience or a really exceptional one. Except on this occasion. Berna and her site manager Ali make a brilliant team. They have taken extra care in providing a venue that is decorated to a high quality fixtures, fittings and finish. Immensely hospitable. The room was very comfortable, I always felt like service was a priority. But without hassles. It's the shortest walk to the edge of the huge Taksim hospitality scene but far enough not to be bothered by venue noise. At this price range it was great value and if you are lucky enough to get a free slot and book, I'd seriously consider it. 5 stars.

Everything was great and exactly as shown in the photos and described in the listing. Access was very easy, and the location was convenient. Just keep in mind that the neighborhood might not be to everyone’s taste.

We had an enjoyable stay. The room was clean and had all the amenities we needed. The hosts were super nice, helpful, and very responsive. They even went out of their way to help me with a few things, which I really appreciated. The only downside was the neighborhood, which wasn't quiet and didn’t feel very safe or welcoming.

They are quite responsive and helpful. The place is clean and the amenities are highly satisfactory. The neighborhood is still developing. If you like observing authentic daily life scenes, it's quite live and cheerful.

I loved staying in that place, especially it os affordable compared to the services they have. It was like a hotel, I had everything I need to live during 5 days.
The host are very kind and friendly and quick responses 🩵

description:
Located in one of Istanbul's most vibrant and central areas, this spacious 55 m² studio apartment is an ideal option for both short and long stays. Our apartment, which is only 350 meters from the Taksim Metro Station, offers you a comfortable stay with its modern design, spacious living area and central location.

Thanks to the large double bed and the fold-out sofa bed, 4 people can stay comfortably. Our apartment is on the 3rd floor.

reviews.text: Hakan was very responsive, and the location was great. Unfortunately, those were the only positives. The address provided after booking was incorrect. We arrived tired with heavy suitcases and spent over 20 minutes walking around trying to find the place before having to contact the host for the correct location. The apartment was also extremely dirty—the bathroom, shower, fridge, floors and bedsheets were not cleaned in ages. The listing did not mention there was no elevator, so we had to carry our heavy luggage up to the 3rd floor (4th level including ground). The A/C remote didn't work, and the water heater was set to 20°C with no instructions for getting hot water. The hair dryers barely worked, and there was no duvet despite the listing saying there was one. The apartment was cluttered, with a huge light and TV protruding from the wall that I hit my head on several times. One star only for the location and Hakan's responsiveness.

Stayed with my family for 15 nights, during our stay everything was superb, thanks to Hakan the super-host who makes our stay comfortable.
The place is exactly as described , clean and newly renovated
Only few steps from istiklal street where the night will never end with its shopping and restaurants and entertainment.
The place is close to taksim metro station and many bus options are around
Waiting for my next visit to Istanbul and for sure this will be my preferred place

I really loved the location. It's easy to find, there's no uphill climb to get there, and a car can pull right up. The tram and bus stops are close by too, and just a short walk puts you straight onto İstiklal street. What surprised me was how quiet the airbnb is, completely peaceful. And in every direction there are plenty of great restaurants and cafés.
I was very happy with the room as well. It's spacious yet compact, clean, and comfortable. The morning sun comes right in, which was nice. Everything worked well, the only small thing was the wifi a bit weak, but that was ok. Overall, a really great stay dan a safe location.

Hayatım boyunca birçok farklı yerde konaklama deneyimi yaşadım ama burası gerçekten beklentilerimin çok üzerinde oldu. Öncelikle evin konumu mükemmel. Taksim’in tam merkezinde olmasına rağmen oldukça rahat ve güvenli bir bölgede yer alıyor. İhtiyacınız olan her yere yürüyerek ulaşabiliyorsunuz. Restoranlar, kafeler, marketler ve toplu taşıma durakları birkaç dakika mesafede.
Eve giriş süreci inanılmaz kolay ve sorunsuzdu. Hakan, daha rezervasyon aşamasından itibaren tüm sorularımıza çok hızlı cevap verdi. Check-in sırasında bizi güler yüzüyle karşıladı ve her konuda yardımcı oldu. Misafirlerine gerçekten değer veren samimi, sıcak kanlı ve çözüm odaklı bir ev sahibi. Kendinizi yabancı bir yerde değil de sanki bir arkadaşınızın evine gelmiş gibi hissediyorsunuz Evin temizliği ise gerçekten kusursuzdu. Her köşe özenle hazırlanmıştı. Banyosu, mutfağı, odaları ve tüm eşyalar pırıl pırıldı. Hijyen konusunda en ufak bir tereddüt yaşamadık. Kesinlikle herkes buraya gelmedi Teşşekürler hakan! 🇹

My stay at Hakan’s apartment was lovely and great to end off trip in Istanbul. It was very clean and bright and peaceful. Hakan was great to communicate and very responsive, accommodating to my needs for an earlier check in time. The apartment is located in a very central location. It is only a 3-minute walk to Taksim Square. Located in a clean, calm, and safe area, the apartment offers easy access to many important points in the city. Would def recommend

description:
Here is an interesting and impressive description that contains exactly this information:
Our apartment, located on Istiklal Avenue, is just a 2-minute walk from the metro. You can enjoy Istanbul to the fullest thanks to the restaurants, bars and shops around it. A comfortable stay awaits you at the center of both entertainment and transportation! If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family.

reviews.text: Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi, temiz, düzenli ve oldukça rahattı. İhtiyacımız olan her şey düşünülmüştü. Savaş Bey de iletişim konusunda çok ilgili, nazik ve yardımcıydı; ihtiyaç duyduğumuzda hızlıca dönüş sağladı. Konum ve genel olarak evin atmosferi de gayet güzeldi. Sorunsuz ve keyifli bir konaklama geçirdik. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz, tekrar yolumuz düşerse tercih edeceğimiz bir yer.

Great location right on Istiklal Street, apartment was very convenient and sparkling clean despite being tiny for 4 people.
Host was very responsive and accommodating of early check-in.
Keep in mind there is a tea and coffee maker (and cute touches such as coffee, tea and little snacks) but no kitchen facilities (stove, microwave, etc.). Not a problem considering lots of cafes and street food joints around the neighborhood.
Konum olarak iyi bir yer gayet temiz ve iyiydi tek proplem camlar eski olduğu için çok ses geliyor ve perdeler tül olduğu için içeri gece aydınlık oluyor
Great price, friendly host and good A/C!
Herşey çok güzeldi daire huzur dolu çok temiz herşey mevcuttu klimasıda var herkesin gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayabileceği biryer

description: Comfortable upper-floor room featuring one 140 cm double bed and one 90 cm single bed. Offering 15 m² of space, including the bathroom, this cozy and practical room is ideal for couples, friends, or small families. Located just a 5-minute walk from Sultanahmet Square, the hotel also offers a complimentary breakfast with a beautiful sea view.

reviews.text: Elif's place was so cozy and warm. It was cleaned so thoroughly, nothing could be found. The bed was more comfortable than average. We enjoyed a great Turkish breakfast every morning that was delicious and nutritious. This is a great location. It's literally steps from a bunch of restaurants and sites (my favorite was Paradise). If you're a cat lover, there are tons of fur babies to shower love upon. 🐈 I felt safe and even with protests happening, my host made a point to keep us abreast! You could not ask for better accommodations. Thank you Elif!

My husband and I loved our stay at Elif’s hotel! The staff were very kind, the room was pretty and clean and the outdoor seating was amazing. I loved having Turkish breakfast overlooking the water each morning!
I also loved how walkable this Airbnb was to all of the major sites—-Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque and the Basilica Cistern. There were many restaurants very close by which was helpful after our jet lag. The shuttles to and from the airport were also incredibly helpful.
If I am ever in in Istanbul again, I will stay here. I would highly recommend this place.

Not exceptionally clean (I asked to switch rooms bc my first room had hair and stains on the sheets. Good location and helpful staff but hotels in Istanbul can be quite cheap… I would be open to stay again but would consider other options first. Good breakfast and lovely view of the Bosphorus

Nice place for a short stay. Very clean and staff is super friendly and helpful. Location can't be better as we were near all the main touristic sights. Obviously very difficult to find parking but that's for all the area! Definitely worth the price.

Very clean hotel with a really nice roof terrace with great views over the Bosphorus. I had a sea view between some buildings) from my first floor room, which was nice.
The staff are really kind, friendly and helpful, even after I had some problems with losing my keys. The wifi is fast, and the location is close to a street full of restaurants, and not far from the main Blue Mosque area.
Very pleasant stay!

description:
You will love our newly reconstructed apartment because of:
•It has a Garden for Barbecue and Dining
•Perfect location - on the border of Old Town and Little Hagia Sophia & Local Supermarkets
•Beautiful neighborhood with Authentic Ottoman Houses
•Amazing equipment - 2 separated bedrooms, spacious bathroom
•Brand new electronic equipments including washing machine
•Rain shower & Massage shower & hand shower unit
•Unlimited free Wi-Fi
•This flat is on the Entrance floor of the House

reviews.text: The apartment was super nice, even better than on the pictures. We arrived pretty late, but someone was waiting for us directly at the apartment to check in. Everything was super clean and the bathroom was pretty new with a great shower. The terrace was super nice and comfy. Even though there is a street next to the terrace, the apartment is on the ground floor, you could sit there without getting disturbed because they have privacy protection. They even cleaned our apartment once during our 5-night stay. The hosts arranged a transfer to the airport super last minute for us and the communication in general was super quick and smooth. We would definitely recommend staying at this place, it is in a quite area with super short walking distance to the main sites of the old town.

The host was super kind, provided all the needed information and answered all our questions. We used a transfer from the airport which was offered by the host. The car was comfortable and the price was fair. The apartment itself was clean, cozy and all needed amenities were present. Also, there is a terrace/garden which is a very nice bonus! In addition, the apartment is well located, a lot of tourist spots can be reached on foot.

Centrally located. About a 5 minute walk from the Blue mosque and Aya Sofaya. Accommodation is fine.
There is a problem of bugs around the house but we were told it’s because of it being close to a park.
We also didn’t realize it’s a duplex and there were people staying upstairs which caused a bit of noise especially with our small baby.
Other than that, value for money. Recommended place.

Our stay at Mehmet place wasn’t great. The location was perfect. It is very close to the sea as well as located in a great tourist location. The host was very welcoming and polite. The accomodation was exactly as listed.
Great location and have everything you need

description:
FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION (Less than 1 minute distance) – FREE MINI BREAKFAST (Less than 1 minute distance) – 3MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – MARKETS & PATISSERIES NEARBY – SAME FLAT IN THE PHOTOS – 10% DISCOUNT in OUR CAFE

How we fight against COVID-19: We do the cleanings with mask and gloves. Our cleaning process is in-line with local & global rules and guidelines. We also have our own laundry and wash all bedhseets and towes 60c hot.

reviews.text:
My stay here was good and fit my needs. For the value, the size of the unit is very good. At the same price, other locations are only small hotel rooms at 10-13m. The location is not in the middle of Taksim Square, but roughly 15-20 minute walk. However, it is very close walking distance to Istiklal Street. It's a short walk from a central bus stop that has buses to everywhere you'd want to go as a tourist.
Keep in mind the building doesn't have any elevators and you'll have to walk up 4 flights of stairs to get to this unit.
To get to the building from the Main Street, it's all downhill, but that means all uphill when you go out to explore.
Check-in process is at their main office which is a few buildings away up the street that is open 24 hours. When you check-in, you'll have someone take you to the unit. Access is a physical key, no digital self check-in.
The room itself was clean. Wifi was good as I was able to work and do Zoom meetings.
Communication and service are top notch

Pros:
- One of the cleanest ever hotels I've been to.
- Very close to Istiklal street and Taksim Square
- Very friendly and hospitable
- Two grocery shops just downstairs
- Good cafes and börek near to Istiklal street.
- Hotel staffs are very helpful
Cons? Or tiny nit-picks:
- The lamp in the bedroom is quite dim, but it's ok after we changed it with an Led bulb.
- Tap water is drinkable after boiling, but only if you're not sensitive to chlorine.
- The area has a bad reputation, but the hotel itself is located at quite a busy main street, so we didn't feel like it's dangerous even at night.
- Weird shoutings at night, not the hotel's fault, but noises die down after 10pm, so there's no worries about sleep disturbance.
Overall it's a great hotel at a great location, and there were no major issues, we enjoyed it during our two weeks stay.

Guner and Guven were very quick to respond to our request and were both very helpful before we arrived and during our stay. We didn't meet Guner in person but Guven was living in the apartment right underneath us, which made it very easy for us to pick up the key. Before we came when I asked Guner for a few suggestions about good places to visit and he sent me a 60 page power point slide presentation with suggestions which we felt was above and beyond. He also sent us a map with directions for finding the apartment. The first time was a little tricky (but after that it was very easy to find by walking down Iskital, turning right by the Hard Rock Cafe, and just going straight till we went under the tunnel and found the "Hands Up" graffiti which was our landmark to turn on the little street and find the place 30 seconds away), and about 10 minutes on foot to Iskital Street and Taksim. The neighbourhood was a bit darkly lit and perhaps a little shady looking (though we had no bad encounters), but the apartment itself looked very recently renovated and was great. It was clean and comfortable. The second night we found it a bit cold but Guner replied immediately online when we asked him about the heat, told us the air conditioner could also be used for heat, and looked into the water heater the next day. The water tap in the bathroom was a bit loose but was still functioning ok. I let Guner know about it as I got the impression he wasn't one to let the place get into disrepair. He again got back to me very promptly and said he hadn't been aware about it. He said he could look after it after we left or have someone come to look at it immediately the next day if we preferred. We told him since it was functioning fine it was ok to wait till we left. Guvin, who lived downstairs, gave us his number, told us not to hesitate to knock or call if we needed anything, and helped us with directions and suggestions. So we actually had two hosts, one online and one in person. Guner even called the Apple Store for me to for an enquiry I had since I couldn't get an English number and saved me a trip for something that they didn't have. I'd absolutely recommend both as hosts. I gave it a four for overall experience as selecting a half star to give 4.5 didn't seem possible, with the only drawback being the slightly dark streets nearby, something not really in the hosts control. I would have no problem recommending this apartment.

so the place is the same as in the pictures, VERY clean, and the cleaning lady comes once per week to clean it for you, breakfast is included. location is amazing. apartment has heating and it is warm. price is low. walcable distance from Isteklar. I have stayed here 2 weeks, host responded within 5 minutes each time I had a question. I think it is a great deal

This flat was exactly what we were looking for during our stay in Istanbul. It was very clean, the hot shower was fantastic and the space was really nice. Guner's brother Guven welcomed us and showed us to the flat at the top of the complex - he was very kind and went out of his way to make us feel welcome. He even went to find a hairdryer especially for me! The description is very accurate, and the location makes it easy to get around the city. We felt safe and comfortable throughout, and Guner and Guven were very responsive if we ever had questions. Many thanks for making us feel welcome!

description:
Welcome to my apartment!
I am a seasoned airbnb traveler and I do my best to accomadate anything you might need. My place is 5 stars with:
- perfect location
-always sparkling clean
-high quality, 100%cotton sateen sheets and towels with plenty extras
-very comfortable beds
- black out curtains in bedrooms
-walk in shower
- coffee maker, kettle, fridge, electric stove, all utencils for kitchen
-great restaurants, cafes around

reviews.text:
Location was superb. Steps from Sishane, and very nice if you want to be near all the action. If you plan to go out, explore, and enjoy the bar scene, it’s a great place to be. Mine, the host, was amazing. Very responsive, great notes, and checked in often to make sure things were well. She was probably the most responsive host I’ve ever had, and went above and beyond what others have done for me in the past.
Internet was great. I needed to have an important video meeting for interview at 10PM at night and was really worried about the noise, but others on my Teams call could not hear the street noise. However, worth noting: only one room has AC, but there’s another AC in the living room that can keep all rooms cooled if you have doors open. Tv and Netflix was a plus on a rainy afternoon while waiting for others to get ready for the day. Shower was good. There is a lift to get heavy luggage up to your room. Special mention to the sandwich shop owner right outside who was also great!

She is a polite and personable girl. She is always available and if you leave her a message, she will respond to you in less than an hour. The location of her house is great and very close to the sights. The beds are good quality and the windows are bright. However, her house is a bit small and smaller than the pictures. The elevator is very small and the staircases and common areas have an unpleasant smell. Maybe it would be better to charge a lower price for the nightly rent and the apartment is not worth this price.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul!
The location was perfect , very close to public transport, historical sights, and the famous Istiklal Street, which helped us save a lot on transportation costs. The neighborhood had a beautiful atmosphere and a charming vibe that we really enjoyed.
The apartment was very clean and comfortable, exactly as shown in the listing. Our host was incredibly friendly, attentive, and gave us many helpful tips for exploring the city.
We truly felt at home and enjoyed every moment of our stay. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul! 🌟

Small cosy 2-bedroom apartment, good size for short stays and everything you would need in a popular location.
Pros: Well-located; 30 seconds from Metro and 10-minute walk to Tram, nice area (close to Galata, Istiklal street, Karakoy and Taksim), good cafes and restaurant nearby, small supermarkets nearby, shower was very strong, lift in the building, easy access to property and check-in, Netflix available on TV, AC in the living room, fans were provided upon request for the bedrooms. Easy to get taxis.
Cons: The beds especially in the second bedroom was very uncomfortable and not firm at all (felt like waterbed) and caused back pain, theres no washing machine unfortunately so wish we had more towels provided. The biggest drawback about this property is that it is located in a very busy location close to Istiklal street and Galata so on the weekends especially Thursday through to Monday it is very loud and noisy until 3 or 4 am in the morning so was very difficult to sleep.
Note: to get to the property from the tram station or to get to Istiklal street from the property there is a lot incline walking!
Overall, had a good stay and the host had great communication and very helpful.

I had a wonderful stay at this accommodation in Şişhane, Istanbul. The location was excellent, with easy access to restaurants, cafés, public transportation, and many of the city’s main attractions. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
The host, Mine, was very kind, helpful, and responsive throughout my stay. Everything was well organized, and I felt very comfortable and welcome.
I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul, and I would be happy to stay here again!

description:
One of the four modern apartments in a fully restored 19th century building.

Located near Galata Tower, close to Istiklal St. and Galata Bridge, within a few minutes walking to Karakoy Tram.

**There is a floor plan of the apartment in the photo stream. We kindly ask our guests to review the plan before booking.**

***Please note that the terrace area is separate and a common space of the building***

reviews.text: You found it—paradise in Istanbul! Truly, you will not find a more comfortable, beautiful, safe, and ideally-located apartment in all of Istanbul. The apartment is 1 of 4 in a gorgeously renovated historic building, located a 1-minute walk from Galata Tower (just far enough to be away from the touristy chaos, yet close enough that anything you need is within steps of the door). The neighborhood is very safe, charming, and welcoming. The building was restored by mother-daughter team Selmin and Zeynep, who are wonderfully kind and interesting women. It is managed by another exceptional woman, Hatice, who will go above and beyond to make sure you are comfortable, help with anything you might need, or simply offer a coffee or tea if you stop by the office to chat. The office is actually a small gallery on the ground floor, where you'll find lovely items from around Turkey—reasonably priced and ready to take home as unique souvenirs! Each apartment retains historic charm, while offering modern conveniences and luxurious, unique decor. The bed and bath linens are so lush, and you'll even enjoy Turkish robes during your stay. The kitchen is fully equipped (including a full-size fridge, which is rare in European rentals), and there's a water filtration system in place (a big bonus in a city where tap water is not OK for drinking). The soaps and toiletries are all premium quality (local olive oil products that smell delicious), and the bathroom is spacious with a large shower and rainfall shower head. I slept better than ever in the comfy bed (I thought if it as a "princess bed" because of the beautiful headboard and luxe decor in the room). The living area is equally comfortable and inviting, with an outstanding view across the water to a large mosque—just wait until you see it lit up at night! The apartment alone would be worth every penny, but then there's also the shared space upstairs—an indoor and outdoor rooftop terrace with two levels, tons of space for everyone to share, and plenty more amenities. The view from the terrace is breathtaking. I spent many early mornings up there watching the sunrise while sipping my coffee, and several evenings watching the sunset while sipping wine. I honestly felt like the space was an extension of my apartment, and because I was there outside of the main tourist season, I always had it to myself. I did meet a few other guests in the building during my stay, and they were lovely people. It's definitely the type of place that draws kind, cool guests—which adds to the feeling of safety and comfort (especially as a female traveling solo). Did I mention that there's also housekeeping service (light daily and full weekly), and the housekeeper, Elif, is sweet as can be. Other amenities include reliable wifi, AC/heat, and shared washer AND dryer access. Trust me, fellow travelers—if you want an Istanbul experience that is ultra comfortable and convenient, with magical views that you'll never forget, this is the place!

This very amazing apartment became my home for three months and I loved every minute of it. The apartment is very comfortable and very well maintained, and so is the rest of the building. There is a building manager on site, which is great as you have someone to rely on for any needs or questions you may have. Zeynep and her family are the most gracious of hosts and they ensured my stay there was a very pleasant experience.
There are countless of thoughtful touches that make this building and the apartment I rented a very special place. Although there is a terrace on the top floor with a stunning view of the city, there is also a superb view from the living room of the apartment, which I grew to treasure every single day. Many were the meals I got to cook in the very well equipped kitchen, but above all having a water filter incorporated in the kitchen sink made it all much easier and convenient, so no need to haul big jugs of water upstairs.
The location of the building is simply spectacular, very well connected, near the metro and tram and with lots of great restaurants nearby. It is the perfect base to get to know the majestic city of Istanbul!
Thanks Zeynep for everything!

Clean, comfortable, great location. Fantastic hosts: Ugur helped us check in and out; helping carrying our luggage during check-in and calling a taxi during check-out. Zeynep checked in with us multiple times during the trip, despite being out of town herself. Rooftop terrace was a charming plus. Fully equipped kitchen was a joy to cook in too. Overall: highly recommended; our best airbnb experience as of yet.

We had a great time at Zeynep's place. The apartment is located in Galata, a very hip neighborhood with a lot of cafes, restaurants and bars. It is also a great place for individual shopping if you like little boutiques.
The apartment is just as displayed on the pictures. It is brand new and in a perfect condition. It was very clean. For us it was just perfect to have a little kitchen. We enjoyed fantastic evenings having dinner on Zeynep's roof top balcony.
Zeynep was a perfect host. She provided us many useful information regarding restaurants and bars.
All in all it was a great place and we would definitley stay there again.

Thank you very much Zeynep.

Wonderful! I stayed in this apartment for a full month, and really enjoyed it. The terrace is a perfect spot for lounging with a great view of the golden horn. The location is right by the Galata Tower, I liked being close to Istiklal Street and a short tram ride away from the sights of the old city. Zeynep and the whole team were very attentive. Just be ready for the stairs, this apartment is on the third floor, but it's worth it for the view and the beautiful and well-furnished apartment. The floor plan, getting from the bedroom to the kitchen is a little awkward but it was no real hindrance. Highly recommend!

description:
Our place, a historical building, with a high ceiling of 3,5 m, is centrally located in Beyoglu which is in the historical area of Istanbul.
The place is 10 min walking distance to Istiklal Street, bars, traditional restaurants, and night clubs. It is also very close to most important historical places such as Sultanahmet, Eminönü,Galata.
The metro and bus stations are 1 km and 350 m away, respectively.

The flat is located in the residential area. So it is important to be quite after 10 pm.

reviews.text:
The place was really nice and clean and the host was reachable very easily. Everything was in the house as described and it was a quiet place. The checkin and checkout was easy and flexible. Although the wifi would become slow or the modem would get disconnected every few hour and you had to change your connection to their other wifis.
When you are looking for a house in Istanbul, you should know that there are many parts of the city that are down/up hilly and this house is located in a good spot, close to the street when coming from TaksimSquare side and about 5-10 minute walk from the bus stops.

Unfortunately taxi driver couldn't find the place and i tried to call the host, he was not able to speak English which was a big shock for me because this place was an appartment for tourists and surely they won't speak Turkish. Place is clean and nice. 10 minutes walk from taksim square, the sink in the bathroom is too small, we were on the ground floor and it was a little noisy because there is a boulangerie outside of the window and they work all night or till late night i think. Everything in description is provided... And the place is exectly the same as in the photos.... In this price it's a good deal. I recommend....

I asked for early check in because of our plane arrival time which got accepted. That made us rest on our arrival to Istanbul. There is a man named Yavuz which will show you the house, he was outside of the house looking for us which felt very good. The house was clean and had useful kitchen tools as described in the description. The house is small yet good for two people. The area is safe, we walked in the area two nights around midnight and felt safe. Overall I recommend the house

We had a great stay in Istanbul. The apartment is conveniently located near Taksim Square, with easy access to public transport including the airport shuttle, metro, tram, and buses. There are plenty of shops and restaurants within walking distance, making it a lively and practical base.
The space is clean and comfortably sized for two people. The kitchen is basic (no cooking oil) but a microwave can be requested, which was essential for us. Having a washing machine was a big plus for our longer stay. Wi-Fi was reliable with decent speed, which made remote work smooth.
The host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Overall, a solid choice for travelers looking for convenience, comfort, and good connectivity in Istanbul.

The location of this Airbnb was excellent. You can walk to Taksim Square in about 10–12 minutes, Istiklal Street in around 12 minutes, and Galata Tower in about 10–12 minutes as well. Since Istanbul has many steep and difficult roads, the walking path from this house was surprisingly easy and convenient, which made our stay even better.
The house was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. Everything was well prepared and organized.
The host was very responsive, responsible, and always replied quickly whenever we needed anything. Overall, we had a great experience as we stay there about 12 days and would definitely recommend this place.

description: Our spacious 3+1 apartment, close to the Osmanbey metro station and the main street, offers both comfort and ease of access to its guests. It is ideal for families with a stylish living room, a double bedroom and two separate bedrooms. You can find the comfort of your home here with a well-equipped kitchen, bathroom and carefully selected furniture. Thanks to its central location, you can easily reach the popular spots of the city and have a safe and pleasant accommodation experience.

reviews.text: The place is conveniently located, right on the main avenue and the flat is on the first floor and accessible with a small elevator. As the flat faced the back of the building there was little street noise inside. While the furniture, kitchen top and the bathroom showed their age and some blemishes on sofas, the flat was generally very good. We stayed as 6 persons and the 3-room arrangement was great. It had everything we expected for a 3-day stay. Koray was very polite and responsive and his aide Enes met us during entrance. They even arranged early check-in. The street in front of the building had Ispark parking which is 500TL for a whole day. If you are a group of 4-6, consider this for your stays. If, by chance, I need a stay for a similar group, I will definitely consider this place again. Thanks...

The best part of this booking was Koray himself as our host. He supported me just from the booking until we left the home. Anything we needed , provided by him immediately. I can call the place home as it feels like home sweet home. Of course, you can never have a perfect place as you desire but I belive this home is great place to stay for a family of 6 or more. The location is perfect. It is very clean, all the necessary amenities are there though you just need to ask Koray anything you need. Internet connection is perfect. Thanks Koray for everything.
Her şey fotoğraflardaki ve açıklamalardaki gibi. Koray Bey harika bir ev sahibi. Evin konumu zaten şahane. Mesajlara oldukça hızlı geri dönüş alıyorsunuz ve gerçekten yardımcı oluyor Koray Bey.

Property manager, Munzur is an amazing man!!!. Just a totally cool guy!
Despite busy with his work etc, he was able to sort out all our requests. And he did them all promptly.
I truly recommend staying here.
The apartment is in a good location. Near to the city, high street shopping, restaurants and take-outs.
Osmanbey Metro was just a ten minute walk. Bus stops were also close by. All six of us could go anywhere on public transport.
The apartment is on the first floor and there is a lift. So easy access for people and luggage.

Very respectful and friendly
The location is excellent and easy to reach
located on a servant street
It was clean and good , but it's better to give more attention to the cleanliness of the sofas.
We contacted them for a delivery service to the airport and we were very satisfied
Thanks again

description:
OUR DETACHED HOUSE WITH A GARDEN ON THE RIVERSIDE IN AĞVA, ŞİLE IS AN IDEAL PLACE TO SPEND TIME IN TOUCH WITH NATURE. YOU MUST ENJOY BREAKFAST AT OUR PIER ON THE RIVERSIDE. WHETHER YOU'RE HAVING A BARBECUE IN FRONT OF YOUR HOME OR ENJOYING TEA AND COFFEE ON THE PIER. OUR HOME IS EQUIPPED WITH AN AIR CONDITIONER, A REFRIGERATOR, A KETTLE, AND A HAIRDRYER.
THERE IS A SHARED KITCHEN AND DINING ROOM ON THE PIER.
WE ARE LOCATED ABOUT 4 KM FROM THE CENTER OF AĞVA AND THE BEACH. IT IS NOT POSSIBLE TO REACH THE SEA WITHOUT A VEHICLE.

reviews.text: It's a friendly, family-like atmosphere. Very calm and peaceful. They value customer satisfaction. A clean and well-maintained place to stay. I'm thinking of coming back again.

2 gün konakladık her şey çok güzeldi ve yasin bey çok ilgiliydi çok teşekkür ederiz iki kişi konakladık ve iki kişi için çok yeterliydi evin boyutu biz yanımızda tabak çatal gibi temel malzemelerimizi götürdük ama yasin bey o konuda da yardımcı oluyordu temiz sessiz ve çok rahat bir konaklama oldu kesinlikle bir daha tercih edeceğimiz bir adres 🙂
