Rahat güzel bir konaklama oldu
Tavsiye ediyorum

description: The last thing you should worry about is your comfort on a holiday. Rappel Suite No.3 has anything you need for a pleasant stay even the Bosphorus lights view. Located in the center of the beautiful city Istanbul. 5 min walk to Taksim Square, 5 min walk down to the Kabataş Boat Station, Karaköy tram that takes 10 mins to the old city Sultanahmet. But the real city feeling to experience in the evening is just 3 min walk. The best bars and restaurants of the city are right behind the corner.

reviews.text:
My wife & I visited Istanbul for a football match. the apartment was well located within 10 mins walk from Taksim Sq. we felt safe in the apartment with the extra secure door and on the 3rd floor. first impressions walking in were great. the bed was comfy, very spacious and all of the amenities we needed.
there were some cleanliness issues. there was a dirty spoon in the kitchen sink, what appeared to be a hair stuck to the kitchen surface, paint from the ceiling had fallen and were on the shower floor, stains on the bedsheets, and there were 4 squares of toilet paper for 2 people for 2 nights. we checked the storage cupboard where there was plenty of useful items, but no toilet paper.
the host was very friendly and responsive before our arrival, and helpful when we struggled to get in (which was our fault for not following the instructions properly).
We would highly recommend if the cleanliness issues were resolved, but this was a big issue for us.

Sina was a great host and the apartment exceeded our expectations. Check in was easy and the apartment building easy to find. We were wowed when we walked in. The apartment was even better and more spacious feeling than the photos let on. The view towards the Bosphorous was lovely, and also the neighborhood and park across the street below the window. Bed comfy, kitchen handsome, great shower. I had been to Istanbul a few times before but my first time staying in Cihangir and my partner and I were both smitten. Great vibe, great walkability, not too busy but alive in the streets, and some really lovely restaurants and bars.
We hope to return and stay again!

Incredible experience!
Spacious flat in a bohemian neighborhood at the very center of Istanbul with breath taking Bosphorus view, and full of natural light! The sunrise view in the morning is priceless! The place is so cozy, and functional. Absolutely suitable and comfortable for remote work: solid WiFi, dedicated workspace, and AC!
1. Sina and his wife - they provided me with list of categorized recommendations, and made a last minute reservation for Aheste (full all the time). It was an incredible dining experience!
2. Derya - she runs the cafe downstairs Rappel, fluent in English and super friendly. Enjoyed fresh coffee drinks, and hanging out. I met super interesting people and made new friends. In fact, started working on a side project with one of them!
3. Neighborhood - truly bohemian! Lots of coffee shops, design stores, antique shops, and proximity to everywhere. Gunesli Street and the Cihangir Park is the main location of the best vintage of Turkish movies!
Every aspect of the airbnb was smooth and exceeded my expectation!
Thanks so much Sina and family. Looking forward to calling your place my home again!

First of all Ali was a wonderful host and went out of their way to help us however they could.
The AC was not working the first night which made for quite a rough experience but he managed to quickly get a mechanic out the next day to address the issue. In the end, the AC was still quite weak, but it was sufficient to keep us from melting overnight.
The description mentions a kitchen and a bedroom - but in reality its worth noting its all one space (an open plan). The view is beautiful, and location great, but the noise from the dog-park below at all hours of the night means that keeping the windows open at night is ill-advised.
We had a pleasant experience overall, mostly due to the kindness and flexibility of the host.

Excellent location and a great neighborhood. Many cafe’s, bakeries, coffeeshops and restaurants in direct vicinity. Taxi’s and Uber are available 24/7, but it is also very walkable.
The place is spacious and cosy. Looks just like the photos. Wifi works great. It felt like a home away from home. Suitable for longer stays, because it has a full kitchen and a washing machine. It also felt very safe, because the entrance door of the building has a keypad lock and there are cameras in the hallways of the building.
The hosts are friendly, helpful and responsive.

description:
A Comfortable Escape in the Heart of History

We are located in the heart of Old Istanbul, from Sultanahmet and Hagia Sophia (5 minutes), the Grand Bazaar (7 minutes walking). With easy access to public transportation, you can reach all parts of Istanbul.
Your comfortable room is entirely yours. Bathrooms, kitchens, and other are shared.

All your bathroom needs, including towels, shampoo, bathrobes, and disposable slippers, are provided by us.

reviews.text:
Amazing place to stay! Felt completely at home with helpful hosts who were available at any time of the day.
The room was exactly as described and squeaky clean. The shares bathroom were also clean at all times with hot water. The common room is a great place to relax after a long day of exploring with complementary coffee, tea and games.
Location is great! Walking distance to tram and the famous places of Istanbul like Grand Bazar, Spice Bazaar, Hagia Sophia etc.
Plenty of food options along the main Sultanahmet street!
Loved our stay and will definitely stay again when we visit Istanbul next!

I must say that i was very pleased with this stay. Everything was in walking distance, but due to being a tourist atea everything is very pricey. The establishment it self was very nice and had a very relax-full feeling. I felt like i was in a dorm but peaceful dorm. The only downfall for me was the room i had was by the street so in the morning i could hear all the beeping but thats because i am a light sleeper. The host was very friendly and helpful. The social area was quite relaxing. The host has everything you could need for your stay and someone is available at anytime 24/7. The place is very safe and comfortable. And i forgot to mention the kitchen, laundry room, and other things are available for your use. And the best attractions are all at walking distance. Enjoyed very much! I would definitely rent again if needed.

I stayed in this room for 5 nights and felt absolutely at home.
The room was spotless, clean and very spacious. It overlooked the road but was still pretty quiet.
The shared showers and washrooms were extremely clean and well maintained. The room came with a bathrobe and toiletries which proved to be super handy.
The social area downstairs is super cute and the unlimited coffee - excellent!
The location is absolutely central with tram stations, top tourist attractions, supermarkets, pharmacies - all within a couple of minutes walking distance.
Finally, the highlight of the stay is the hospitality, kindness and promptness of the hosts. Ridvan and Mustafa are very prompt with their communication and always smiling and willing to help make your stay absolutely pleasant.
I also felt safe traveling solo as a woman in the property as well as in the area nearby.
The place is perfect for anyone who wants the best on a moderate budget! Thanks for the happy memories! 🙏🏻😊

Social House is minutes walk from Sultanahmet Square and surrounded with places of historical interest. You'll be staying in what was the heart of Constantinople if history is of interest to you. The room was spacious and spotless with a view of the street below. Air conditioning worked well and has block out curtains. There is ample space in the common areas, including a roof top terrace, and an indoor lounge-dining area. The host was extremely responsive and friendly with messages, seemingly anytime of the day. Washing machine/dryer available, and the kitchen was functional. Only criticism is the mattress was a little hard for my tastes. Also note, you'll have to walk up three flights of stairs to get to the room. There is no lift.

Literally the best b'n'b experience I've ever had. Anything you could ever wish for while visiting Istanbul, it's there. Great location. 3 min walk to Sultanahmet tram station, 5 min to Blue Mosque and Hagia Sofia. A lot of great street food locations just out on the same street, a couple of supermarkets as well. The place itself is really charming. 3 floors of living space and to top it off, a huge terrace with artificial grass and chaise longues, couches and tables where you can have amazing meals or late night drinks with friends, or with seagulls if you're alone 🙃 Plus an amazing view of the bosphorous. Rooms are spacious with huge windows, shower and toilet are super clean. Beds are comfy and huge. Shared kitchen where you can cook your own food or store it in the fridge. Last but not least, the Co-hosts !! Ceren, Akif, Mohammad and Zaidan are literally a dream team, together with the owner of the place Mustafa, they'll go above and beyond to make sure your trip doesn't lack anything. Such cheerful, funny and hospitable people, you have no idea until you meet them. Just a wonderful stay, where I felt like home. Definitely gonna stay here everytime I'm in Istanbul. From all my heart, wish you all the best guys!!! ❤️👍🏻

description:
--Renovated on May of 2023--

This Studio Apartment is specially designed for the guests.
The Apartment is located in the Best Location of Istanbul; Taksim.You will be only 200 meters away from the Taksim Square(Center of Istanbul).Only two minutes away to Istiklal Street which is the heart of the nightlife of Istanbul;There are many shops,restaurants and bars furthermore many of them are open for 24 hours
It is on third floor(three stairs)
The apartment is only 2 minutes away to Metro Station.

reviews.text:
Pluses:
1) Taksim square, Istiklal street, Taksim metro, Galataport and few more key places is near, so you can walk/travel very nice.
2) Host is responsive, answering very quickly.
3) Check-in and checkout went well and comfortable.
Minuses:
1) A very dirty apartment.
2) The floors are not washed
3) the sheets are old.
4) Stinky smell all over the apartment
5) one night it was very loudly even with all door and windows closed
6) you can't use washing machine at night
7) no elevator, third floor

The apartment is on the 3rd floor without an elevator, the apartment is located down a street, it is very difficult to go down and up and reach the apartment, the balcony does not look like the one in the picture and the shower is not comfortable, there were problems with the hot water only after two days, they fixed the problem for us, this means that we are without hot water, we asked to cancel the order, but the owner of the apartment did not agree We had no fun in this apartment

Although the apartment is little small and is on 3rd floor without a lift but it's location make it all worth it. It's walkable from takmis square and all public transportation. The apartment is very clean and host is very helpful. Highly recommended for your trip to Istanbul.

I wouldn’t say the place was bad but needs a little improvements
Good things
- Perfect Location
- Good WiFi
- Kitchen and appliances
Not great
- Bed and the bedding condition
- Pillows
- Price for the place is a little too much for what you get
- Too hot (air conditioner not working well)
- Netflix in Turkish and hard to change to English
No elevator

The apartment is centrally located and near Taqsim square. Kinda small and fits two people max. The apartment is located in the 3rd floor with NO elevator. To go to the downtown area you have to go uphill Street.
Easy check in process, great Wi-Fi, and the host is excellent in communication.

description: Welcome to our enchanting guest room located in the vibrant Küçük Ayasofya neighborhood, a stone's throw away from the timeless beauty of Sultanahmet. Nestled beside the historic Sokullu Mehmet Paşa Mosque and within walking distance to the awe-inspiring Grand Bazaar and Blue Mosque, our meticulously designed space invites you to immerse yourself in the rich tapestry of Istanbul's history.

reviews.text:
Stayed for 3 nights at this place in early May 2023. Had a good experience during our stay. The place is located on a quiet street just on the periphery of Sultanahmet tourist attractions (8-10 minute walk). There's also easy access to mini marts and restaurants around the area.
The unit we stayed in was on the 3rd floor and there is no lift in the unit. Room was as described and clean. Bed was comfortable. WiFi was fast and stable. There is a balcony attached to the room which allows for some fresh air. Do be careful about leaving the balcony door open as cats did try to enter & one even marked their territory on the door.
Both Ozan & his brother were friendly, helpful and responsive throughout our stay. They made us feel welcomed and were attentive to our needs. Ozan even helped us carry one of our bags during check-in and check-out.
Overall would choose this place again due to the strategic location, clean and comfortable room, and excellent hosts.

Perfect.
The room was amazing - the thought, care and details that went into the features and amenities showed the love that the brothers Ozgur and Ozan have in what they do and what they want to offer their guests. It was super clean, there is free laundry service and a dryer, the check-in was wonderful and super smooth (thanks for helping us carry our heavy luggage Ozgur!), Ozgur immediately WhatsApped all the details and photos we needed to get to the location the moment our booking was confirmed (and later places of interest too with google map links), the brothers both spoke good English and were kind, helpful, friendly and attentive, the location was absolutely perfect surrounded by restaurants, stores, PCR test services and cobbled treats and buildings dating back to the Byzantine and yet was quiet as it was just off the lovely Main Street. It is a 15m walk to the Grand Bazaar, the Serefiye Cistern, Ayasofea, the Blue Mosque and the tramline, where you can take the tram to Galata and Taksim. The balcony was such a joy (especially for smokers and cat lovers), the bathroom was well lit, clean and the shower strong and hot.
Of all the places I've stayed over the years on Airbnb around the world, this is the one where I felt most at home and personally the best experience for me. We had the fortunate chance to meet Ozgur and Ozan's mother too, and we said hi to their Dad who runs a leather shop down the street. There was so much to experience and explore in the area that I wish our stay was 3 times longer instead of just 3 nights.
If you don't mind walks on streets past mosques and shops where the locals are, this is a much, much better location than the other side of the tramline where the tourist traps and expensive hotels and restaurants are.
Ozgur and Ozan - thank you for doing such a good job with heart and offering such a fine and wonderful accommodation to us. Thank you! ❤️❤️❤️

The host was very nice, responsive, and friendly. Check-in was flexible, which we really appreciated since we arrived later than planned. The place is about a 10-minute walk from Sultanahmet Mosque and Hagia Sophia and is very easy to access by public transport (tram to the Sultanahmet stop, then a short walk).
The room was comfortable, with both heating and air conditioning, and all the listed amenities were provided. The hot water in the bathroom was excellent.
The only downside is the steep walk to reach the place, so if you’re traveling with heavy luggage, I’d recommend taking a taxi. Our room was on the second floor and there were quite a few stairs, but the host kindly helped us carry our luggage up and down, for which we were very grateful.
I believe these conditions are common for accommodations in this area, and overall everything was perfectly fine. Considering the quality-to-price ratio, I really have not

The room looks better in the photos than it does in reality and could benefit from some improvements. I noticed several details that gave an overall impression of insufficient cleanliness, such as paint stains on the door and walls, as well as dirty windows and terrace. The curtain rod was not properly installed, which made it difficult to open the balcony door without lifting it. The bathroom also appeared to be quite roughly finished.
There was also a persistent unpleasant smell coming from the bathroom, resembling sewage. With better maintenance and a more thorough cleaning, the room could look and feel completely different.
On a positive note, the host was very kind and welcoming, and I especially enjoyed the visits from the neighborhood cat each day. The location is also perfect, 10 minutes walk from all the main attractions.

Porta Nova is a simple, convenient building very close to Sultanahmet square (500m) towards the north and the harbour/ferry station on the south. The room was very spacious, airy and has a great terrace - exactly like the pictures. The tram is about 900m away, but do note that the path is steep uphill and you will have to drag your luggage. This should be mentioned in the listing, ideally.
As for the host - friendly, communicative and helpful. Late check-out was unavailable due to other guests coming in, but the host let me store luggage, come back later to use the kitchen, eat lunch in the dining room, and help with suggestions for getting to the airport. He also helped with my luggage on day 1 (the room is on the 2nd floor and there is no elevator).
The room had a little bit of a damp smellz probably due to an under repair / open AC unit. If that can be fixed, and they can arrange a daily cleaning / turn down service, I would've rated this 5*.

reviews.text:
Murat is truly a superhost.
We rented two adjoining flats in a quiet but lovely neighbourhood of trendy Beyoglu. Flats were nicely furnished and very comfortable. You could easily spend your day there. Modern bathrooms. Everything was clean and kitchen well equipped. Air conditioning worked fine. Murat responded always promptly to messages and offered us housekeeping service after midstay.
Plenty of nice bars, cafés, minisupermarkets and restaurants were only a few minutes walking distance away. Galata tower in close vicinity.
All in all great location and supercomfy flats.
Thank you Murat for hosting us!

There were 7 ladies staying in 2 apartments. There is one main entrance and a set of stairs which take you up to Apartments 1, 2 and 3. We had the first two apartments and both are identical in shape and size and facilities. The apartments were well stocked with utensils etc. The sofas are large, beds are comfortable. The shower doesn't drain as well as it should do, but to it was great to have 4 showers. The best thing about the apartment is the location. Very close to shops, restaurants and supermarkets. It is definitely hilly, and cobbled stones, but a good pair of trainers or sandals you will be fine. Communication was good with Murat. We did have a power cut whilst there, but he was quick to respond. We had an excellent time and recommend this apartment.

The location was very convenient and close to lively neighborhoods, so it was easy to walk to most places. We were a group of 9, so we split in the 2 apartments. The building is old, but the apartments have been renovated and are very spacious. Overall the apartments were not very clean and could use some more care. The linens and towels were old and worn out. We had some issues with the heat and the hot water the first night, but our host fixed them as soon as possible. Overall it was an ok experience, convenient for a big group, but could be a lot better with more attention to the cleanliness and the amenities, such as towels, linens, soap, trash bags, coffee maker etc.

Murat's place is clean and beautiful, looked just like the photos, and the location is so convenient and walkable to many things - shopping, public transit, restaurants, grocery, Galata Tower, etc! First floor flat is up a flight of stairs. The area is rather hilly and streets are quite narrow, so we were really grateful to have planned a hotel transfer from the airport that delivered us right to the door of the building. Would definitely stay again!

We rented two apartments, one above the other accessed by a communal staircase. Murat was there to meet us and was very helpful with our luggage and explaining the amenities in the flats, which were very stylish and comfortable.
The flats are in a perfect location, very near to the metro (uphill) and also to the tram (downhill) which makes them ideal for travel to Sultanahmet or to Taksim and further up the Bosphorus. It is also only a couple of minutes walk to the Galata tower and nearby restaurants and shops.
We loved our stay and really hope to return before too long. Thank you Murat.

description:
Our room has a double bed, a large sofa, a TV, air conditioning, a makeup table, a balcony and an area with a view. The kitchen of the room has a stove and refrigerator, kettle and all kitchen utensils. There is also a large and spacious bathroom, a safe, hangers and a wardrobe."

It has a balcony view and offers a pleasant stay."

reviews.text:
Amazing Hotel..!
Very friendly and Helpful.
Location was very easy and almost 3 minutes to Taksim square.
10 out of 10
Many thanks frim Reza (ENGLAND v IRAN )

Mutfak kisminin kirliligi ve evin bulundugu sokagin kotu bi sokakta bulunmasi haricinde diger seyler guzeldi
