The place is clean but lacks proper arrangement. For example the Jacuzzi is not working and the place is tight.

Firat war ein freundlicher und charmanter Mann. Er war immer da, wenn wir Fragen hatten. Er hat meinen Eltern wirklich sehr geholfen, da sie weder Türkisch noch Englisch sprechen konnten. Ich kann Firat jedem empfehlen, der nach Istanbul reist!

description: The place is located in Kadıköy, on the Asian side of Istanbul. It is one of the most livable areas of the City. The neighborhood is a place where mostly young people prefer to live. It is full of cafes, pubs, and affordable restaurants you can have fun like a local do. It is well connected to other parts of the city, you can easily access ferries, metro, marmaray (train) and bus stations. Airport shuttles' last station in Kadıköy is only a 3-minute walk from my place.

reviews.text:
Mehmet was a great host. He sent me lots of instructions on how to reach the apartment and also restaurant recommendations. The house is easy to find and in an amazing location in Kadiköy. Lots of things to do very near, ferry, metro and bus stations 10 minutes away walking. To reach from the Sabiha Gökçen Airport you only need to take the M4 metro all the way to the end (Kadiköy). The walk to Mehmet's apartment is around 10 minutes.
The bed was super comfortable and smelled nice. Towels, pillows and blankets are provided and all very clean and comfy. Toilet and shower are small, but enough. Common areas are well tidy, kitchen is fully equipped and there is a cute balcony that we could not use because of the weather, but in summer might be great to have breakfast.
Thank you Mehmet for the hospitality! :)

Ali's place is conveniently located, few min away from Kadikoy ferry and bus stations. The bedroom has a comfortable double bed and a small balcony. The place is clean and neat. Ali is a welcoming, discreet, and attentive host! Great value for a short stay!

+the host is pleasant with good manners and good English
+flat is modern
+everything is clean and comfy
+bed is big and good for sleeping
+room is stylish
+location is close to havaist airport bus stop and 5-7 min walk to Bosporus ferry
+transportation is good
+we didn't have any problems with safety around that location
+enough convinient stores around (sok, a101, migros, carrefour)
+warm inside
+hot shower
so advise to stay at that place!
одни плюсы, советую для проживания:)

The location of the place is extremely convenient! It's literally 3 minutes walk to havaist/havabus parking lot, 4-5 minutes to ferry station, many restaurants and cafes nearby.
The room is clean and shiny in minimalistic style, with a comfortable large bed and access to the balcony. The windows overlook the backyard so you won't be disturbed by any noise at night which is important in such a busy city.
Mehmet is genuinely kind, caring, intelligent and easy-to-communicate person, it was a pleasure to stay in his house.
I can definitely recommend this place!

I had a short but great stay at Mehmet's place. Mehmet was very, very helpful with the indications and recommendations which I really appreciate.
The room and bed were super comfortable and the house was very clean. It was also very well connected to the metro, ferry, bus to the airport, etc. In short, the location was perfect.
I wish I had a longer stay there.
Thanks a lot for everything!

description: Our apartment is in the center of Kadıköy's new entertainment and shopping venues, within walking distance to the Marmaray and high-speed train station, close to all means of transport, the Altıyol bull and ferry port, the historical Kadıköy bazaar. 16m2 unlimited wi-fi, furnished, private shower/wc, air conditioning, Led TV, water heater, mini fridge. There is no elevator in our building. Kitchenette is in common area. ınternet speed 100mpbs

reviews.text:
First, the place: it's perfectly located in the middle of the vibrant Kadikoy area. There are plenty of shops, restaurants, and cafes at your doorstep. It's a well-appointed room with clean shared facilities (laundry, kitchen) too.
Secondly, the host: Gokalp is a very attentive and responsive host who makes a big effort to ensure you have a nice stay. He was very helpful and flexible at all times!
I would recommend this place without hesitation!

I stayed Gokalp’s place for a month and had experienced some issues.
1. A leaking roof (the bed was wet and uncomfortable to sleep) so I asked them to change the sheets.
2. Bad smell like strong peanuts (maybe because of the humidity) I asked the owner for the oil diffuser and opened the window whenever it was a good weather, but never works.
3. Insects (because of the humidity, there were some insects)
4. A/C (heater) wasn’t working. Sometimes at night, I was freezing.
However, Gokalp was very responsive and tried to fixed. Thank you so much.
Konum mükemmel, gayet temiz ve düzenli.

Considering price, that's a very good place.
Beware that kitchen and washing machine are in separate room in the basement.
It was a nice apartment with all amenities you need. The location is great.

description: A cozy comfortable room in the center of Taksim, close to everywhere. You will feel very special in the 140-year-old historical building.

reviews.text:
Clean and Cozy Stay
The space was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, ensuring a smooth check-in process. The location was convenient, with easy access to local attractions. Highly recommend for a comfortable stay!

This is an excellent and high-value Airbnb in a convenient location near Taksim Square! Easy to get around via public transport nearby and walk to the famous Istiklal Street from here. The space itself is clean and has all the key amenities for a short stay. I liked that it’s situated in a historic building as well. I had a late check-in but it was not an issue, as Fatih provided seamless self check-in instructions. The only downside to the place is that it’s quite noisy considering it’s off of a loud street (Tarlabaşi), so if you’re a light sleeper then it may bother you at times (it was okay for me).

Faitih is an amazing and welcoming host who helped us with everything from the first minute of our stay. The room was very clean, cozy and stylish in its authentic way. We really liked his attention to every detail of the room interior and even hygiene items selection! The bed was very comfortable to sleep in. Best value for money!
Fatih and his brother Eser where extremely helpful and kind, the room itself was clean and comfortable, located in a strategic spot

Place is amazing everything was as described and showed in the pictures
Easy to walk to, Fatih the host is friendly and very helpful,

description:
Welcome to our property!
Wake up to Bosphorus views and historic waterfront mansions — right in the heart of Kuzguncuk, steps from the shore. The Family Suite sleeps up to 4 guests with a double bed, a single bed, and a sofa bed. A 5th guest can be accommodated with an extra bed upon request and at an additional charge. Smart TV, air conditioning, heating, coffee machine, kettle, iron, and hair dryer included. Located on the waterfront with easy access to public transport. Family friendly.

reviews.text: the location is very good. And also communication was smooth. I could contact directly to host with phone. House was too clean and everything I need was in house already. Hot water was ready. I had good experience.

Clean and neat accommodations in a lovely neighborhood. Keep in mind that the neighborhood is a little noisy and that while street parking is free it is rarely possible given how narrow the streets are and how popular the neighborhood is. Friendly, responsive host.

Faruk's house is professionally run, and everything was as described. The apartment was clean and tidy. The house has a great location and views. While not in the most central part of Istanbul, it's in the heart of one of the most beautiful neighborhoods on the Anatolian side. I recommend it to everyone.
We stayed for just one night but we left wishing we had more time in this Airbnb! Great location, good restaurants, kind & responsive host, and comfy beds. Definitely recommend!

My husband and I had a wonderful stay at Faruk's airbnb. We were looking forward to a retreat as Istanbul is quite a busy city, and this airbnb gave us just that. It's location is wonderful (we loved Uskudar!).
As for the host- I'm very positive about Faruk and his father Mustafa. Faruk was quick in responding to text messages, and his father is a lovely man (we've spoken to him a couple of times). They were flexible in regards to our arrival and departure times.
Please note that in the description smoking is prohibited, but in the list of facilities smoking is allowed. My husband (who is asthmatic) noticed the smell of cigarettes, and an ashtray is present in the airbnb. I can imagine that it's difficult to keep guests from smoking in a city where a lot of people smoke.. for us it's not a dealbreaker, and we'll return to Faruk's airbnb in the future in case we visit Istanbul again!

description: If you stay in this place in Galata, you will be close to everywhere with your family. This airbnb is close to all historical places. If you want to explore Istanbul, this airbnb is in the right place. All public transportation is within walking distance. Please check the address before booking. ''Şahkulu Mahallesi ilk belediye caddesi Beyoğlu İstanbul''

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was excellent, making it easy to explore Istanbul.
The host was incredibly thoughtful and welcoming. He met us personally and checked us in even though we arrived late at night. We also really appreciated that he had prepared plenty of bottled water for us, which was such a nice gesture after a long trip. As a lovely surprise, he even gave us a pair of socks as a farewell gift.
Thank you for your wonderful hospitality! We would definitely recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
I had a wonderful stay here for two nights in Istanbul. Everything was excellent. The host went above and beyond to help me, even though I arrived very late due to a flight delay. He was extremely communicative, always replying quickly, and was very flexible when I had a problem with my card and needed to cancel and rebook the reservation.
When I arrived, he was waiting for me, helped me with my luggage, and welcomed me into a warm and comfortable apartment. The flat is spacious, modern, and in an absolutely perfect location, you really cannot ask for better. The heating worked well, the bed was very comfortable, and he even left water for me, which is a small detail but very much appreciated after traveling.
Before I left, he also gave me a small gift, which was a very kind and thoughtful gesture. Throughout my stay he was always available if I needed anything.

I had a wonderful stay here for two nights in Istanbul. Everything was excellent. The host went above and beyond to help me, even though I arrived very late due to a flight delay. He was extremely communicative, always replying quickly, and was very flexible when I had a problem with my card and needed to cancel and rebook the reservation.
When I arrived, he was waiting for me, helped me with my luggage, and welcomed me into a warm and comfortable apartment. The flat is spacious, modern, and in an absolutely perfect location, you really cannot ask for better. The heating worked well, the bed was very comfortable, and he even left water for me, which is a small detail but very much appreciated after traveling.
Before I left, he also gave me a small gift, which was a very kind and thoughtful gesture. Throughout my stay he was always available if I needed anything. You can tell he is very professional and truly cares about his guests.

Volkan’s place was one of our favourite during our trip to Turkey. The location is perfect for exploring Istanbul - less than a 5min walk from Galata Tower and easy transit to get to other parts of the city. The place itself is very comfortable, clean, and we felt extremely safe. Volkan was highly responsive and very friendly, making check in a breeze. We would stay here again!

This was a perfect stay for our first time in Istanbul. The neighborhood was great with a lot of shops and restaurants within walking distance. The metro was also super close by and got us to all the major attractions that we wanted to see. Volkan was an amazing host. He greeted us and explained the place. He also had bottled water for us which is just super kind and convenient. The property was in the fifth floor but it had an elevator so we had no issues going up or down. We highly recommend this place for all kinds of visitors.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place. Right behind Kanyon AVM shopping center and which has Levent metro train station connected to it. Central to Istanbul so good if you want to be close to everything

reviews.text:
The apartment was very comfortable and most of all felt like home.
kitchen was equipped with all the cooking tools and appliances needed to prepare meals , there were a lot of cleaning products available & varied. Check in & check out didn't even take time & very smoothly. The location is strategic & close to two shopping centers(ozdalik, kanyon) . I would highly recommend this flat to anyone looking for a high quality flat at an affordable price. I give Aylin 5 stars for his place. many thanks for making our stay amazing & I will definitely rent this flat again and again when I visit Istabul

My family stayed in Yusef's place for 2 weeks. The flat was very comfortable and most of all felt like home. The flat was sparkling clean, kitchen was equipped with all the cooking utensils and appliances needed to prepare meals. There were also cleaning products available. Check in & check out didn't even take a minute. The area is a very good area to stay in, there are 2 very nice malls right across the street from the flat. I will definitely rent this flat again and again when I visit Istabul. I would highly recommend this flat to anyone looking for a high quality flat at an affordable price. I give Yusef 5 stars for his place. Thank you Yusef for making our stay amazing.

Aylin's place was great. We stayed there as a family of 4, 2 adults and 2 teenagers. The mattresses in the bedrooms were comfortable and the living room had a super welcoming feel with it's big dining table and corner sofa. We felt like we were at home. The instructions given by Aylin were clear on how to get there and how to open the apartment which is located on the second floor with an elevator. The location of this apartment is perfect because it's walking distance to great restaurants, coffee places, the Kanyon shopping mall and the Levent metro station. Aylin was very kind, responsive and gave us a flexible check-in and check out! Thanks for a wonderful stay Aylin!

We stayed in Aylin’s home for more than a month, and it was such a wonderful experience. The house is spacious, clean, and had everything we needed to feel comfortable during our long stay. The location is close to shops and transportation, which made it very convenient.
Aylin is an amazing host, always kind, responsive, and ready to help whenever we needed something. Her hospitality made us feel so welcomed and at home.
After spending over a month here, we can truly say it felt like our own home. We created beautiful memories and would happily return again. Highly recommend staying at Aylin’s place if you’re visiting Turkey!

Probably the best Airbnb I've ever stayed at so far. If I'll ever come back to Istanbul, I'll do my best to book this place again. It has EVERYTHING you need, and even more. Stocked with cleaning products, essentials and toiletries, plenty of towels, 2 TVs (with Netflix included), dishwasher, fridge+freezer, washing machine with dryer, etc. The only thing I was missing was a microwave, everything else was there. I love the location too. There are 3 restaurants literally downstairs and few more very close by + a grocery store too. Aylin was very helpful and accommodating. 10/10 Airbnb.

description:
If you want an amazing view with a great entertainment you gonna love this place😉
VAT included💸

reviews.text: Fantastic peaceful location. With just a short walk into the township which had great restaurants and shops. We loved catching the ferries everywhere. Stunning View of the bridge especially at night. Apartment is actually a lot nicer than photos portray. It had everything we needed and was well supplied and clean. Bedrooms (main bedroom is large) and bathrooms are downstairs with Kitchen and living area upstairs. Only downside is there is no lift but views are certainly worth the climb.

I had a very good communication with Berk.
I recommend his house because it is well positioned and the living room and kitchen have a great view, especially at night. The mattresses are very good, you will sleep very well.
What I didn't know is that the apartment is on the 4th floor without an elevator and parking is between € 10 and €15/day. You can't find free parking spaces without paying. From the second bathroom (crowded with cleaning products) you can only use the toilet, there is no sink and the shower is not great. I was also expecting a better cleaning and fewer clothes of the owner in the closets. Overall I can recommend this place for 2 friends couples.

It really was perfect place to stay. You’re a 5 minute walk away from Besiktas but still so quiet and peaceful. They are not exaggerating about the view. It’s exactly why I chose this place and it was amazing! To get to this amazing loft, be prepared for lots of stairs, but so worth it! Our host was so helpful and welcoming. 100% I will come here again!

Berk's place was amazing. We stayed there as a family of 4, 2 adults and 2 teenagers. Everything was super clean and the 2 bedrooms were quite big. The view from the living room is absolutely stunning and the living room and kitchen space are super cosy and inviting. I could sit on the balcony for hours looking at the view of the bridge and the Bosphorus! I received clear instructions on how to get to the apartment and how to open the door. Berk also gave me recommendations for restaurants and was always very responsive. This neighborhood is a blend of local and touristic places, you can walk to many wonderful coffee places, bakeries and restaurants, we just loved it. Thank you Berk, we will be back!

Spectacular place. Plenty of room, quiet, and we felt right at home.
The views from the balcony, living room, and dining/kitchen were absolutely mesmerizing. One of the bedrooms also had a lovely view. The hot tub was great, and the beds were comfortable—great location within walking distance to restaurants, shops, and the ferry.
The hosts were helpful, accommodating, responsive, and friendly. Highly recommend this Airbnb!

description:
A one-bedroom flat designed by an award-winning architect, inside a modern residence with 24/7 security — the reassuring option if you arrive late or travel with family.

Private jacuzzi, fast WiFi, full kitchen and a lift. Osmanbey Metro is a short walk away, with a direct line to IST Airport and on to the Old City and the shopping malls. Gourmet restaurants and cafes line the surrounding streets.

Sleeps 3. Crib and baby bath available. Flexible cancellation.

reviews.text:
I had a controversial experience with this apartment. On one hand, the host was very friendly and fast responding. On the other, everything that could be wrong with the apartment, was slightly wrong. It was okay but we constantly felt like we are fighting the environment. Lift doesn't properly work, the apartment door doesn't easily open, taps are wobbly, A/C and TV remotes are not responding normally, dishes were not perfectly clean, cracks on the windows, jets of the hot tub falling off... that didn't feel quite cozy and felt overpriced
Location is pretty good, shops and supermarket near by, close to metro station. But quite far from the center

The apartment is clean, cozy, and exactly as described. It has everything needed for a comfortable stay. The neighborhood is quiet and convenient, with shops and public transport nearby. The host was always in touch, friendly, and helpful. I definitely recommend it and would love to stay here again!

Overall the stay was great. The location was close to the shops I wanted and there’s restaurants all around. The place was super clean and the sheets were fresh. The only thing I would say is the apartment looks older than it did in the photos not a big deal breaker though. There was construction right next to us so I did wake up a few times from the noise was not pleasant. There was a smell from the bathroom I’m not sure if it’s the fan that causes the smell but it would come and go.
Overall it was a good stay. Can was super helpfully and friendly replied quickly and assisted in anything I needed!

I had a lovely stay here, the receptionists were always so kind and helpful and I really appreciated it. The host was extremely responsive and available which was also great. My only real issue was that there was construction work very close by - during my entire stay - and unfortunately it was so loud that even the tv did not help. This is not the host’s fault but I wish I had known so perhaps I would have booked my stay some other time to have a more “relaxing experience”. Other than that the location is wonderful and you can easily walk to so many cute cafes, restaurants, and shops. The apartment I stayed in was definitely comfortable and cozy, and I loved using the bathtub. The pictures though need to be updated because there was no tv in the bedroom which was not an issue for me but if that’s something important to the guest I think it’s important to have an accurate photo of the current room. I am planning on coming back to Istanbul soon and will definitely be staying here again

I wasn't happy with the stay.
Many listed items on the listing were not available at check in:
Extra pillows and blanket.
Bedding and sheets were not adequate.
Shampoo & shower gel were missing.
No coffee mug, no water glass only one wine glass which was not suitable!
Also the Entrance light is not working so entrance & kitchen has no light.
One door of kitchen cabinets was broken and moving from it wasn't secured.
Bathroom sink faucet was wobbling moving from its place. Bad smell was coming from bathroom into bedroom. Bathroom door was Glass partially visible for the person in the bedroom this was annoying!
It was not well maintained apartnent.
Outdated and torn sofa.
I notified the host about all the issues he promised to fix them. Later he brought me shampoo, water glass and extra blanket & pillow. Left the other issues not fixed.
It was unfortunately unpleasant stay. I regret booking this stay. I have been using this platform for over 12 years, I rarely criticize my stay.

description:
Indulge in the exquisite allure of the ''Bestekar'' Apartment, a stunning abode that has been meticulously crafted and newly constructed in 2021.
You'll be greeted by stylish finishes and top-of-the-line appliances that are sure to make your stay comfortable and convenient. Each room is equipped with air conditioning to ensure that you have a cool stay.
Whether you're looking to relax or explore, the newly constructed ''Bestekar'' has everything you need to make the most of your stay

reviews.text: The apartment is exactly as described. Host was very responsive and communicated in a friendly way. The apartment it self was very clean with updated details and even a little amenity like slippers and some good soap products and detergent made the beginning of this stay a great one. The kitchen was equipped with all the needed kitchen supply to make some breakfast and a quick dinner when needed. I will certainly be back in touch with this host for a future stay. As it was a great experience. Clean, friendly, professional and straight forward. Location wise, want to mention that the home is located in a neighborhood that’s quite hilly. A lot and most neighborhoods near the popular attractions are. It has transportation options requiring a short walk.

Easy to find and check in. Clean apartment with plenty of natural light. Comfortable bed. Nice small balcony. Internet worked well. Washing machine could use a good clean inside but was fine. A few things to fix like the broken door handle on the balcony and a few loose hangers in the bathroom but no big deal. Communication was easy with management. Elevators in building helps alot if you have bags. Overall we would definitely come back if the price was reduced.

Stayed about 4 weeks. The apartment was clean, well-equipped (heating, washer, dishwasher, microwave, Nespresso, safe, etc), and felt secure with a daytime receptionist present. The bed was comfortable. Communication was prompt and professional with proactive follow-up. The Beşiktaş location was convenient and a good base to explore the neighborhood.

Exactly as the pictures and description. Fully equipped with everything I needed . Comfortable bed. Street parking possible. Great neighborhood.I really liked this location very much . Above all , Homie suites is the host and They really do a fantastic job. I’ve been to Istanbul over 30 times and Homie Suites apartments have become my automatic first choice. I highly recommend .

The place was very clean and similar to the pictures. Homie suites staff was very responsive and helped me with various things especially when my parents came and I needed to switch to a bigger apartments they did that and refunded me for the days that I wasn't going to be in the first unit. They provided me with extra towels and even an inflatable bed. I also liked the neighborhood, all the basics are around the corner.

description: You will stay with your family with peace of mind, with our sincere style and sincere conversation, we offer hospitality in the comfort of your own home...

reviews.text: We really loved staying in this charming house for two nights. The location is amazing and the hosts were always so kind, friendly and helpful. The rooms are beautifully decorated, great hot shower, cute little balcony and we really enjoyed taking breakfast there. Bear in mind that it’s an old house with thin walls, so bring earplugs! Apart from that, this place is a real treat and a perfect base to explore beautiful Büyükada!

Tam anlamıyla büyülendik. Konumu merkezi olması sayesinde her yere kolayca ulaşabildik. Damla Hanım bize sanki ailelerinden biri gibi çok kibar davrandı. Odalar temiz ve rahattı, sabah eşsiz bir manzaraya günaydın dedik. Kahvaltıda her bir lezzet özenle hazırlanmıştı ve kahvaltımızı portakal ağacının başucunda balkonumuzda ettik. Restoran fiyatları İstanbula göre çok makuldu. Mimar ve Tarihçi bir çift olarak otelin tarihi dokusu ve mimari detayları ise bizi gerçekten etkiledi; özellikle portakal ağacının restore edilmiş yapıya ahengi bizi büyüledi. Yapıya son derece naif bir restorasyon anlayışıyla yaklaşılması ekstra mutlu etti. Odadaki küçük detaylar, sanki bizim için özel olarak düşünülmüş gibi hissettirdi. Oda kış ayı için oldukça iyi ısınıyordu, ısınma problemi olmadı. Tek küçük dezavantajı, odanın göründüğünden biraz dar olmasıydı. Erkek arkadaşımla bu otelde geçirdiğimiz zamanı çok sevdik, bize eşsiz bir deneyim ve romantik bir tatil yaşattı. Tekrar geleceğiz, çok teşekkürler..

Absolutely lovely and charming place. This boutique hotel felt like a cozy bed and breakfast. The breakfast was delicious and the hosts welcoming. It was easy to get to - just a short walk from the Büyükada port. It was peaceful and quiet. Would love to return sometime!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at No.16 Butik. Damla was a great host - friendly and always available in person and before we arrived on the app to answer questions. They kindly took our bags for safekeeping before checkin so we could explore the island without carrying our things. They also offered a list of recommended cafes, restaurants and sights to see, which we used and were really pleased with them all!
The room was very cute, very clean and fit for purpose - as seen in pictures. Only very small suggestions to improve an already lovely space was upgrade a few fixtures such as bathroom door.
Our room had a private balcony overlooking the garden and a gorgeous orange tree - a perfect spot for breakfast and evening drinks - where we chose to eat our breakfast each morning. The breakfast was delicious and very filling!
I’d recommend to friends - it’s a very sweet butik (boutique) in a calm street and lovely host.

Her şey çok güzeldi. Fotograflardan farkı yok bizimle çok ilgilendiler. Kahvaltıları harika. Ada havası bizi biraz çarptı o yüzden acele çıktık ertesi gün ama nerdeyse odayı temizleyip daha da düzenlemek istedim çünkü hakediyorlar. Konumu merkezi. Her yer mis gibi tertemiz. Huzurlu bir konaklama için gönül rahatlığıyla gidebilirsiniz.

description:
Available for stays longer than 100 days.

Located in a historic building, this modern studio offers ideal accommodation for those wishing to explore the vibrant atmosphere of Beyoğlu. With high brick details, warm wood textures, and carefully selected decorative elements, you'll enjoy a space that is both characterful and comfortable. A fully equipped kitchenette, a comfortable sleeping area, a relaxation corner, and a modern bathroom make it suitable for extended stays.

reviews.text:
The check-in went smoothly. Everything was as the owner explained. The building is very old and not suitable for strollers. The apartment was tidy, but there was quite a bit of dust, which caused runny noses and sneezing for me and my son. Later, I wrote a message to the owner, and the next day someone came to clean, and it was much better.
The shower in the bathroom is poorly adjusted and needs repair. There is always hot water. All necessary appliances are in the kitchen.
The location is great, about a 10-minute walk to Istiklal Street, and it’s very quick to get to Taksim or the tunnel.
All in all, I wouldn’t recommend the apartment for families with small children neither for single women since it can be quite dark in the evenings but for a couple or a single person, I think it would be a good accommodation in line with the price we paid.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great, and everything we needed was provided. The host was friendly and responsive. We would happily stay here again!

I stayed in this apartment for 10 days and had a great experience. The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. All the essentials were provided, making the stay easy and enjoyable.
The host was friendly, responsive, and professional, which I really appreciated. The location was convenient and the apartment was relaxing.
Overall, I was very satisfied with my stay and would definitely recommend this place to other guests.

We had a great stay at this property.
Pros
- Place is same as the pictures
- host was accomodating with storing our bags before check in and after checkout
- Extremely clean
- Great Wifi
- Perfect to stay for a long period as well
- kitchen is equipped with all appliances.
Cons
- The building seemed a little old
- it's quite internal on the road so have to walk 5-6 mins to reach istiklal or the busstop
- The lane is a little dingy, scary to walk alone at night and a little smelly but once inside makes no difference at all.
the house and building entrance makes it very safe inside.
also if you're with someone there's nothing to worry about. also the people are really sweet so we didn't have any bad experiences but it's just better to be safe.

Our stay was absolutely perfect! The apartment matched the photos exactly and was spotlessly clean, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. The neighborhood was friendly, safe, and lively, even late at night, which made exploring Istanbul so much more enjoyable.
The host was incredibly friendly, responsive, and helpful throughout our stay, ensuring that everything went smoothly.
I highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul—it exceeded our expectations in every way!

description:
If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family.

Right next to the subway, Taksim, Nişantaşı, many shopping malls are within a five-minute walk. The apartment has two bedrooms and a sofa that can be two beds. The apartment has air conditioning in two bedrooms. It is suitable for families, clean and safe. Everything you need is provided for you in the apartment. We wish you a pleasant stay in our apartment, which will be as comfortable as your home.
(Wifi-towel-slippers-)

reviews.text:
Excellent location, with a lift and very close to the metro station.
Even though the apartment I stayed in was not the same as the one shown in the pictures — it wasn’t facing the street — it had comfortable mattresses and pillows, and clean bed sheets.
The kitchen appliances were very basic (there were no wine glasses or frying pan).
The place deserves better finishing and maintenance (for example, the skirting boards were missing or only partially installed).
What bothered me was that there were no blackout curtains in the rooms, so the sunlight came in very early.

The apartment is modest and small, with two very small bedrooms and a tiny bed that may fit two people. The living room has a couch that can be used as an extra bed.
A key drawback is that there is only one bathroom, which could be problematic for four occupants.
On the positive side, the location is excellent - near Nişantaşı and Şişli streets, and very close to a supermarket and Starbucks. The neighborhood is considered safe for a family with children.
The apartment has air conditioning and an elevator, but the AC units were not cooling well and had issues, requiring the filters to be cleaned. After cleaning by us, the AC worked properly, suggesting maintenance problems.
Overall, the apartment has both pros and cons, and the air conditioning system should be thoroughly inspected before renting

I recently stayed at this accommodation and overall, I had a pleasant experience. The location is absolutely perfect, offering easy access to everything I needed during my stay.
The apartment itself is spacious and has a lot of potential. However, there were a few details that were missing which could have enhanced the overall experience. Nightstands and bedside lamps would have been convenient additions, as well as some storage space in the bathroom for towels and toiletries. Additionally, having a few basic kitchen essentials like knives and a frying pan would have been helpful.
While the industrial style of the apartment is trendy, some areas could benefit from a bit more attention to detail to achieve a more polished look. One notable aspect was the lack of natural light, which made the space feel a bit dim at times.
On the positive side, the linens were clean and the host was incredibly kind and accommodating. With a few improvements in terms of amenities and attention to details.

Perfect location, close to all restaurants, coffee shops and shopping areas. 1 min walk to metro station. House was very clean and comfortable. Burak was super helpful and assisted when needed. Highly recommended especially if you are looking for an apartment that is in a quiet area yet very close to all attractions.

Amazing apartment exactly like photos😍, amazing location very centrally located next to great shops & restaurants
Thank you Burak for being such a helpful & responsive host, will recommend your flat to everyone for sure
Will definitely go back here everytime i come to Istanbul👌

description:
Hello, I’m Sadik. I have been hosting you since 2019 to provide you with a perfect Istanbul experience. This flat is right in the heart of Cihangir (innovative district of Istanbul), which has a very central location.
Here is the list of things you can do by walking
10 minutes from the apartment :)
You can be in Galata Port, Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, take a tram to Hagia Sophia or Topkapi Palace, enjoy the Bosphorus with Turkish coffee, hang out in innovative bars.

reviews.text:
My reviews for Sadik house is excellent. The house is as described in the pictures. Neat clean. Towels and extra bedsheet available. Kitchen and AC is perfect. Sadik was a great helpful host. His house was perfect and our stay was very comfortable.
Issues with building and location:
1) It has a small lift and it was hard to fit our graco baby stroller inside out. We have to take two turns to enter and exit the lift
2) there few stairs entering the building and than again few more stairs to go the lift so family people with baby strollers or wheelchair will be difficult
Lastly the apartment is on a steep hill and again with baby strollers it difficult to go to Takism or the tram. Climbing up and down is very steep and dangerous with cars moving around. We had to do taxi everyday to go out and come back home.
Lastly the apartment was excellent for people without kids.

My wife and I stayed here for about a month. The location is in the heart of Cihangir with very good access to public transportation. Like most of the neighborhood, it’s very hilly. Walking to Taksim is mostly uphill with a lot of stairs, while walking down to Kabataş is easier. That’s just part of staying in Cihangir and makes it convenient to access the ferries, trams, and buses.
Sadik was very responsive and quick to help whenever we needed anything.
The apartment is smaller than it appears in the photos. The furniture and bed are dated and could be updated. The shower had some mold that should be cleaned. It’s suitable for one or two people.
The internet connection was reliable. There is a small table for working, but the limited space makes it less practical if you’re working remotely. There is one air conditioner in the main living area.
Overall, I would recommend it and will be back for a short stay because of the location and the responsive host.

I had a wonderful stay at Sadık's place and would definitely stay there again! The apartment matches the description and is even better than the pictures. It feels like being at home, you'll find everything you need for a comfortable stay. If planning a long-term stay, you'll have nothing to worry. There's a washing/drying machine, and a well-equipped kitchen to cook your own meals if you prefer. There are grocery shops and markets nearby to stock up. If you don't want to cook, there are affordable restaurants in the neighborhood too... all within walking distance. The location is great, a safe neighborhood that's well connected to tourist areas but remains quiet and peaceful compared to busier tourist spots. Tram and bus stops are close and easy to reach. I ejoyed my stay very much and I appreciated the details like extra chargers, cooking ingredients and bathroom items readily available. Special thanks to Sadık for being such a great host: friendly, responsive and helpful!

It has been a pleasure to stay at Sadik’s flat in Istanbul! The flat is located perfectly, at a quiet street very close to all public transport stops and the seaside and 2 mins away from a lively neighborhood with coffee shops, bars and nice local places. The flat is small, but was enough for us as a couple. The bed is comfortable, the kitchen has everything for cooking, shower is clean.
Sadik is a great host, he helped us to check in and was always available for our questions.

I had a wonderful stay in this beautifully decorated apartment in the heart of Cihangir, Beyoğlu. The location is absolutely perfect—close to everything, yet peaceful and charming. The apartment was exactly as described, clean, stylish, and very comfortable.
What truly made the experience special was the host—warm, welcoming, and always ready to help with anything I needed. You can really feel that they care about their guests.
I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would love to stay here again in the future!

description: Enjoy our 80m2 home centrally located and with special decor. You will stay in a peaceful house overlooking Kadıköy, open in front, overlooking the sea from Fenerbahçe stadium and fashion. 8 min walk to the metrobus, metro and marmar. We invite you to have a peaceful experience in our home, whose interior design is thoughtfully made and full of details in every corner. We would like to remind you that we only allow cigarettes on the balcony, as we sometimes use our home as well. Please send us a photo of your passport.

reviews.text:
I stayed at Selim and Billur's apartment for one month. The apartment is just as the photos indicate bright, sunny, spacious, with an excellent kitchen for cooking and a spectacular view. My cat, also my travel companion, loved their apartment. The balcony has been safely secured with netting so cats can follow the birds every day.
The location is around a 12 min walk to a main metro/train/bus/metro bus station, Söğütlüçeşme, in Kadikoy and a 20 min. walk to the ferry to the European side. This is the older part of Kadikoy where I found a Bohemian area with artists, cafes and nomads and where I worked many days.

When I moved in we had a problem with communication, that was resolved and both Selim and Billur were responsive and helpful throughout my stay. The apartment is on the top floor with a 5 story climb, so travel light.
Billur and Selim are two of the nicest hosts I've had with Airbnb which made my stay memorable and pleasant.

I stayed in Selim's place for a month in November to work on a writing project: beautiful view, excellent weather, and good company in seagulls and plants. Walkable to the Kadikoy ferry port, cafes in Moda, Kadikoy carisi (book bazaar is cool!), and many food stores. Even a nearby organic mezze cafe! Kitchen had all necessary equipment, wifi was strong for video calls, and the place was SUPER clean.
Selim is an easy, regular, and helpful communicator. He even shared a recorded video tour before I arrived! Highly recommend him as a host.
A note for future guests: The stairs to the top floor were not insignificant. I found myself running errands maximum 2 times/day so I didn't have to climb the stairs a 3rd time. I would recommend entering / exiting building on the "back side" (up the hill) instead of only accessing the building from the front (which means additional stairs to the building door). Of course, your legs and back may be stronger than mine!
Would definitely return again!

A truly wonderful stay. The apartment is cozy, bright, comfortable, and spotlessly clean. It does not feel like another faceless, soulless Airbnb, it feels like a real home that people once lived in and genuinely cared about.
The location is excellent: quiet and slightly removed from the busiest areas, while still very close to major transport links. There are plenty of shops, cafés, and restaurants nearby.
Everything in the apartment feels new and well maintained, and the balcony view is gorgeous. The hosts were exceptionally hospitable, responsive, and helpful throughout the stay.
The only thing to keep in mind is that the apartment is on the fifth floor and there is no elevator, which may be difficult for some guests.
This will be the first place I check the next time I am in Istanbul. Highly recommended.

This is the BEST airbnb I have ever stayed in. I felt like home right from the helpful and responsive check-in when I landed in the middle of the night. The apartment has the most breathtaking view of the city. You really can't get better than this. Most days I'd spend in the apartment, drinking tea and just admiring the view. There is everything you could possibly need - from kitchen to bathroom amenities, to a comfortable bed, to a functional desk where I spent most days writing. It was really hard to leave this play. Selim gave me some amazing local recommendations and made sure I had everything I needed, and even checked in on me in the beginning to make sure I was all settled in. I know I will be back in the future - 1 month was not enough. If you're unsure, just book it! It was 100% worth it, and made my time in Kadıköy so special. It's a great neighborhood and everything you need is right there.

I thoroughly enjoyed my month in this apartment. It is very comfortable, spacious and bright. The kitchen is well equipped and the bedroom has loads of storage space. The house plants help to give the apartment a homely feel. The views from this top floor apartment are fantastic, Fenerbahce Stadium and the sea just beyond.
The area is lovely and people are very friendly. Selim was the perfect host, very attentive and helpful. I would highly recommend this place.

description: In this apartment, which is centrally located and has a separate entrance, you can have a stylish and peaceful stay in this apartment, which includes all kinds of facilities and all basic materials, whether for long or short-term stays. You can find air conditioning, fireplace, Netflix and smart TV, fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, dryer, dishwasher, Wi-Fi and 24/7 support.

reviews.text:
The area is beautiful and very convenient, everything is so close, ferry, buses, restaurants, cafés, pharmacies, hammam, laundry... It's literally the dream neighborhood to live in, if you're tired and don't want to take the ferry to the European side, just walking around Kadiköy will give you the best day. We loved every second of it.
Unfortunately, the house wasn't as we imagined or as it was pictured in the photos. I don’t think the host cleaned before our arrival. There was dust in every corner, and I have pictures to confirm it. There were trash and empty bottles under the beds, dead bugs under the heaters, and the stairs were dusty with stains on the floor. the tea kettle was rusted, so we couldn’t use it. We didn’t have any extra essentials, we stayed for almost two weeks, we had to buy many things ourselves and ask the host to bring extra sheets and pillowcases. He did bring them eventually but it would have been more considerate and professional of him if he thought about it

We stayed for one week in July and Yasin was a very polite and helpful host and gave us clear instructions about entering the property on arrival. He was quick to accommodate some extra requirements for my elderly relatives. The flat is perfect for those with mobility issues as a double bedroom, kitchen and bathroom are all on the flat, and there are only two steps upto the front door. The bedroom downstairs features a double and single bed.
The flat is in a historic area of Kadıköy, and only a short downhill walk to the busy seafront, where there is an overwhelming choice of cafes and restaurants. It's also a major transport hub with buses, dolmushes and ferries. If you walk uphill from the flat you arrive in the beautiful district of Yeldeğirmeni which is quite a creative community and has a lovely village feel with beautiful old houses and buildings and cafes, restaurants and small shops.

Pros- Yasin was really informative and helpful. His place was decently clean and it’s an old place so bathroom was okaish with grout dirt but generally clean. The bedrooms was clean and what was expected. Transportation was good and there were a few restaurants around.
Cons- the only thing is the washing machine and dryer wasn’t working. I would like to inform you guys about the surrounding of the apartment. The neighborhood is not clean and up-to-date.
Overall, I recommended Yasin’s place.
Clean, comfortable and flexible check in. Yasmin was very responsive. In a really nice area, with lots of cool cafes and bars nearby. Thanks :)

Ailemle birlikte üç gece konakladığımız bu daireden son derece memnun kaldık. Beş kişi rahatlıkla sığabildik ve odalar oldukça temizdi. Özellikle araba ile geldiğimiz için otopark konusunda bize yardımcı olan Yasin Bey'e çok teşekkür ederiz. Konumu çok merkezi olduğundan aracımızı dört gün boyunca hiç kullanma ihtiyacı duymadık. Her yere ulaşım oldukça kolaydı. Yasin Bey'in ilgisi ve misafirperverliği sayesinde konaklamamız çok keyifli geçti. Herkese tereddütsüz tavsiye ediyorum!

description: Our apartments are distinguished by the spacious area suitable for family residence, as it contains all the necessary necessities for a comfortable and happy stay, where you feel as if you are in your own home. We also have a 24/24 reception desk to secure the needs of guests at any time, and the entire building contains a security system and cameras that work around the clock In addition to the availability of the Internet throughout the hotel, also the apartments have amazing city view

reviews.text: This is our second time staying at hexa suites in the same month. Our second visit to Istanbul we knew we wanted to stay here with no second thoughts. We were very happy with our stay the first time and nothing else seemed like a better choice. You can’t get a better location, walking distance to the metro and lots of cafes and restaurants all around, very lively area. Also if you have a car this place offers free parking which is rare to find. The apartment was squeaky clean both times and very comfortable. The staff are friendly and helpful and there’s someone in reception 24/7. We love this place and would definitely choose it again.

My family and I stayed at Hexa suites and were very happy with our stay! The place was very spacious and clean and looked exactly like photos. We were especially happy with the level of service and hospitality, the staff were very helpful and accommodating! We will definitely be coming back next time we’re in Istanbul.
incredible service, the place was exactly as described and in a great location. the staff were very helpful and accommodating. I highly recommend and will definitely book again when in Istanbul.

We had to change rooms as the first suite was too dirty, toilet was broken and the other bathroom door didnt close at all. Sofa had cigarette stains/holes in it. Management was great in getting us a new room and that was fine. Dont miss the note that the place allows smoking as I did, as you can smell it. Management and hotel staff were the highlight of the stay, super nice and helpful

Hello!
We were a larger group that stayed at Hexa suits for 10 days.
The staff were super nice, flexible with a manned reception around the clock. We want to give an extra blow to Riad who worked at the reception in the evening.
He was so good to be around.
He was honest, loyal and very helpful.
He was always nice and extremely respectful. We always took the opportunity to ask our questions when he was on duty.
Thank you!
With kind regards, the Adeli family

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: Ev sahibi çok nazik ve samimiydi, iletişim çok kolaydı. Oda çok temiz ve rahattı. Resepsiyona her zaman ulaşılabilirdi. Konumu harikaydı; metroya çok yakın, çevre sakin ve güvenliydi. Kendimi hep rahat ve güvende hissettim. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim! :)
Fiyatına göre gayet iyi bir yerdi konumu olaraksa gayet iyi bir konumdaydı ev sahibi gayet anlayışlı ve isteklerimizi çabuk bi şekilde çözerek ihtiyaçlarımızı karşıladı

Banyoda duş kısmında kıl vardı , yatakta ve yastıkta kir izleri vardı , en önemlisi gece boyu şap şap su damlası banyonun tavanından yerlere su aktı ve her yer ıslandı, banyoda duş jeli veya şampuan yoktu bunu söylediğimde bana marketten alabilirsiniz market yakında var dendi ,
Gayet güler yüzlü insanlardı her şey görsellerdeki gibi birebir aynıydı metroya 5 dk yürüme mesafesiydi kısaca fiyat performans olarakta çok memnun kaldık
konumu, iletişimi, temizliği her şeyi güzeldi sadece giriş katı olduğu için dışardan ses geliyordu onun dışında gayet kalınabilir bir yer ve kesinlikle parasını hak ediyor.

description: 1 bedroom 1 living room Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located peaceful place. Pool, billiards, gym, 24/7 security

reviews.text: Öğrenci olarak sınav haftamızda kalmak için gelmiştik ve Mehmet Bey bize çok da bilmediğimiz İstanbulda çok yardımcı oldu. Ev tertemizdi ve Gedik üniversitesine 5dk lik yürüme mesafesindeydi. Havaalanı ve YHT istasyonuna oldukça yakın olması da ayrıca iyiydi. Öte yandan oldukça güvenlikli ve nezih bir konaklama yeriydi. Mehmet Bey her konuda elinden geldiğince yardımcı oldu. Bu açılardan sanırım istanbula tekrar gelişimde başka bir yerde kalmak istemem. Mehmet Beye sunduğu imkanlar ve temiz kalpli yardımlarından çok teşekkür ediyorum. Tereddütsüz seçebilirsiniz. Ekstra olarak ev fotoğraflardakinden çok daha rahat ve konforlu.
Nice flat, good house and comfortable location. Host was very responsive. Very comfortable check in and check out.

Mehmet, he is nice and friendly person. His place is clean and comfortable . It is close to Sabiha Airport and Pendik market, metro and Yht tran station. Walkable distance to Burger King and restaurants. There is Security 24 hours, and amazing pool playground. Highly Recommended.
Ev tamamen fotoğraflardaki gibiydi aradığımız her şeyi rahatlıkla bulduk rahat ve konforluydu fiyatını hakeden bir yerdi.

The place is in great location, it’s close to everything in Kartal. What caught my attention is that it’s unlike every apartment I stayed at in Turkey noise wise. It’s very quiet and peaceful. The view from living room’s window is beautiful. Also the owner was very welcoming and friendly, thanks a lot Mr Mehmet.

description:
Galata Design Hotel serves its guests with rooms designed in different styles. This room has a TV, satellite channels, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, wardrobe, heating, minibar, private bathroom and a bathtub exclusive to this room. A mixed breakfast is served in the Lounge Cafe on the ground floor.
The historical scent identified with the cobblestone pavements is located 100 m from the famous and historical Galata Tower.

reviews.text: SAMIR was an amazing host. After a long day of traveling he allowed us to check in early and even helped with our luggage. They stored our suitcases as well for us they day we left which allowed us to explore area a bit more stress free. The hotel is perfectly located on same street as the Galata tower. Room was clean, I felt safe and comfortable and it was priced perfectly!

negative - The hot water is enough to have shower, but not enough to use the Bath Tub.
Positive - The Staff was brilliant and respectfully served my expectations in the accommodation. the confort of the air conditioning, bed, towels, cleaning was perfect.
traveling dates - 8-10 Jan 24
Enjoy your trip :D
fiyat performans olarak gayet iyiydi, konum olarakta çok iyi bulması kolaydı.
Yeri cok iyiydi, fiyat performans bir yer, terasli odada kaldik terasi galata kulesine bakiyor her sey güzeldi tavsiye ederim
El lugar es increíble, muy cercano de una estación de metro e increíbles lugares en estambul. 100% recomendado a un gran precio.

description: Enjoy simplicity and style at this peaceful, central location! Housed in a new, earthquake-resistant building, it features modern amenities. The light-filled living room boasts tasteful decor and comfy seating. A fully equipped kitchen includes high-end appliances. The bedroom offers a cozy bed with luxurious linens and various pillows for comfort.

reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment was very clean and spacious with a wonderful garden view. The security helped us with luggage and parking in the garage below apartment. Very comfortable sofa and bed. The kitchen is beautiful with adequate space for cooking and well stocked with utensils. The shower head has an amazing massage setting. Very quiet area, but just a 7 minute walk to busy Galata Tower area. Selin was very kind and helpful with local tips. The coffee shop downstairs is the best in the area. 5 stars to Seline!

We stayed for six nights in September 2024, the apartment was easy to find and ideally situated to explore Istanbul by foot or public transport. The apartment was spotlessly clean and exactly as shown in the images, the kitchen appliances, and bathroom fixtures and fittings are very high quality, and appear to be brand new. The kitchen is well equipped with all you need for cooking although there are excellent restaurants and cafes nearby if you prefer. There is aircon in the lounge and bedroom which was a blessing and we slept well as there was no noise at all during the night and the large bed was very comfortable. The early call to prayer was barely audible at 5am and did not disturb us. There is 24 hour security at the entrance which was a comfort although the area is perfectly safe for a major city. Selin was friendly and proactive, and we would not hesitate to recommend staying with her. Thank you Selin!

Our stay at Selin’s apartment was great from start to finish. The location is ideal: a short walk from Galata Tower, Karaköy, Istanbul Modern, restaurants, cafés, and the T1 tram that quickly takes you to Sultanahmet (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, etc). Although very central, the apartment is also peaceful with lovely garden views (some construction work notwithstanding) and well shielded from street noise.
The apartment was spotless, spacious and modern - just as pictured - with everything we needed. We enjoyed the balcony, the well-equipped kitchen (we used this a few times during our stay), and the comfortable bed.
Selin was a friendly and responsive host. When feet-on-the-ground were needed the complex's door staff were always obliging.
We highly recommend Selin's apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul and would gladly stay here again.

Great apartment!!! It was nicely decorated, well equipped, and in an amazing location. The price was also definitely below average. We stayed at a different apartment for a few days at a higher price, and it was extremely disappointing in terms of cleanliness and kitchen supplies.
Highly recommended…Selin was also very responsive

Great apartment, everything is as in the photographs. It located just 300 meters from Istiklal Street, but at the same time in a very quiet place! The apartment is clean, has everything you need, and is equipped with excellent air conditioning!
I recommend visiting this apartment ;)

description:
This room in our Büyükada Çınar Hotel 2 branch is located on the 3rd floor and has a balcony facing the back facade that belongs only to the room. There is a bus stop near the hotel. It is located within a 1-minute walk to the pier.
You'll love the stylish decor of this charming accommodation.

*Each individual must present their ID or passport at the entrance to the facility. Guests under the age of 19 are not accepted.

reviews.text: Gayet temiz bir oda, konumu ise rahat ulaşılabilir bir noktada idi. Odanın çok küçük olması ve duvarların inceliğinden fazla ses geçirmesi eksik yönleri idi ama kısa süreli konaklamalar için gayet uygun bir konaklama alanı. Ev sahibimizin iletişimi gayet hızlı ve çözüme yönelikti. Teşekkürler.
Odalar fotoğraflardan biraz küçüktü fakat temiz ve konforluydu. Personel iletişimi güzel ve kibardı. Fiyat performans diyebiliriz

Konum oldukça merkezi, oda çok temiz ve oldukça güvenliydi biraz küçüktü ama alan gayet iyi değerlendirildiği için bu hiç sorun olmadı. Kusursuz bir şekilde giriş ve çıkış yaptık. Konaklama boyunca oldukça konforlu hissettik. Martılar dışında ses yapan hiçbir şey yoktu 😊 Çalışanlar oldukça yardımsever ve iletişime açıklardı. Gönül rahatlığı ile hiç düşünmeden tekrar tekrar kalabileceğim bir yer oldu burası.

Haftasonu Büyükada'da yapılacak gezintiler için ideal bir konaklama yeri. İskeleye yakın, temiz, sessiz, sakin ve huzurlu bir konumu var. Odalar fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi derli toplu ve temiz dolayısıyla konaklama yaparken evde gibi hissedeceğiniz yerlerden birisi, teşekkürler👍🏻

Location, room and host was great. In 2 minutes you are in street and almost everything is near to hotel. He speak Turkish, English so anyone easily can communicate. I would definitely advise to anyone who is visiting Büyükada.

description:
Experience the vibrant heart of Istanbul with a stay in this charming Airbnb flat located on a lively street with restaurants and bars just a few meters away from the famous Istiklal Street in Taksim.

This cozy one bedroom flat features a private terrace that's perfect for enjoying the warm Turkish sun. Also a comfortable living room with AC, a kitchen with a mini fridge, a washing machine, coffee machine, and a barbeque on the terrace, as well as a Smart TV for your entertainment.

reviews.text: Communication was good, check in straightfwd, location excellent. Apartment was clean and well presented generally as per the photos, apart from the lack of the sun lounger on balcony. We knew we were above a lively area so expected noise into the ealry hours, although maybe not till 6am for each of the 7 nights however this was managable as it was a more distant noise. The single biggest issue we had was the constant 'yapping' of a dog in the apartment below. It would appear our neighbours practice was to leave it alone all night and come in and sort it around 5.30am most mornings. I'm not sure how much our host can do about this BUT bookers should be aware that this could be a real issue to deal with in a multi apartment block. I would still recommend staying at Merve's place as we still had a great time in Istanbul and the apartment in balance was great value for money.

Large comfortable top floor studio with large sunny balcony centrally located in Taksim. Great shopping, restaurants and bars all around very lively area. Apartment has everything you need and good internet...had no problems with video calls. Building has an elevator but still need to climb two flights of stairs. As others mentioned there is significant bass noise from the after hours night clubs in the area that start at 2am-6am...other noise from neighbors in the building is also significant but host took action to try and resolve. Ear plugs may be a solution. Over all if you want to have some fun in a party area with lots to do for a couple nights it's a great location and good place for that.

This is my second time staying in this apartment. I felt like I was at home. Very clean, cozy, comfortable furniture, the apartment has everything you might need (washing machine, iron, ironing board), elevator, huge sunny terrace. Very central location, caring and easy-to-communicate hostess. Thank you, Merve, and see you again next time.

Öncelikle 6 gece kaldığımız ev de Tolga bey çok yardımcı oluştu erken giriş sağladı valizleri erken koyma imkanı verdi çıkışta da aynı şekilde geç çıkışa izin verdi ve sorulara çok hızlı be ilgili cevap verdi teşekkürler. Evin fotoğrafları ve gerçek hali çok benzer ama biraz farklı birçok ampul patlak çok rahatsız etmiyor ama televizyon üstündeki tek beyaz ışık rahatsız edici(heryer sarı loş ışık kullanılmış) evin içinde aksesuarlar ufak tefek farklı ama çok da önemli değil benim için en can sıkıcı şey balkondu ilk olarak kapıdı dışardan açılabiliyor ve görsel ile balkonun alakası yoktu ve pisti belki kış olduğu için bazı şeyleri kaldırmışlardır ama zeminde rengi değişikti istediğim verimi alamadım. Bunlar çok önemli değil ama ne olursa olsun dürüstlük için önemli ev sahibine şikayet değil öneri olarak yazıyorum. Ev güzeldi temizdi konumu muhteşem heryere yakındı ama yüksek ses den rahatsız olan uyuyamayan için sıkıntı ama taksim meydanındasın ses olması gayet normal çok güzeldi tşkler

There is a flight of stairs to get to the lift which goes up to 4th floor only and the apartment is on 5th floor. The apartment definitely needs maintenance, it is not as nice as shown in the pictures but the location is good in terms of transport. However, there is a lot of noise at night from a Club/Bar nearby, we could hear the loud music. The balcony is not nice, there was a drip coming from the gutter and so there was always water on the floor. The bathroom door does not shut properly and the floor tiles to the entrance of the bathroom are broken. The wardrobe has hangers but you cannot hang clothes because there is no rail. There is no a proper cooker, only a two ring hob of which one does not work, it also looks very old.

description:
Ideal for visiting Istanbul in an easy and fun way. In the center.
Apartment in Taksim area. on the 4th floor with elevator. Main artery of tourist interest. Very well placed in the heart of entertainment, shopping and art. At Taksim Square, 1 minute from Istiklal shopping and cultural street. Close to the metro, the dolmus and the bus. At the foot of all shops. In a luxury Rococo style building. Around restaurants, supermarkets, banks and currency exchange.

reviews.text: Hürrem and her husband Dundar were really great hosts. I stayed with my family for three nights in April/May 2023. The apartment was clean and as shown in the pics. The location is excellent, right at the Taxim Square. The hosts welcomed us with the gift. They were responsible and responsive within minutes. The location is peaceful enough during the night even though it is in the center of the nightlife. We felt safe and secure, with the entrance door to the bld locked during the night amidst the busy Taxim. Spacious apartment, newly refurbished, with lots of light, spotlessly clean, on the 4th floor, with the elevator, dark curtains for providing complete dark for comfortable sleep in the morning made our stay more than pleasant and enjoyable! The apartment is fitted in a fashionable way, well-designed interior, with an eye for detail! We did not miss a single thing. We would definitely like to come back! It is worth every penny! Thank you, Hurrem and Dundar, for your hospitality!

Host (Hurrem) was very cooperative. Apartment was in excellent condition, neat and clean. All the basic requirements like accessories in kitchen, bed rooms and in lounge were available which make stay very comfortable. Location was excellent as it's close to Taskim square(2 mins walk). One can enjoy the lively night life of Istanbul at Taskim. Apartment is bit expensive but worthy to stay. Highly recommended to have stay

I would like to thank the host and his crew for all the support. The property matches the photos and it’s very well located. Easy to access to plenty of options regarding the public transportation and also the taksim square and istiklal avenue. Despite the area is quite busy there was no annoying sound. The air conditioning situation was also pretty good. The room doesn’t have air conditioners inside but right in front of it there is an air conditioning system, also there is a fan in the room which we didn’t even use.
Bathroom and toilet were clean and there are also plenty of towels. Everything during the stay was nice and good. The apartment itself has almost everything you need and also you have access to many supermarkets and restaurants nearby.
All in all, for us it was very nice.

Great stay overall, everything went very smoothly. The apartment fully matched the Airbnb description and photos: clean, cozy, and conveniently located. Mert was very responsive, always available, and quick to help with any questions.
It would also be helpful to mention the boiler and the hot water capacity in the listing description. On our first night, we unintentionally used up all the hot water 😅, so having that information in advance would make things much easier for future guests.
Other than that, everything was excellent, and we would happily stay here again.

I stayed in this apartment for one week and overall, it was a excellent experience. The apartment was causy very clean and fully equipped with everything I needed, including a washing machine, a complete kitchen, and air conditioning. Very good internet .The location was excellent—close to Taksim and public transportation and shops—which made it easy to get around and buy necessities.
The host was helpful and responsive whenever I had questions or requests. The area was quiet, which allowed me to relax and get good rest.
Overall, I would recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a comfortable stay in a convenient location in Istanbul.
lf I come next time I will stay in this apartment.

description: The apartment is just 5 minutes walking away from the Grand Bazaar and 15 minutes walking away from the Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. The area is safe and full of hotels. Walking distance to nightlife, restaurants and other attractions. Our place is suitable for couples, solo adventurers, corporate travelers, families (children). Free WiFi, TV, Hair Dryer, Kettle, Non-smoking Room, Central Heating System, 24-Hours Hot Water, Microwave.

reviews.text: I am very satisfied about this kind place. They are very helpfull ! Perfect bamboo matras. Very clean ! Thx for making it us comfortable !
Such a lovely host super responsive and kind ) place was spotless
Host is very nice and helpful
