description:
Our room is luxurious, modern and carefully designed. Located in our hotel, this room has a large double bed, a 43-inch smart television and a private bathroom. Our room has a small kitchen with a mini fridge and small kitchen supplies.
Our room is on the 2nd floor. There is a 24/7 camera and security system. The exterior door of the building is specially coded and protected. Our room is designed to accommodate 2 people.

reviews.text:
This place is walking distance from Ortakoy(5min). Around it there are cafes and restaurants. Easy transportation.
Studio room was good. Everything was clean and smelt good. Hot water and toilet working properly.
Worth the money.
Host is also very attentive and careful person. They change towels whenever you need.
Worth the money.

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb in Beşiktaş! The apartment was comfortable, and exactly as described in the listing. The location is perfect — tucked away on a quiet street, yet just a short walk to cafés, restaurants, the Bosphorus, and public transport.
Our host was truly outstanding: very welcoming, always available for questions, and gave us great local tips that made our trip even more special. Check-in and check-out were smooth and easy.
Overall, this place felt like a home away from home, and we would definitely stay here again on our next visit to Istanbul. Highly recommended! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Hidden Gem in the middle of Istanbul💜. Kubilay is a really great host! His staff Hayot was so friendly and helpful. Great place for solo female travelers or couples. The building and location is so safe and easy to reach even late at the night. A lot of different types of public transport availability including sea transportation. 5/7 minutes walk to the Bosphorus and you may enjoy coffee or tea with the most beautiful view. Nice restaurants and shops. The room was so clean with very fresh linens/towels. The cost vs value is 100% match! Easy check-in and Kubilay was so helpful with late check out. Thanks again to fell like home🙏🙏🙏🙏
The apartment is as described. The host is very friendly and always ready to help. Great location with all essentials in walking distance.

Öncelikle oda fotoğraflarda göründüğünden farksızdı, son derece modern ve temizdi. Ev sahibi Kubilay bey ilgiliydi, gece geç saatte giriş yapmamıza rağmen girişte bir problem yaşamadık. Yalnızca araba ile gelecekler için malum İstanbul koşullarından dolayı park yeri bulmakta zorlandık, bunun dışında konumu vs. çok güzeldi.

description:
This spacious flat, which can accommodate up to 8 guests, is situated in a historical building (w high ceilings, AC and lift) in Taksim. Surrounded by numerous attractions including Istiklal Avenue, Galata Tower, Taksim Square and Galataport, the flat’s location is simply unbeatable.
To be exact, Istiklal Street is only 80 meters away!

The flat has 3 BR with king-size beds and a living room with 1 sofa bed, a dining table and TV.

reviews.text:
We had a great stay at Ali's place.
- The lift was was good, it was helpful for bringing the luggage up even though the apartment is on the first floor.
- Clean, spacious, nice modern furtniture.
- Lots of shops and restaurants within walking distance.
- 5-8 min walk to Taksim Square, we took the funicular from there to Kabatash and then from there to Sultanehemet to visit the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sofia, etc.
- The living room is huge and was where we spent the most of our time. Rooms and kitchen are much smaller than what they seem from the photos.
- Comfortable beds, lots of pillows.
- Communication with Ali and cohosts was good, prompt replies. Accommodated our needs for more sheets and laundry (thank you Ali!)
It was loud during the night, lots of crowds in the area even late into the night.
- We were visiting in July and it was hot! The AC in the living room would cool down the whole house but not enough to feel comfortable.

The best part of this stay is the location — right in the heart of Istiklal Street, surrounded by the vibrant, buzzing energy of Istanbul. If you want to be in the middle of the action, this place definitely delivers.
However, there are some serious issues that guests should be aware of - the listing mentions it has elevator and host said the elevator was "not functional that day," but we spoke to the neighbors and found out that it hasn’t been working for quite some time. This is misleading. The stairs are steep and narrow, and carrying luggage up is very challenging. If you're traveling with seniors or anyone with mobility issues, this apartment is absolutely not suitable.
Noise is another major factor if you are a light sleeper — the lively street atmosphere goes on until about 4 AM. The apartment also lacks some basic amenities: there was no drinking water provided, no tissue rolls or tissues, and zero toiletries. On the positive side, the bedsheets were clean.

We were very happy with the location and the accomodation although the kitchen and shower areas were quite small. Also, the TV did not work throughout our stay. Overall it was a great experience and Ali was a very responsive host.

I have stayed 4 nights with my family, we were 5 and 3 of us were old can't use the stairs to and the elevator was out of service once we reached. I found to couples got stock in the elevator for 40 minutes and the owner was not responding. I asked him to understand the issue and cancel my reservation because the elevator was out of service and even if it was fixed we'll not trust it and use it, then he responded you can cancel but no refunds at all. He did not understand the issue that come from his side. however, the place was in the middle of many bars and we did not sleep at all the nosey kept up till 6 in the morning. Also one of the chairs and curtain were broken and I shared pictures to the owner and no respond. I don't recommend the place at all.

Ev sahibiyle harika bir şekilde iletişim halindeydik. Evin konumu gereği her yere yakın ve ulaşılması kolaydı. Yılbaşı organizasyonumuz için harika bir zaman geçirdik. Etrafı dağıttıysak affola, biz çok eğlendik :) Çok teşekkürler, görüşmek üzere.

description: Located in the newest building of Taksim Square, our apartment offers you a view of Taksim Square and Gezi Park. Our apartment, which stands out with its proximity to one of the most popular meeting points of Istanbul, such as Istiklal Street, is specially decorated and includes all the necessary features to maximize your accommodation experience.

reviews.text:
First and foremost, the location was unbeatable. Being right at Taksim Square meant that I was within walking distance of some of Istanbul’s most famous landmarks, restaurants, and shops. The convenience factor was off the charts.
The apartment itself was a cozy haven. It was impeccably clean, well-furnished, and had all the amenities I needed for a comfortable stay. The attention to detail by the host was evident, from the comfortable bed to the fully equipped kitchen.
One of the standout features was the breathtaking view from the apartment’s window. I could wake up to the stunning sights of Taksim Square, and it added an element of magic to my mornings and evenings.
Communication with the host was smooth and hassle-free. They were responsive and went above and beyond to ensure I had everything I needed during my stay.

I have absolutely loved my time in Istanbul in this wonderful apartment in Taksim. The apartment was exactly as described, clean, homely, it had everything I needed & the location was absolutely perfect. The views out of the windows of Taksim Square were beautiful & a real treat to wake up to every morning. The apartment is within a walking distance to the Bosphorus, tram stops, train station & there are plenty of wonderful restaurants nearby to choose from. I stayed as a solo female & felt very safe in the area. The apartment was easy to find & the instructions that Guestvia left were very clear & helpful. The communication with the Guestvia staff was very responsive & they frequently checked in to make sure everything was okay. They helpfully answered any questions I had almost straight away too, which was wonderful. I couldn't have asked for a better stay in Taksim, and I will definitely be staying in this wonderful apartment again in the future. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederim!:)

Great apartment in an excellent location, just a short walk to Taksim Square and the metro. Clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host/management was responsive and helpful throughout my stay. Highly recommend!

The Building at quiet area and walking distance to most attractions. Apartment is re-innovated with old furniture. The overlook from the 7th floor to the surrounding area is amazing with Beautiful Sunlight. Livingroom TV with downloaded Applications but cannot be accessed without the guest “Personal User Profile-details”. Kitchen is part of the Livingroom, fully equipped (no drinking water, Coffee or tea for Guest arrival). Bedroom has a local fabricated furniture over wide-wooden base, standard bed mattress, generic linens, two pillows, no bed-cushions, no side-lights. A folding table next to window and seat-damaged chair.! Bathroom is re-innovated and fully equipped with all necessities and good quality towels. Also, Considering the summer heat high-degree, another point to mention that there’s AC Unit only in the Livingroom. Whereas, the Bedroom has no AC, and the host offers a fan!

Superb location directly facing Taksim square and nice views from the windows to the city. The apartment is nicely decorated with comfortable furniture and full-stacked kitchen. Communication with host was easy with clear check-in and check-out instructions.

description: Enjoy a modern stay in Beyoğlu — close to Taksim! This stylish apartment offers a bedroom, living room, kitchen, and bathroom with heating and seasonal AC (May–Oct). The building has elevators, 24/7 security, a café, and paid social facilities (gym, pool, and sauna). Starbucks and Sheraton City Center Hotel are next door, and you can find us easily by searching “Safezone Homes” on Google Maps 🌿

reviews.text:
We stayed at the location for ~2 weeks. Our experience was the definition of mediocre. Everything was barely acceptable. First the location. it was goodish. Small problem but public transit is 15 min walk uphill. But that's fine. Next the building is okay. They have parking but our specific building smelled in the hallway. (the weird smell is a theme) Now the house itself. The pictures and description do not do the place justice (negatively). There is maintenance that needs to be done as there's water damage under the sink and carpet needs to be deep cleaned and the mattress is horrendous to sleep on. Random stink from the fridge, oven and dishwasher. The dryer keeps shutting off(tried asking host but not solved even tho effort was made) The water pressure is bad but WAY worse is that the water temp is not consistent AT ALL. It'll keep fluctuating and makes showers miserable.
Good things. Place is decent to stay and cook. Heating is good (too much acc) cleaning products provided.

Clean, modern apartment with comfortable bed and pull out sofa. Easily walkable to Taksim square/Galata Tower and area. Transit nearby to access other areas of the city, although we did walk to other popular spots like the Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque. Really enjoyed having access to a gym for a few days. Host was responsive and provided helpful instructions and recommendations for our stay. Great value stay while in Istanbul!

This stay met my expectations! The home was as-described, modern, clean, cozy, and beautifully decorated. Check-in was fairly easy if not for the front door lock. The
host was responsive, friendly and helpful throughout my visit. The door lock needed a little time to figure out otherwise Check-In would have been 5stars. I appreciated the thoughtful touches like fresh towels, coffee. The washer and dryer was also a great bonus. The property is on the main street so while accessibility was great, the noise from everything I needed. I’d definitely book again and recommend for anyone visiting Istanbul.

accommodation was very good. The flat is on the 7th floor. It was just as it looked in the pictures. I will definitely come again. Also the pool and gym were handy. The apartment was very clean. Internet was very fast, I got all my work done. the host is a very nice person! I would recommend it to everyone.

I had no problems during my stay. The host is very kind and helpful. He helped us whenever we needed it. The apartment had everything, even dishwashing liquid. Pool and gym are very good. The cleanliness of the house was the thing I liked the most. It takes 12-15 minutes by walking, very close to Istiklal Street in terms of location. There is a Starbucks very close by and you can get coffee every morning! Thanks great host! I will definitely come again.

description:
Our property is located in a fully renovated building in Beyoğlu, the historical and cultural heart of Istanbul.
It is just a 10-minute walk from İstiklal Street, the metro station, traditional restaurants, and vibrant nightlife spots.
Major landmarks such as Taksim Square, Eminönü, the Blue Mosque, and Galata Tower are also nearby.
With its central location, it’s an ideal choice for both leisure and business travelers

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay here in Istanbul! The apartment was exactly as shown in the pictures, clean, comfortable, and in a great location, very close to everything we needed.
The host was amazing and extremely responsive. Every time I had a question, I received a quick and helpful response, which made the whole stay very easy and stress-free. The staff were also incredibly sweet, welcoming, and helpful.
The location was definitely one of the highlights, as it was so convenient for getting around and exploring Istanbul. Everything was just as expected, and we felt very comfortable throughout our stay.
Thank you so much for making our stay such a pleasant experience! I would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it. ❤️

It is perfect place for a short stay for 1 or 2 people, location is great, all you need is walking distance, balcony is very cute, I was able to work from there, bed was super comfortable, clean, modern space, host was very efficent at replying, I was able to do laundry as well. Kitchen works for easy meals, everything was as listed.

The place is nice, has everything one needs for a short stay with some marks of use but nothing of a big concert. Washroom works fine, bed is comfy, place is clean. Wifi works fine. The guy there do not speak English. Not very clear check-in instructions or directions, but not a big deal either. We arrived 10pm and were a bit uncomfortable when walking to the accommodation trying to find it. It's close to Taksim, but on the other side of the avenue. Once leaving the busy streets, there are a lot of junkies/drunks on the way there, one has to pass a little dodgy park and under a bridge. As a female, if I was alone I'd have been scared.

Lovely small hotel very close to famous Istiklal street but located in a quiet street away from the noise and bustle of the area. Lots of small shops and eating options nearby. There is a kitchenette with basic stuff and lovely balcony in the room. Good internet connection and a table with chairs make the room suitable for working. Washing machine in the building. Emre was very helpful and kind host and we managed to communicate on Whatsup as he does not speak English. Safe access to the hotel via code and good lockers of the room door. Would definitely return again.

It’s a cozy apartment located in the centre of the city and a good place for one person to either work remotely or just stay for vacation. Emre is very responsive and he always gets you supplies you need. The room is clean and maintained, comes with a little nice balcony. It’s a really good price and you’ll get more than you pay. Recommend!

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
I was very disappointed with accommodation in Istanbul and Turkey overall.
The location is excellent. There was a smell in the room, the kitchen was not very useful and the bedsheets were old and itchy.
I can't say it was worth my money, but to be fair I couldn't find anything else for a reasonable price.

I would like to thank the host Arya, was responsive and very helpful.
The apartment is in a nice location (next to a hill and that would not be suitable for ealders or people with knee problems) in my case was totally ok.
The apartment has everything you need and nice for a short visit to Istanbul.
Things to improve;
- the bed mattress was hard and not comfortable at all, need to be replaced with a softer one.
- pillows looks old and thin, need to be replaced.
- curtains does not cover the sunlight properly, you will definitely wake up from the sunlight all over the room.
- the external door makes notices will wake you up whenever is open (need greasing I guess)
- it would be better if you add iron for clothes & a complementary water would be appreciated after a long flight & tea and coffee would be nice.
Other than that everything was excellent.
I would stay again in Arya’s apartment. I hope next time whenever I visit will find what I mentioned resolved.
Thank you for your time.

Very nice and small apartment, which is very pleasant to spend a few days there. Only five minutes from Taksim in a really quiet but safe side street. Unfortunately, the kitchen isn't very usable, but the bed is extremely comfortable. Communication with Arya was always very friendly and helpful. I really enjoyed my stay and would love to come back next time I come to Istanbul.

Great location, close to everything (10-minute walk). Communication with the host was very efficient. The apartment is small but cozy. As is the case in many places in Istanbul, there is a noticeable smell from the bathroom that can sometimes be unpleasant.
Host was awesome and welcoming. Place was warm and welcoming. Only had an issue with the kitchen. Some appliances and drawers need to be updated but overall a great stay! Perfect location as well.

description: Enjoy this romantic place in the lap of nature. We will be pleased to welcome you, our esteemed guests, with our 5 independent custom-made bungalows. We would like to invite you to our wonderful view, which is only 1 hour away from Istanbul.

reviews.text: Anıl bey mükemmel bir ev sahibi samimi misafirperver her konuda yardımcı oluyor mekan tam olarak fotoğraflarla aynıydı temiz güzel rahat bir ortamdı kendi etinizi aldığınız takdirde barbekü hizmetini ücretsiz sunuyor ayrıca biz toplu taşıma ile ulaşım sağladık bizi otogardan alıp tekrar otogara istediğimiz saatte bıraktı her şey çok güzeldi tekrar görüşmek dileğiyle
Beautiful, comfortable, clean, and specious cabin. I specially enjoyed the relaxing environment and the view. Everything is as described and shown in the pictures.
We absolutely loved our stay here, super comfortable cabin with nice balcony, and close to the beach. Anil was a lovely host and his bbq kofta was great. Highly recommend.

Anıl Beyin misafirperverliği kendi evimdeymişim gibi hissettirdi. Her şey fotoğrafta göründüğü gibiydi ve tertemizdi. Bahçe alanında mangalımızı yaptık ve ortak mutfak alanında malzemeleri kullanabilme imkanımız vardı, her şey kusursuzdu. Manzarası da bi harikaydı tabii. Kesinlikle bir daha tercih edebileceğimiz bir yer olacak. Anıl beye çok teşekkür ederiz 🥰🙏🏼
Harika bir konaklamaydı biz hafta sonu için kafa dinlemelik yer baktık ve doğru yere nokta atışı yaptık , ilgileri için teşekkür ederim . Temiz düzenli ve rahat edebileceğiniz bir yer tavsiye ederim…

description: Our wonderful apartment is located in the stunning 42 Maslak building. The apartment is on a high floor, and features a queen bed as well as a private balcony. The building complex also has an indoor pool, sauna, and gym all fully accessible to our guests. The apartment also comes with 1 resident parking pass for underground parking at the resident garage. 24 hr concierge and security staff on site. The indoor mall has many restaurants, shops, and a pharmacy.

reviews.text: Our host was good and responsive. Location is great within walking distance to market, Cafes and restaurants. The flat has only one main problem which the bedroom hasn’t got door and also needs better and complimentary kitchen appliances. Getting to the garage was quite challenging as always being asked by the security guards at the entrance.

This place is a gem. Great location for me and my daughter. Drew was always responsive, easy to communicate with. He wanted to make sure we were happy and checked-in often. The place is clean and breezy even in the summer. The balcony is lovely and the bed very comfy. We will definitely be back.
Drew is a very friendly and helpful host. The house was clean and just like it looked in the photos. The gym and the pool were especially great.

I spent 3 months in the apartment and everything was perfect. The communication with my contact person Drew was easy and he usually responded within minutes. Every issue I had was solved immediately and when a technician came to fix something they even sent someone to translate for me because I don’t speak Turkish. Amazing service!
The apartment was clean and cozy and had everything I needed to feel at home.
The gym and pool were amazing additions to the overall experience.
The area is very safe and you have an amazing café, a supermarket and some restaurants right in the building which is very convenient.
The metro station is ~10 minutes walking distance but I even felt safe going there alone at night.
Overall, would definitely recommend especially for longer stays where you don’t want to be right in the city centre.

Wow - what a gorgeous place!! Luxury, yet affordable rental. The flat is a dream, squeaky clean, ultra modern. The gym is top notch, there's an indoor pool and sauna with lovely views over Istanbul. There's also the infamous gastronomy museum/upmarket food court, with a selection of the best regional Turkish restaurants from around the country. It's 20 minutes to Taksim square on the metro. It's the kind of place you're happy to get back to after seeing the sights and crowds of Istanbul. Carter was a brill host. Would stay here again, no question!

description:
Who wants to feel more local in Istanbul?
- Special penthouse with 120 squaremeter area + attic bedroom for romantic couples,
- 2 minutes walking distance to Taksim Square,
- Historical building with lift,
- Very close to all amenities.

reviews.text:
The apartment is beautiful, special and clean.
and very well located
Aslinaz was very attentive and nice, (through email and whatsup)
the restaurant down stairs is delicious !
The elavetor is a bit bizarre - it arrives straight to the apartment
But there is no other exit .. If you wish to take the stairs or a bit claustrophobic it is a kind of a problem ( as well as what happens when there is a fire?)

The bad point for us was the noise. On the gallery floor where the bedroom is there was a terrible noise all night on the weekend that kept us up.
I hope that was a temporary problem, as Alsinaz told us - she was very kind about it and tried to help by calling the police.
Just make sure that this club is closed or has a sound control before you go because it is really noisy... We ended up sleeping on the sofa on in the salon with ears plug. .

Exept this it was really nice, Alsinaz gave us restaurants recommendation and alway answered imidiatly, the apartment as you can see in photos is beautiful , maybe better for winter as there is a beautiful fireplace
But the air condition was working very well :)

For conclusion - just make sure there is no noise any longer

The penthouse unit where we stayed for 5 days is a unique and interesting space. We enjoyed its large open space, soaring steel trusses and ceilings, with a spacious bedroom loft serviced by an iron spiral staircase.

The apartment is located right in the heart of all the action in Taksim. The area is always bustling with shopping, restaurants and clubs nearby, so there is activity at all hours. While this has its upside in that there is always something going on, it also makes for some loud nights. We were told it could be noisy in the evenings so we were prepared for the general noise. The weekends are much more so. On the Friday night, the booming music from a nearby club didn’t cease until almost 7 AM. Earplugs were not enough to block out that much noise. As they say, if you can’t beat it then join it, so we stayed out until the wee hours and enjoyed ourselves.

Our hosts, Aslinaz and her father, Mustafa – who lives in the penthouse when it isn’t being rented, were responsive, friendly and helpful. Aslinaz recommended a number of places for us to eat and some things to do. She was always available to answer questions, even though she lives in London.

One of our favourite places to have a drink was on the rooftop patio at Ali Ocakbaşı (near the Galata bridge). The view was amazing. There were also two restaurants which were highly recommended, one on each of the 4th (meat) and 5th (fish) floors. It doesn't look like much from street level, but when you get to the rooftop, you won't want to leave!

This was my second time staying at Aslinaz's Penthouse suite. Again a really great place to stay - clean, tasteful and comfortable. Aslinaz and her father (Mustafa) were easy to get a hold of and always friendly and hospitable. The location is perfect for Taksim life, which is very lively. I would recommend staying here.
Fiona

Really lovely and romantic place. The appartment is perfectly located in the very lively – also during nicht – Taksim area. We felt so comfortable in the apartment that it was difficult to motivate ourselves in the morning to go out explore the city :)

A good place to stay in the heart of Istanbuls lively Taksim area. If you like to be close to clubs, restaurants and places to shop this appartments location will suit your needs.

We were three people, to slept in the good sized bed on the upper floor and one in the sofa/bed in the livingroom.

description:
Relax in our recently refurbished, modern rooms decorated in earth-tones. Hard-wood floors, natural light shining through floor-to-ceiling windows offering remarkable views, and fine linens and plush pillows, all enrich the comfort you feel at our apartments.

Choose among rooms that offer stunning views of the Sea of Marmara and across to Asia, or our rooms with the picturesque views of the old city and Sultanahmet district.

reviews.text:
This is not just an Airbnb — it’s an experience.
Beautifully located within walking distance of everything, yet tucked away in a quiet, cozy, super clean, and modern space.
Waking up to the gorgeous view of the water was a real treat.
Communication with Zeynep was easy and seamless.
I truly enjoyed my stay here — it felt peaceful, comfortable, and special in every way. I would love to come back!

The flat was in a great location to visit all of the major sites. The flat was clean and tidy and we found it really useful to have the kitchen to prepare food. I found the host to be very responsive and getting into the flat was very easy. We are very light sleepers so we struggled with the noise from the trains and road even with the really good double glazing, this might not bother other people.

we were greeted by the host with a message asking us to come check in at 4pm instead of 3pm "because cleaner had to pick up child from school and couldn't clean the house on time"
we arrived at the residence at 3pm and sat down accross the street at a coffee shop. 2 hours later (around 5pm) we were able to check in (cleaners were just leaving) and once we got in quickly realized that the apartment wasn't even clean. after sending pictures to the host I got a response of "they were in a hurry and forgot to clean that". as a host myself, I expect to be treated the way I treat my guests. I often stay in istanbul on long Layovers and try to book a different airbnb every time. I am very disappointed because all of our previous airbnb stays were amazing. this one not so much. I hope the host makes some improvements because the location is quite amazing and with a few fixer upers and some better organization I think this place would be amazing

I've had a wonderful time in Istanbul and the apartment is comfortable, clean, and with a marvelous view on the Marmara sea you can enjoy magical sunrises and sunsets.
Everything is well organized.
Zeynep is a thoughtful host and very kind, I'm fortunate to have met her and her family.
The location of the apartment is splendid for visiting the city's cultural treasures, all in Sultanahmet (district) and Eminönü/Karaköy. Within a 10 min. walk you can take the tram which is most convenient. For instance to go with a ferry to another part of the city, like the Asian side, which is great for some quieter time, and still find out what makes this city so special.
From the apartment going out for a walk or run near the shore is also a great choice.
Personally I've loved some great terrace rooftops, from café or restaurant, so for foods too, and to take in some of the best views, experience the fairytale this city offers.
I recommend visiting a Hamam. Wishing you much light and love.

Zeynap's place is in a perfect location to easily walk to all the famous sites. There are stacks of restaurants nearby and bazaars, and there are trams and bus tours close by. The area felt safe to walk around at night. The bed was very comfortable and clean, there was a good sized fridge and induction hob. The shower was fantastic, hot and powerful. The view was great to see the sea and we felt relaxed in the room. Thank you!

description: Enjoy a warm, family-friendly stay in this spacious Şişli apartment, located in a vibrant and safe neighborhood. Cevahir Mall is only 15 minutes away on foot, while Trump and City’s Nişantaşı are within a 20-minute walk. The home features bright living areas, comfortable bedrooms, and a fully equipped kitchen, offering a relaxing base for families and groups. Cafés, markets, and metro access are all close by, making it easy to explore Nişantaşı and central Istanbul.

reviews.text:
We had the absolute pleasure of staying in this fantastic apartment for two weeks, and it exceeded all our expectations!
The location is simply unbeatable—just a short walk to 2 metro -Osmanbey and Sisli -perfect to go old town; main street nearby has plenty of food stores and excellent cafes nearby. The apartment itself was a peaceful haven, allowing us to enjoy restful, undisturbed sleep every night.
The spaciousness was perfect for the four of us, and the comfort was top-notch! The mattresses were very comfortable, ensuring we woke up refreshed each morning. The living room furniture was comfortable and cozy, making it a great space to relax after a long day.
The kitchen was equipped with everything we needed, making meal preparation a breeze.
A few words about our host and management :very professional, responsive, and truly committed to making our stay perfect, our experience was just outstanding!
Without a doubt, we would rent this place again and will highly recommend it !

We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
We experienced a small issue during our stay, but the host was incredibly responsive and available within minutes. Communication was excellent throughout, and the issue was handled quickly and professionally.
The host was kind, helpful, and attentive, which made our stay even more enjoyable. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend this place to future guests.

Our family enjoyed the apartment so much that we plan on staying here again during our next visit to Istanbul. It's quite spacious, with modern and comfortable bedrooms and a great living room. The kitchen is excellent, providing the feeling of cooking at home.
The location was perfect - it's situated in a safe and quiet neighborhood filled with supermarkets, restaurants, and stores. We found the apartment clean and equipped with almost everything we needed for our family of 5.
Thanks a lot Demir!
everything was perfect, the rooms were clean and beds were comfortable. the appartment is well located and near public transportation.

This flat was a peaceful oasis is the busy city of Istanbul! Spacious and comfortable. Very close to the bus and metro for convenient transportation. Hanemo was kind and responsive in communicating. Would definitely stay here again!

description: Welcome to our urban oasis in the heart of Balat! Beautifully designed 1-bedroom home offers a perfect blend of modern comfort and historic charm. Whether you're a solo traveler, a couple seeking a romantic getaway, or here on business, this stylish retreat is the ideal base for exploring Istanbul's rich history and vibrant culture. Premium linens and a cozy bed. Relax in the living room and channel your inner chef in a fully equipped kitchen. Comes with AC, and Wifi.

reviews.text:
I had a wonderful stay at this apartment and can highly recommend it. Everything matched the description and photos perfectly, which made the experience even more comfortable and stressfree.
The host was very proactive, easy to communicate with, and extremely accommodating. I really appreciated the flexibility, especially when extending my stay, which was handled without any issues.
The apartment was clean, well-equipped, and had everything one might need for a comfortable stay. The surrounding area was also beautiful, ideal for both daytime and evening walks. There are great cafés just on the street, which added to the overall experience.
Overall, a very pleasant stay, I would definitely come back again.

The apartment itself is great and in a great location! In Balata it is really difficult to find a modern apartment with good sound insulation and all the amenities needed. So this one is definitely a great option. It also has heating shall you need it in the humid and times chilly Istanbul climate - which is important.
The host was responsive.
It is like renting an apartment for short or long term. You shouldn’t expect the hotel type of service there as changing your bed linen or regular cleaning - this comes at an extra fee. But if you’re ok with that, the option is actually great!

The location couldn’t be better for exploring Balat! You step out of the building right into the middle of the best street. There’s a coffee shop right below the apartment which opens at 07:00, and the rest of the street comes to life at around 09:30-10:30. Boutiques, mini market, cafes, restaurants, rooftop tea spots, mocktail bars, bbq spots - all just steps away. It is noisy at night with music, people, cats and scooters - so pack earplugs or get some from the pharmacy down the road. The apartment is better in real life than in photos! It’s clean, spacious and the host was excellent. My husband was recovering from surgery so we needed more pillows. We asked the host and they were delivered very quickly. I’ve stayed in many airbnb and this is definitely one of the best. I’d recommend the restaurant right at the end of the street called Ballad - it’s a peaceful oasis amongst the hectic street. Great food and service

The apartment is really better in real life than in the pictures. Clean and well-equipped. The hosts have kindly provided an extra blanket and duvet free of charge. The windows are very thin, so if you are sensitive, grab your earplugs - you can hear a man whisper outside. The location was too much for us - touristy, noisy and dirty.
Overall, it’s a nice hotel-grade apartment, but if you are looking for something with a bit more soul and authenticity, this is not the place.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this incredible Airbnb apartment. I was impressed by the stylish and modern decor. The space was impeccably clean and well-maintained.
The apartment was equipped with all the amenities one could need. The kitchen was fully stocked with high-quality appliances and utensils, making it easy to prepare meals. The living area was cozy and perfect for relaxing after a long day of exploring. The bed was exceptionally comfortable.
I’d also like to note the location of the apartment. It was within walking distance to great restaurants, shops, and public transportation.
Overall, this apartment exceeded my expectations in every way. I will definitely be returning on my next visit. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a top-notch Airbnb experience.

description:
Welcome to a thoughtfully designed home in the heart of Istanbul. This spacious three bedroom ground floor duplex combines comfort smart functionality, and modern amenities, offering a relaxing stay for families or groups in one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. A private garden adds a peaceful outdoor space to unwind. Ideal for both short and extended stays.

Whether you are here to discover the city or work remotely, everything you need is right at your fingertips.

reviews.text:
NOA Tatarbeyi 18, Apartment 003 is everything you can ask for in a great AirBnB experience. Aylin was very responsive and took care of all our requests like sending 20L water cans every other day at mkt prices ( no mark ups), getting the place cleaned during our 9 days stay etc. NOA support team was awesome.
Pros:
Location: Place is steps away from Galata tower, short walk to Istiklal street, Tophane and Karakoy tram stations, Karakoy Ferry terminal with lots of restaurants and shopping options in the vicinity.
Property: Big enough to host 6 guests comfortably. Fully equipped kitchen and fast Internet for work calls and meetings. It is located on a quiet street with guest room facing the street (a bit exposed to noise from the cars and scooters but still relatively quiet).
Caveats: Galata area is on a rolling hill with steep elevation, so be cautious if you are traveling with older people or kids on strollers.

This nice apartment is well located close to Galata Tower but still on a fairly quiet street. One of the top floor bedrooms is right on the street. The place was clean and well equipped, and the back deck was nice though the apartments back there look right down on you. And you get visited by tons of cats back there.
If you go in summer months, please note that there is only air conditioning in the top master bedroom and in the living/kitchen area downstairs. so the other bedrooms can get really hot.
Otherwise, we very much enjoyed our stay here. The host company was very responsive, but there is no one on site so just keep that in mind.

My family of four had a wonderful stay at Noa’s place in late May. The location was slightly hard for our Uber to find at night, and is uphill in a neighborhood of tight, largely pedestrian streets. But Noa had provided a phone number that the driver was able to call, and then was able to get directly to the unit, where we were immediately greeted and welcomed inside by a professional, English-speaking staff member.
The apartment itself is beautiful and very comfortable, with lots of space - more than the 4 of us needed. It is modern and well-organized, with two bedrooms and bathrooms upstairs where the main entry is, and another bedroom, living room and kitchen downstairs, as well as a spacious outdoor patio.
The location is central to plenty of restaurants and shops - along with Galata Tower. It’s a short walk to the metro, and also to the ferry that crosses the Bosphorus to the Asian side.
You will hear the city noise outside - and the call to prayer - but we really enjoyed it!

We had a wonderful stay! The Airbnb was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Everything was well-maintained and thoughtfully prepared, making us feel at home from the moment we arrived.
The location was excellent—close to restaurants, shops, public transportation, and many attractions, making it easy to explore the area. The host was friendly, responsive, and made the entire stay smooth and enjoyable.
This is one of the cleanest and best Airbnbs we’ve stayed in, and we would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!
My only regret is not staying longer 😊

We really enjoyed Noa's place, the check-in process having to go to a different building first made it a little difficult since we had to walk from this building to the actual location and the street was very steep.
The apartment looked a little smaller than in the pictures, but it is a good size, very comfortable and cleaned.
One day we tried to use the oven and it didn't work, and the other suggestion we will give to Noa is to provide more toilet paper, we had to buy some since we were running out of it.
The location is great! Seeing the Galata Tower so close to the apartment is beautiful!!
The other inconvenient we found is that many times the taxi drivers don't want to bring you to the door of the building so we had to walk from the main streets and many times we found ourselves walking very steep streets to come back to the apartment.
Overall, we enjoyed our experience in Istanbul and the apartment was
great!!
